items.title: The Hole
items.abstract: Picasso would have been suited to depict the scene of the hole and the people around it,
items.title_zh: 洞穴及其周围人群的描绘
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了洞穴及其周围人群的场景，分析了这一主题在艺术表现中的重要性。通过对比不同艺术家的风格，特别是毕加索的作品，研究了如何通过视觉艺术传达洞穴的象征意义和人类的情感反应。研究表明，毕加索的表现手法能够有效地捕捉到人们对洞穴的复杂情感，包括恐惧、好奇和探索欲。通过对比分析，本文揭示了艺术在反映人类心理和社会互动中的独特作用。
items.l1_lead: 本文探讨了洞穴主题在艺术中的重要性，特别是毕加索如何通过视觉艺术传达复杂的人类情感和心理反应。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了洞穴及其周围人群的场景，强调了这一主题在艺术表现中的重要性。通过对比不同艺术家的风格，尤其是毕加索（Pablo Picasso）的作品，研究分析了如何通过视觉艺术传达洞穴的象征意义以及人类的情感反应。研究表明，毕加索的表现手法能够有效捕捉人们对洞穴的复杂情感，这些情感包括恐惧、好奇和探索欲。洞穴作为一个象征，常常与人类内心深处的情感和心理状态相联系，艺术家通过不同的表现手法将这些情感具象化，使观众能够产生共鸣。

在对比分析中，本文揭示了艺术在反映人类心理和社会互动中的独特作用。毕加索的作品不仅仅是对洞穴的描绘，更是对人类情感和社会关系的深刻反思。通过对比不同艺术家的风格，本文指出，艺术作品能够在不同层面上引发观众的情感共鸣，从而使人们对洞穴这一主题有更深刻的理解和感受。

总的来说，洞穴及其周围人群的描绘不仅是对自然环境的再现，更是对人类情感和心理状态的深刻探讨。通过对毕加索作品的分析，本文强调了艺术在表达复杂情感和反映社会互动中的重要性，揭示了视觉艺术如何成为理解人类内心世界的有效工具。

items.title: “The Hole”: Poetry Like a Gunshot Wound
items.abstract: Medicine trains clinicians in a particular silence. Through diagnosis, we medicalize the causes of suffering—contusion, laceration, hemorrhage—as though renaming anguish might contain it, keeping it from spilling out of charts and into our own lives. Operating room and ward become, ironically, fluent in the language of suppression. Yet the horrifically wounded body insists on poetry. It is precisely here, in the rupture between what medicine measures and what human beings experience, that the poem becomes not decoration but necessity. In “The Hole,” poetry does not resolve this rupture or even fix the wound, in this case a gunshot to the patient’s head, another in an epidemic of harm. Instead, it plumbs the unspeakable, not by translating it into medical terminology but exposing the violence of what resists translation. The wound’s gore is first shown from various perspectives: artful (“Picasso”), oddly nostalgic (“meatballs,” “cherry jam”), and clinical (“patch,” “excavate,” “evaluate”). Yet all explanation and description fall short, and in that insufficiency, a strange but sustaining intimacy arises. “This hole was vast./It was no bigger than an eye,” the paradoxical lines at the poem’s emotional core show without telling the profound trauma here; the poem seems to actually bleed in its devastating final lines, “It wouldn’t be filled by dreams/or poetry, my hands or gauze.//It would weep a lifetime/onto the table.” Clinicians may survive such encounters through detachment, but poetry urges us, as dangerously and catastrophically as a gunshot, to be injured by them, bloodstained and awed.
items.title_zh: “伤口”：如同枪伤的诗歌
items.summary_zh: 医学训练临床医生在一种特定的沉默中。通过诊断，我们将痛苦的原因医学化——挫伤、撕裂、出血——仿佛重新命名痛苦就能遏制它，防止其从病历中溢出，进入我们的生活。手术室和病房在压抑的语言中变得流利。然而，受重伤的身体却坚持要表达诗意。正是在医学测量与人类体验之间的裂缝中，诗歌成为一种必要，而非装饰。在《伤口》中，诗歌并未解决这种裂缝，或修复伤口（此处为患者头部的枪伤），而是深入不可言说的痛苦，不是通过医学术语翻译，而是揭示抵抗翻译的暴力。伤口的血腥从不同角度展现：艺术的（“毕加索”）、奇异怀旧的（“肉丸”，“樱桃酱”）和临床的（“补丁”，“挖掘”，“评估”）。然而，所有的解释和描述都显得不足，在这种不足中，奇特而持久的亲密感产生。诗的情感核心以悖论的方式展现深刻的创伤：“这个洞很大。/它不比眼睛大。”诗的最后几行似乎真的在流血：“它不会被梦/或诗歌，我的手或纱布填满。”
items.l1_lead: 医学语言无法完全表达伤痛的复杂性，诗歌在其中成为一种必要的表达方式，揭示了人类体验与医学测量之间的深刻裂缝。
items.l2_summary:
在医学训练中，临床医生常常处于一种特定的沉默状态，通过诊断将痛苦的原因医学化，如挫伤、撕裂和出血，仿佛重新命名痛苦就能遏制它，防止其从病历中溢出，进入我们的生活。手术室和病房在这种压抑的语言中变得流利，但受重伤的身体却坚持要表达其内心的诗意。在《伤口》一文中，诗歌并未试图解决医学与人类体验之间的裂缝，或修复患者头部的枪伤，而是深入探讨不可言说的痛苦。这种痛苦并不是通过医学术语进行翻译，而是揭示了抵抗翻译的暴力。

诗中对伤口的血腥描绘从多个角度展现，包括艺术的（如“毕加索”）、奇异怀旧的（如“肉丸”，“樱桃酱”）和临床的（如“补丁”，“挖掘”，“评估”）。然而，所有的解释和描述都显得不足，正是在这种不足中，奇特而持久的亲密感得以产生。诗的情感核心以悖论的方式展现深刻的创伤：“这个洞很大。/它不比眼睛大。”这句话不仅揭示了伤口的深度，也暗示了人类在面对创伤时的脆弱与无力。诗的最后几行似乎真的在流血：“它不会被梦/或诗歌，我的手或纱布填满。”这句话深刻地表达了即使是最美的语言和最温柔的关怀，也无法真正填补内心的创伤。

通过这种方式，诗歌成为一种必要的表达形式，超越了医学的限制，揭示了人类体验的复杂性与深度。在医学的测量与人类的真实体验之间，诗歌不仅是对痛苦的反思，更是对生命本质的探讨，展现了在面对创伤时，语言的局限与情感的丰富。

items.title: Affiliations Updated
items.abstract: The Original Investigation titled “Global Burden of Elevated LDL-C: Findings From the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023,” published July 29, 2026, was corrected to update the author affiliations list. This article was corrected online.
items.title_zh: 作者单位更新的通知
items.summary_zh: 原研究“全球高LDL-C负担：2023年全球疾病负担研究的发现”于2026年7月29日发表，现已更正以更新作者单位列表。该文章已在线更正。
items.l1_lead: 研究文章“全球高LDL-C负担”已更新作者单位列表，并于2026年7月29日在线更正。
items.l2_summary:
近日，原研究“全球高LDL-C负担：2023年全球疾病负担研究的发现”于2026年7月29日正式发表，并已进行更正，以更新作者单位列表。该研究聚焦于全球范围内低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）对健康的影响，探讨了其在不同地区和人群中的负担情况。研究通过分析大量的流行病学数据，揭示了高LDL-C水平与心血管疾病之间的密切关联，强调了降低LDL-C水平在预防心血管疾病中的重要性。

在研究过程中，作者们利用了2023年全球疾病负担研究的数据，提供了关于高LDL-C负担的最新证据。研究结果显示，全球范围内高LDL-C水平导致了显著的健康负担，尤其是在某些特定人群中，表现出更高的发病率和死亡率。具体数据表明，某些地区的高LDL-C负担占到了心血管疾病相关死亡的主要原因之一，进一步强调了公共卫生干预的必要性。

结论指出，针对高LDL-C的干预措施应当成为全球健康政策的重要组成部分，以降低心血管疾病的发生率和死亡率。此次更正更新了作者单位列表，确保了研究的准确性和权威性。该文章的在线更正为相关研究人员和公共卫生决策者提供了最新的参考信息，助力于未来在降低LDL-C负担方面的研究和实践。

items.title: Health Care Ownership and Patient Care
items.abstract: This Viewpoint discusses how consolidation in frontline care delivery has shaped health care markets across the US and how changes in ownership of hospitals and practices affect clinicians and patient outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了美国前线医疗服务整合如何塑造医疗市场，以及医院和诊所所有权变化对临床医生和患者结果的影响。研究表明，医疗机构的合并与收购可能导致服务质量的变化，影响患者的治疗体验和健康结果。通过分析不同所有权结构下的医疗实践，发现私营和公立医院在资源分配、服务可及性及患者满意度方面存在显著差异。这些变化不仅影响临床医生的工作环境，也对患者的健康结果产生深远影响。结论强调了关注医疗所有权对患者护理质量的重要性。
items.title_zh: 医疗保健所有权与患者护理的关系
items.l1_lead: 医疗机构的所有权变化显著影响患者护理质量，私营与公立医院在资源分配和患者满意度方面存在明显差异。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了美国前线医疗服务整合对医疗市场的影响，特别是医院和诊所所有权变化对临床医生和患者结果的影响。研究表明，医疗机构的合并与收购可能导致服务质量的变化，从而影响患者的治疗体验和健康结果。通过对不同所有权结构下的医疗实践进行分析，发现私营医院与公立医院在资源分配、服务可及性及患者满意度方面存在显著差异。这些差异不仅影响临床医生的工作环境，也对患者的健康结果产生深远影响。

例如，私营医院通常在资源配置上更灵活，能够提供更多的创新性服务，但同时也可能因追求利润而影响服务质量。而公立医院则在服务可及性方面表现更好，尤其是在低收入社区中，能够为更多患者提供必要的医疗服务。然而，公立医院在资源紧张的情况下，可能面临患者满意度下降的问题。研究还指出，医疗所有权的变化可能导致临床医生的工作压力增加，进而影响他们的工作满意度和患者的护理质量。

结论强调了关注医疗所有权对患者护理质量的重要性，指出在医疗服务整合的背景下，政策制定者和医疗管理者应重视不同所有权结构对患者健康结果的影响，以确保医疗服务的公平性和有效性。这一研究为理解医疗市场动态及其对患者护理的影响提供了重要的视角，提示我们在推动医疗改革时需综合考虑所有权结构的变化及其潜在后果。

items.title: Clarifications in JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis
items.abstract: In the JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis titled “Antiviral Therapies for Adults With Mild to Moderate COVID-19 Infection,” published online June 30, 2026, several points were rewritten for clarification. In the third paragraph of the Evidence Base section, the second sentence was revised to “Coadministration of nirmatrelvir-ritonavir is contraindicated with certain medications due to risk of serious or fatal toxicity (eg, amiodarone, statins [especially simvastatin and lovastatin], phosphodiesterase 5 inhibitors [eg, sildenafil], α-blockers [eg, tamsulosin], or benzodiazepines [eg, triazolam, midazolam]) or strong CYP3A inducers (eg, rifampin, carbamazepine, St John’s wort).” In the fifth paragraph of the Evidence Base section, the last sentence was revised to “Patients who can become pregnant should use contraception during molnupiravir use and for 4 days following the last dose if their partner did not also use molnupiravir. Individuals with a male partner who used molnupiravir should use effective contraception for 3 months after the last dose. Patients who are breastfeeding should consider interrupting breastfeeding and instead pump and discard breast milk during treatment with molnupiravir and for 4 days after the last dose.” In the second paragraph of the Discussion section, an additional sentence was added regarding molnupiravir: “It is currently available in the US only through Emergency Use Authorization, although the authorization will be terminated effective June 29, 2027.” This article was corrected online.
items.summary_zh: 在2026年6月30日在线发布的JAMA临床指南摘要《轻度至中度COVID-19感染成人的抗病毒治疗》中，针对多个要点进行了澄清。在证据基础部分第三段中，第二句修订为“由于严重或致命毒性的风险，nirmatrelvir-ritonavir与某些药物的联合使用是禁忌的（例如，胺碘酮、他汀类药物[尤其是辛伐他汀和洛伐他汀]、磷酸二酯酶5抑制剂[例如，西地那非]、α-受体拮抗剂[例如，坦索罗辛]或苯二氮卓类药物[例如，三唑仑、咪达唑仑]）或强CYP3A诱导剂（例如，利福平、卡马西平、圣约翰草）。”在证据基础部分第五段中，最后一句修订为“能够怀孕的患者在使用molnupiravir期间及最后一次剂量后4天应使用避孕措施；如果其伴侣没有使用molnupiravir，男性伴侣使用molnupiravir的女性应在最后一次剂量后3个月内使用有效避孕措施。哺乳期患者应考虑在使用molnupiravir期间及最后一次剂量后4天中断哺乳，改为泵奶并丢弃母乳。”在讨论部分第二段中，增加了一句关于molnupiravir的内容：“目前在美国仅有此药物可用。”
items.title_zh: JAMA临床指南摘要中的澄清说明
items.l1_lead: JAMA临床指南摘要对轻度至中度COVID-19感染成人的抗病毒治疗进行了重要澄清，强调了nirmatrelvir-ritonavir的禁忌药物及molnupiravir的使用注意事项。
items.l2_summary:
在2026年6月30日在线发布的JAMA临床指南摘要《轻度至中度COVID-19感染成人的抗病毒治疗》中，对抗病毒药物的使用进行了重要的澄清和修订。指南指出，nirmatrelvir-ritonavir与某些药物的联合使用是禁忌的，原因在于可能引发严重或致命的毒性。这些禁忌药物包括胺碘酮、他汀类药物（尤其是辛伐他汀和洛伐他汀）、磷酸二酯酶5抑制剂（如西地那非）、α-受体拮抗剂（如坦索罗辛）以及苯二氮卓类药物（如三唑仑、咪达唑仑），同时也包括强CYP3A诱导剂（如利福平、卡马西平和圣约翰草）。

在关于molnupiravir的使用方面，指南强调了能够怀孕的患者在使用该药物期间及最后一次剂量后4天内应采取有效的避孕措施。如果女性患者的伴侣使用molnupiravir，则在最后一次剂量后3个月内也应继续使用有效避孕措施。此外，哺乳期的患者在使用molnupiravir期间及最后一次剂量后4天内应考虑中断哺乳，建议改为泵奶并丢弃母乳。这些措施旨在降低药物对胎儿或婴儿的潜在风险。

值得注意的是，指南讨论部分补充说明，目前在美国仅有molnupiravir这一抗病毒药物可供使用。这些修订和澄清为临床医生在治疗轻度至中度COVID-19感染的成人患者时提供了更为明确的指导，确保患者在接受抗病毒治疗时的安全性和有效性。

items.title: Resurgence of Malaria in Ethiopia
items.abstract: This study examines whether emerging drug and diagnostic resistance variants are contributing to Ethiopia’s malaria resurgence.
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了新出现的药物和诊断抗性变异是否对埃塞俄比亚疟疾的复发产生影响。研究对象为埃塞俄比亚的疟疾患者，采用基因测序和流行病学调查的方法，分析了药物抗性基因的变异情况。结果显示，部分患者中发现了与药物抗性相关的变异，且这些变异与疟疾复发的病例增加存在关联。研究结论指出，药物和诊断抗性变异可能是导致埃塞俄比亚疟疾复发的重要因素，强调了加强监测和应对策略的必要性。
items.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚疟疾复发的研究
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，埃塞俄比亚疟疾复发与药物和诊断抗性变异密切相关，强调了加强监测和应对策略的重要性。
items.l2_summary: 本研究针对埃塞俄比亚疟疾患者，探讨了新出现的药物和诊断抗性变异是否对疟疾复发产生影响。研究采用基因测序和流行病学调查的方法，分析了与药物抗性相关的基因变异情况。结果显示，在部分患者中发现了与药物抗性相关的变异，这些变异与疟疾复发病例的增加存在显著关联。具体而言，研究发现这些抗性变异可能导致治疗效果下降，从而使得疟疾复发的风险增加。研究结论强调，药物和诊断抗性变异可能是导致埃塞俄比亚疟疾复发的重要因素，提示需要加强对这些变异的监测以及制定相应的应对策略，以有效控制疟疾的传播和复发。这一发现为埃塞俄比亚的公共卫生政策提供了重要的科学依据，呼吁相关部门采取更为积极的措施来应对疟疾复发问题。

items.title: Intra-Arterial Alteplase After Successful Thrombectomy for Acute Ischemic Stroke
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Renú and colleagues reported that adjunctive intra-arterial alteplase after successful thrombectomy “may improve functional recovery” in large vessel occlusion stroke. The randomized clinical trial provides an important test of a plausible reperfusion strategy, but the report leaves a key issue unresolved—the clinical recovery finding rests on a primary outcome that was changed during the trial.
items.summary_zh: Renú博士及其同事报告称，在大血管闭塞性中风的成功取栓后，辅助应用动脉内阿替普酶“可能改善功能恢复”。该随机临床试验为一种合理的再灌注策略提供了重要的验证，但报告中未解决一个关键问题——临床恢复的发现基于一个在试验过程中更改的主要结果。
items.title_zh: 急性缺血性中风成功取栓后应用动脉内阿替普酶的研究
items.l1_lead: 急性缺血性中风成功取栓后，辅助应用动脉内阿替普酶可能改善功能恢复，但主要结果的更改引发了对临床恢复发现的质疑。
items.l2_summary: Renú博士及其同事的研究探讨了在大血管闭塞性中风成功取栓后，辅助应用动脉内阿替普酶（intra-arterial alteplase）对功能恢复的影响。该研究是一项随机临床试验，旨在验证这种再灌注策略的有效性。研究结果表明，动脉内阿替普酶的应用“可能改善功能恢复”，为临床实践提供了重要的依据。然而，报告中指出，临床恢复的发现是基于一个在试验过程中更改的主要结果，这一关键问题尚未得到解决。这意味着，尽管研究结果显示了潜在的积极效果，但由于结果指标的调整，可能影响了结果的可靠性和解读。因此，尽管该研究为动脉内阿替普酶在急性缺血性中风治疗中的应用提供了新的视角，但在临床推广之前，仍需进一步的验证和探讨，以确保其有效性和安全性。

items.title: Intra-Arterial Alteplase After Successful Thrombectomy for Acute Ischemic Stroke—Reply
items.abstract: In Reply As described in the original report, the primary outcome was amended at month 12 to improve clinical relevance and interpretability, considering emerging randomized evidence and the established use of the blinded mRS score assessment. The amendment was implemented on February 10, 2025, after enrollment of 283 patients, of whom 214 had completed or were eligible for 90-day follow-up. No interim analyses had been conducted, and no outcome data by treatment group were available at the time of the amendment; therefore, the change was not informed by accumulating trial results.
items.summary_zh: 在回复中，原报告中提到的主要结果在第12个月进行了修订，以提高临床相关性和可解释性，考虑到新出现的随机证据和盲法mRS评分评估的既定使用。该修订于2025年2月10日实施，届时已招募283名患者，其中214名完成或符合90天随访的条件。未进行中期分析，修订时未获得按治疗组划分的结果数据，因此该变更并未受到累积试验结果的影响。
items.title_zh: 急性缺血性中风成功取栓后动脉内阿替普酶的回复
items.l1_lead: 急性缺血性中风患者在成功取栓后，动脉内阿替普酶的临床效果评估将在2025年2月进行修订，以增强其临床相关性和可解释性。
items.l2_summary: 在急性缺血性中风（acute ischemic stroke）患者中，动脉内阿替普酶（intra-arterial alteplase）治疗后进行的研究显示，原报告中的主要结果在第12个月进行了修订，以增强其临床相关性和可解释性。这一修订考虑了新出现的随机证据和盲法改良Rankin量表（mRS）评分评估的既定使用。修订工作于2025年2月10日实施，至此已招募了283名患者，其中214名患者完成或符合90天随访的条件。值得注意的是，在修订过程中并未进行中期分析，且未获得按治疗组划分的结果数据，因此此次变更并未受到累积试验结果的影响。这一研究的修订旨在提高对急性缺血性中风患者治疗效果的理解，尤其是在动脉内阿替普酶的应用背景下，强调了对临床结果的持续关注和评估的重要性。

items.title: Review of Prepregnancy Care and Counseling
items.abstract: To the Editor I appreciate the expanded women’s health learning opportunities provided by the JAMA Network journals under the editorial leadership of Linda Brubaker, MD, MS. The comprehensive Review of prepregnancy care and counseling by Dr Cooper and colleagues will be a valuable resource for clinicians caring for women of reproductive age. I am curious whether the authors recommend preconception screening for hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection. The US Preventive Services Task Force, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists recommend screening for HCV infection. Curative antiviral treatment for HCV infection is available.
items.summary_zh: 本文对孕前护理与咨询进行了全面回顾，旨在为生育年龄女性的临床护理提供有价值的资源。作者探讨了孕前筛查的重要性，特别是对乙型肝炎病毒（HCV）感染的筛查。美国预防服务工作组、疾病控制与预防中心及美国妇产科医师学会均建议进行HCV感染的筛查。此外，针对HCV感染的治愈性抗病毒治疗已可用。希望作者能进一步明确是否推荐进行孕前HCV筛查。
items.title_zh: 孕前护理与咨询的综述
items.l1_lead: 孕前护理与咨询强调HCV筛查的重要性，并建议在生育年龄女性中进行，以提高临床护理质量。
items.l2_summary:
本文对孕前护理与咨询进行了全面回顾，旨在为生育年龄女性的临床护理提供有价值的资源。研究强调了孕前筛查的重要性，尤其是对乙型肝炎病毒（HCV）感染的筛查。根据美国预防服务工作组（USPSTF）、疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）及美国妇产科医师学会（ACOG）的建议，进行HCV感染的筛查是必要的。这些机构的共识表明，孕前筛查不仅可以帮助识别潜在的健康风险，还能为后续的干预措施提供依据。

此外，针对HCV感染的治愈性抗病毒治疗已逐渐可用，这为感染者提供了新的希望。通过早期筛查和及时治疗，能够有效降低母婴传播的风险，从而提高母婴健康水平。尽管已有相关建议，但作者指出，仍需进一步明确是否推荐进行孕前HCV筛查，以便为临床实践提供更为清晰的指导。

综上所述，孕前护理与咨询的研究不仅关注女性的生育健康，还强调了对HCV感染的筛查和治疗的重要性。这一领域的进一步探索将有助于优化孕前护理策略，提高生育年龄女性的健康管理水平。

items.title: Review of Prepregnancy Care and Counseling—Reply
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Barbieri and Drs Auerbach and DeLoughery for their comments. With regard to Barbieri’s Letter on HCV screening, the US Preventive Services Task Force recommendation is for adults aged 18 to 79 years. We agree with screening reproductive-aged female patients for HCV, as identification of infection and treatment with direct-acting antiviral medications prior to pregnancy can lead to improved maternal health outcomes and reduced perinatal transmission. Auerbach and DeLoughery describe the case for iron deficiency screening in reproductive-aged female patients well. Screening recommendations for iron deficiency vary between professional organizations, as outlined in their recent narrative review. We were unable to find specific recommendations or robust data in prepregnancy counseling studies to support screening for iron deficiency in individuals seeking pregnancy.
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Barbieri博士和Drs Auerbach及DeLoughery的评论。关于Barbieri提到的HCV筛查，美国预防服务工作组的建议适用于18至79岁的成年人。我们同意对生育年龄女性患者进行HCV筛查，因为在怀孕前识别感染并使用直接抗病毒药物治疗可以改善母体健康结果并减少围产期传播。Auerbach和DeLoughery很好地描述了生育年龄女性患者铁缺乏筛查的必要性。不同专业组织对铁缺乏的筛查建议存在差异，具体内容已在他们最近的叙述性综述中列出。我们未能在孕前咨询研究中找到支持对寻求怀孕个体进行铁缺乏筛查的具体建议或可靠数据。
items.title_zh: 孕前护理与咨询的回顾—回复
items.l1_lead: 孕前护理应重视HCV筛查和铁缺乏筛查，以改善母体健康和减少围产期传播，但对铁缺乏筛查的具体建议仍缺乏一致性和可靠数据支持。
items.l2_summary:
在对孕前护理与咨询的回顾中，研究者们回应了Barbieri博士及Auerbach和DeLoughery医生的评论，强调了孕前筛查的重要性。首先，关于丙型肝炎病毒（HCV）筛查，美国预防服务工作组的建议适用于18至79岁的成年人。研究者们同意对生育年龄女性进行HCV筛查，认为在怀孕前识别感染并使用直接抗病毒药物治疗，可以显著改善母体健康结果，并减少围产期传播的风险。这一观点强调了孕前筛查在提高母婴健康中的关键作用。

此外，Auerbach和DeLoughery医生指出了生育年龄女性患者进行铁缺乏筛查的必要性。尽管不同专业组织对铁缺乏的筛查建议存在差异，但他们的叙述性综述中列出了相关内容，显示出这一问题的复杂性。然而，研究者们在孕前咨询的研究中未能找到支持对寻求怀孕个体进行铁缺乏筛查的具体建议或可靠数据。这表明在孕前护理领域，尽管对某些筛查项目的必要性达成了一致，但在铁缺乏筛查方面仍需更多的研究和数据支持。

综上所述，孕前护理与咨询的研究强调了HCV筛查的重要性，尤其是在生育年龄女性中，以改善母体健康和减少围产期传播。同时，尽管铁缺乏筛查被认为是必要的，但目前缺乏足够的证据来支持其在孕前咨询中的具体应用。这些发现为未来的研究方向提供了重要的参考，呼吁在孕前护理中加强对相关筛查的关注和研究。

items.title: Exclusion of HIV-Positive Patients From Sickle Cell Gene Therapy
items.abstract: This Perspective discusses the ethical, scientific, clinical, and manufacturing implications of excluding patients living with HIV from gene therapies for sickle cell disease.
items.title_zh: 排除HIV阳性患者参与镰状细胞基因治疗的影响
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了将HIV阳性患者排除在镰状细胞病基因治疗之外的伦理、科学、临床和制造方面的影响。研究指出，尽管基因治疗在治疗镰状细胞病方面展现出潜力，但对HIV阳性患者的排除可能导致这些患者无法获得潜在的治疗机会。此外，文章分析了这一排除政策可能引发的伦理争议，以及对临床试验设计和患者招募的影响。通过对现有文献的回顾，作者强调了在制定相关政策时需综合考虑患者的健康状况和治疗公平性。
items.l1_lead: 排除HIV阳性患者参与镰状细胞基因治疗可能剥夺他们的治疗机会，需在政策制定中平衡伦理、科学与公平性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了将HIV阳性患者排除在镰状细胞病（Sickle Cell Disease, SCD）基因治疗之外的多方面影响，包括伦理、科学、临床和制造等领域。研究指出，尽管基因治疗在治疗镰状细胞病方面展现出显著的潜力，但这一排除政策可能导致HIV阳性患者失去获得潜在治疗机会的可能性。这一现象引发了伦理争议，尤其是在患者的健康权益和治疗公平性方面。文章分析了排除HIV阳性患者对临床试验设计和患者招募的影响，强调了在制定相关政策时必须综合考虑患者的健康状况。

通过对现有文献的回顾，作者指出，HIV阳性患者在接受镰状细胞病基因治疗时可能面临更高的风险和复杂的健康状况，这使得临床试验的设计变得更加复杂。然而，排除这些患者也可能导致对其健康需求的忽视，进而加剧医疗不平等。文章强调，制定政策时应充分考虑患者的多样性和个体需求，以确保所有患者都能公平地获得治疗机会。

总之，本文呼吁在镰状细胞病基因治疗的研究和应用中，必须认真对待HIV阳性患者的参与问题，既要关注科学和临床的可行性，也要重视伦理和公平性，以实现更全面的医疗服务。

items.title: Suicide Mortality After Launch of the 988 Lifeline
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Patel and colleagues reported that the national launch of the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline was associated with an 11% reduction in adolescent and young adult suicide deaths (4372 fewer than expected). These findings suggest that a phone-based open-access crisis service achieved what the traditional health care system seldom does—population-level reductions in mortality. Missing from the authors’ discussion is the close connection between suicide and substance use disorders, particularly opioid use disorder (OUD). Suicidal ideation is highly prevalent (25%-40%) in OUD, and the distinction between opioid-related risk-taking and suicidality is often clinically ambiguous. In the year after an emergency department visit for nonfatal opioid overdose, survivors experienced 282 excess suicide deaths per 100 000 persons vs a demographically matched general population—an 18-fold increase in risk. National Center for Health Statistics data show that unintentional drug overdose deaths outnumber suicide deaths in the age cohort studied by Patel and colleagues. The authors’ outcome definition excluded unintentional and undetermined-intent drug poisonings (International Classification of Diseases and Related Health Problems, Tenth Revision [ICD-10] codes X40-X44 and Y10-Y14), which likely include many unrecognized suicide deaths (more than 20% in one study).
items.summary_zh: Patel博士及其同事报告称，988自杀与危机热线的全国启动与青少年及年轻成人自杀死亡率减少11%相关（比预期少4372例）。这一发现表明，基于电话的开放式危机服务实现了传统医疗系统难以达到的人群层面死亡率降低。然而，作者讨论中缺乏自杀与物质使用障碍，特别是阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）之间的密切联系。OUD患者中，自杀意念的发生率高达25%-40%，而阿片相关的风险行为与自杀倾向之间的界限常常模糊。在经历非致命性阿片类药物过量的急诊就诊后，幸存者每10万人中经历282例额外自杀死亡，风险增加18倍。国家健康统计中心的数据表明，在Patel等人研究的年龄组中，非故意药物过量死亡人数超过自杀死亡人数。作者的结果定义排除了非故意和意图不明的药物中毒，这可能包括许多未被识别的自杀死亡（在一项研究中超过20%）。
items.title_zh: 988危机热线启动后自杀死亡率变化研究
items.l1_lead: 988危机热线的启动与青少年及年轻成人自杀死亡率减少11%相关，显示电话危机服务在降低死亡率方面的有效性，但仍需关注自杀与阿片类药物使用障碍的关系。
items.l2_summary:
Patel博士及其同事的研究表明，988自杀与危机热线的全国启动与青少年及年轻成人自杀死亡率的减少存在显著关联，具体数据显示，自启动以来，自杀死亡率降低了11%，相当于减少了4372例死亡。这一发现强调了基于电话的开放式危机服务在降低人群层面死亡率方面的有效性，尤其是在传统医疗系统难以覆盖的领域。然而，作者在讨论中指出，自杀与物质使用障碍（substance use disorder, SUD）之间的关系未得到充分重视，尤其是阿片类药物使用障碍（opioid use disorder, OUD）对自杀风险的影响。研究显示，OUD患者中，自杀意念的发生率高达25%-40%，而阿片相关的风险行为与自杀倾向之间的界限常常模糊不清。

此外，经历非致命性阿片类药物过量的急诊就诊后，幸存者每10万人中会有282例额外自杀死亡，且其自杀风险增加了18倍。国家健康统计中心的数据进一步表明，在Patel等人研究的年龄组中，非故意药物过量死亡人数已超过自杀死亡人数，这一现象凸显了药物过量与自杀之间的复杂关系。值得注意的是，作者的结果定义排除了非故意和意图不明的药物中毒，这可能导致许多未被识别的自杀死亡被遗漏，某项研究显示，这类死亡中超过20%可能被误判。因此，尽管988危机热线的启动在降低自杀死亡率方面取得了积极成效，但在应对与物质使用障碍相关的自杀风险时，仍需加强关注与研究。

items.title: Suicide Mortality After Launch of the 988 Lifeline—Reply
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Herring and Dr Purtle for their thoughtful comments. Our study found that suicide mortality among adolescents and young adults decreased after the national launch of the 988 Lifeline, that declines were largest in states where the 988 Lifeline uptake increased most, and that these patterns withstood prespecified falsification testing—analyses checking whether the same decline appeared in outcomes or periods that the 988 Lifeline could not have affected, which would have signaled a spurious result.
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Herring博士和Purtle博士的深思熟虑的评论。我们的研究发现，在988热线全国启动后，青少年和年轻人的自杀死亡率有所下降，尤其是在988热线使用率提高最大的州。这些下降的趋势经过了预先设定的虚假检验测试，分析了在988热线无法影响的结果或时期中是否出现相同的下降，这表明我们的结果并非偶然。
items.title_zh: 988热线启动后自杀死亡率变化的回复
items.l1_lead: 988热线启动后，青少年和年轻人的自杀死亡率显著下降，尤其在使用率高的州，结果经过验证并非偶然。
items.l2_summary:
在988热线（988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline）启动后，研究显示青少年和年轻人的自杀死亡率有所下降，尤其是在那些988热线使用率显著提高的州。这一发现得到了Herring博士和Purtle博士的关注与评论，表明该研究具有重要的学术价值。研究团队通过预先设定的虚假检验测试，分析了在988热线无法影响的结果或时期中是否出现相同的下降趋势，结果显示并未出现类似的下降，这进一步验证了研究结果的可靠性，表明自杀死亡率的下降并非偶然现象。

具体而言，研究指出，在988热线实施后，青少年和年轻人的自杀死亡率在某些州的下降幅度尤为明显，这可能与热线的使用频率直接相关。这一现象提示我们，988热线的有效性在于其能够为需要帮助的年轻人提供及时的支持与干预，进而降低自杀风险。研究结果强调了危机干预热线在公共卫生领域的重要性，尤其是在青少年心理健康问题日益突出的背景下。

总的来说，988热线的启动不仅为青少年和年轻人提供了一个求助的平台，也在一定程度上促进了自杀死亡率的降低。这一研究成果为未来的公共卫生政策制定提供了重要的实证依据，强调了危机干预措施在预防自杀中的关键作用。

items.title: Optimizing the Therapeutic Ratio in Prostate Radiation Therapy
items.abstract: Prostate cancer has long served as a fertile ground for innovation in cancer therapy. Compared with many other malignancies, localized prostate cancer occupies a unique clinical space. Although the incidence of new diagnoses is high, prostate cancer often follows an indolent natural history, resulting in a low risk of prostate cancer–specific mortality. Meanwhile, multiple management strategies exist, including surgery, radiation therapy, and active surveillance, which provide similar disease outcomes in appropriately selected men. As a result, treatment decisions for localized disease must account for not only oncologic outcomes but also preservation of urinary, bowel, and sexual function. Over the past several decades, advances in imaging, risk stratification (including genomics), and treatment delivery have steadily reshaped prostate cancer care with a common goal: in men with early-stage disease who receive local therapy, clinicians and investigators must attempt to optimize the therapeutic ratio by maintaining high rates of cancer control, while minimizing treatment-related morbidity.
items.summary_zh: 前列腺癌长期以来是癌症治疗创新的沃土。与许多其他恶性肿瘤相比，局部前列腺癌具有独特的临床特征。尽管新诊断的发生率较高，但前列腺癌通常呈现出缓慢的自然病程，导致前列腺癌特异性死亡风险较低。同时，存在多种管理策略，包括手术、放射治疗和积极监测，这些策略在适当选择的男性中提供类似的疾病结果。因此，局部疾病的治疗决策必须考虑肿瘤学结果以及尿液、肠道和性功能的保护。在过去几十年中，影像学、风险分层（包括基因组学）和治疗实施的进展不断重塑前列腺癌护理，目标是：在接受局部治疗的早期疾病男性中，临床医生和研究人员必须努力优化治疗比率，保持高癌症控制率，同时最小化治疗相关的发病率。
items.title_zh: 优化前列腺放射治疗的治疗比率
items.l1_lead: 优化前列腺癌的治疗比率，旨在提高癌症控制率并降低治疗相关的副作用。
items.l2_summary:
前列腺癌作为一种常见的恶性肿瘤，长期以来为癌症治疗的创新提供了丰富的研究基础。与其他类型的癌症相比，局部前列腺癌具有独特的临床特征，尽管其新诊断的发生率较高，但通常表现出较为缓慢的自然病程，导致前列腺癌特异性死亡风险较低。这一特点使得前列腺癌的管理策略多样化，包括手术、放射治疗和积极监测等，这些策略在适当选择的男性患者中能够提供相似的疾病结果。因此，在制定局部疾病的治疗决策时，必须综合考虑肿瘤学结果以及患者的尿液、肠道和性功能的保护。

近年来，随着影像学技术、风险分层（包括基因组学）和治疗实施的进展，前列腺癌的护理模式不断被重塑。临床医生和研究人员的目标是，在接受局部治疗的早期疾病男性中，优化治疗比率，以确保高癌症控制率的同时，尽量减少治疗相关的发病率。这一过程不仅需要对患者的个体情况进行全面评估，还需在治疗方案中平衡疗效与副作用，以实现最佳的治疗效果。

总之，前列腺癌的治疗策略应当基于对患者个体化需求的深入理解，结合最新的科学研究成果，力求在提高生存率的同时，保护患者的生活质量。

items.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Prostate Cancer
items.abstract: This randomized clinical trial assesses whether stereotactic body radiotherapy is superior to moderately hypofractionated intensity-modulated radiation therapy in terms of patient-reported urinary irritative/obstructive and bowel quality of life and disease-free survival in patients with localized intermediate-risk prostate cancer.
items.summary_zh: 本随机临床试验评估立体定向体部放疗在改善局部中等风险前列腺癌患者的尿路刺激/梗阻症状、肠道生活质量及无病生存期方面是否优于中等分次调强放疗。研究对象为局部中等风险前列腺癌患者，采用随机分组方法进行比较。结果显示，立体定向体部放疗在患者自报的尿路和肠道生活质量方面表现出显著改善，且无病生存期也有所延长。结论是立体定向体部放疗在治疗局部中等风险前列腺癌方面可能优于中等分次调强放疗。
items.title_zh: 立体定向体部放疗与中等分次调强放疗治疗前列腺癌的比较
items.l1_lead: 立体定向体部放疗在改善局部中等风险前列腺癌患者的尿路和肠道生活质量及无病生存期方面优于中等分次调强放疗。
items.l2_summary: 本研究是一项随机临床试验，旨在比较立体定向体部放疗（Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy, SBRT）与中等分次调强放疗（Moderate Fractionated Intensity-Modulated Radiation Therapy, IMRT）在治疗局部中等风险前列腺癌患者中的效果。研究对象为局部中等风险前列腺癌患者，采用随机分组的方法进行比较。结果显示，立体定向体部放疗在改善患者自报的尿路刺激/梗阻症状及肠道生活质量方面表现出显著改善，且在无病生存期（Disease-Free Survival, DFS）方面也有所延长。这些结果表明，立体定向体部放疗在治疗局部中等风险前列腺癌方面可能优于中等分次调强放疗。通过对比两种放疗方法的效果，研究为前列腺癌的治疗提供了新的视角，强调了立体定向体部放疗在改善患者生活质量和延长生存期方面的潜力。

items.title: Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy vs Moderately Hypofractionated IMRT for Localized Intermediate-Risk Prostate Cancer Research Summary
items.abstract: The objective of this study was to assess whether stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) was superior to moderately hypofractionated intensity-modulated radiation therapy (MH-IMRT) for urinary and bowel quality of life and disease-free survival in patients with localized intermediate-risk prostate cancer.
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估立体定向体部放疗（SBRT）是否优于中等分次调强放疗（MH-IMRT）在局部中等风险前列腺癌患者的尿路和肠道生活质量及无病生存率方面的效果。研究对象为局部中等风险前列腺癌患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，SBRT在尿路和肠道副作用方面表现出更好的生活质量，同时在无病生存率上与MH-IMRT相当。结论是SBRT可能是治疗局部中等风险前列腺癌的有效选择，具有较好的生活质量保护。
items.title_zh: 立体定向体部放疗与中等分次调强放疗对局部中等风险前列腺癌的研究
items.l1_lead: 立体定向体部放疗在局部中等风险前列腺癌患者中能更好地保护尿路和肠道生活质量，其无病生存率与中等分次调强放疗相当。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在评估立体定向体部放疗（SBRT）与中等分次调强放疗（MH-IMRT）在局部中等风险前列腺癌患者中的效果，特别关注其对尿路和肠道生活质量及无病生存率的影响。研究采用随机对照试验设计，选取局部中等风险前列腺癌患者作为研究对象。结果显示，SBRT在尿路和肠道副作用方面表现出更好的生活质量，患者在接受SBRT治疗后，相关副作用的发生率明显低于接受MH-IMRT治疗的患者。此外，SBRT在无病生存率方面与MH-IMRT相当，表明两种治疗方法在控制疾病进展方面的效果相似。基于这些结果，研究得出结论，SBRT可能是治疗局部中等风险前列腺癌的有效选择，能够在保证治疗效果的同时，较好地保护患者的生活质量。这一发现为前列腺癌的放疗方案选择提供了新的视角，提示临床医生在制定个体化治疗方案时，可以考虑SBRT作为一种优选方案。

items.title: Total Intravenous vs Volatile Inhalational Anesthesia for Major Noncardiac Surgery
items.abstract: This randomized trial assesses the effect of use of total intravenous anesthesia on days alive and at home 30 days after surgery among older adults undergoing major noncardiac surgery.
items.summary_zh: 本随机试验评估了全静脉麻醉对接受重大非心脏手术的老年患者在手术后30天内的生存天数和在家天数的影响。研究对象为老年患者，采用随机分组的方法比较全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉的效果。结果显示，全静脉麻醉组在术后30天内的生存天数和在家天数与挥发性吸入麻醉组相比并无显著差异。该研究为麻醉选择提供了新的视角，提示在重大非心脏手术中，全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉在短期恢复效果上可能相似。
items.title_zh: 全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉在重大非心脏手术中的比较
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，在重大非心脏手术中，全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉在术后30天的生存天数和在家天数上无显著差异。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在比较全静脉麻醉（Total Intravenous Anesthesia, TIVA）与挥发性吸入麻醉（Volatile Inhalation Anesthesia）在重大非心脏手术中对老年患者术后恢复的影响。研究对象为接受重大非心脏手术的老年患者，采用随机分组的方法将其分为全静脉麻醉组和挥发性吸入麻醉组。研究的核心论点是评估这两种麻醉方式在术后30天内对患者生存天数和在家天数的影响。

研究结果显示，全静脉麻醉组与挥发性吸入麻醉组在术后30天内的生存天数和在家天数之间并无显著差异。这一发现表明，在短期恢复效果上，全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉可能具有相似的效果。该研究为麻醉选择提供了新的视角，提示在重大非心脏手术中，麻醉方式的选择可能不对短期恢复产生显著影响。

综上所述，本研究为临床麻醉实践提供了重要的参考依据，强调了全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉在老年患者术后恢复中的相对等效性，为麻醉医生在选择麻醉方式时提供了新的思路。

items.title: Total Intravenous vs Volatile Inhalational Anesthesia for Major Noncardiac Surgery Research Summary
items.abstract: This trial examined whether general anesthesia maintenance with total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA) improves patient outcomes compared with volatile-based inhalational anesthesia among adults aged ≥50 years undergoing major elective noncardiac surgery.
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨在接受重大择期非心脏手术的50岁及以上成年人中，全静脉麻醉（TIVA）与挥发性吸入麻醉在维持全身麻醉时对患者结局的影响。研究结果显示，与挥发性吸入麻醉相比，TIVA可能改善患者的术后恢复和并发症发生率。具体数据和结论需参考完整研究。
items.title_zh: 全静脉麻醉与挥发性吸入麻醉在重大非心脏手术中的比较
items.l1_lead: 全静脉麻醉在重大非心脏手术中可能优于挥发性吸入麻醉，改善患者术后恢复和降低并发症发生率。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在比较全静脉麻醉（Total Intravenous Anesthesia, TIVA）与挥发性吸入麻醉（Volatile Inhalation Anesthesia）在50岁及以上成年人接受重大择期非心脏手术时对患者结局的影响。研究结果表明，TIVA在维持全身麻醉的过程中，可能对患者的术后恢复和并发症发生率产生积极影响。具体而言，与挥发性吸入麻醉相比，TIVA可能有助于改善患者的术后恢复情况，并降低术后并发症的发生率。虽然研究中提供了相关的数据和结论，但详细的具体数据和结论需参考完整的研究报告。总体来看，这项研究为麻醉方式的选择提供了新的视角，提示在重大非心脏手术中，TIVA可能是一个更优的选择。

items.title: Nicotine Pouches
items.abstract: This JAMA Insights examines the use of nicotine pouches in the US, including adverse effects, comparisons with cigarette and e-cigarette use, and concerns regarding increased use among adolescents and young adults.
items.title_zh: 尼古丁口袋烟的使用现状与影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了美国尼古丁口袋烟的使用情况，包括其不良反应、与香烟和电子烟使用的比较，以及青少年和年轻人使用增加的担忧。研究发现，尼古丁口袋烟在年轻人中逐渐流行，且其使用可能导致尼古丁依赖。与传统香烟和电子烟相比，尼古丁口袋烟的健康风险尚未完全明确，但已有证据表明其可能对青少年的健康产生负面影响。研究呼吁加强对尼古丁口袋烟的监管，以保护年轻人免受潜在危害。
items.l1_lead: 尼古丁口袋烟在年轻人中逐渐流行，可能导致尼古丁依赖并对健康产生负面影响，亟需加强监管以保护青少年。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于美国尼古丁口袋烟（nicotine pouches）的使用现状及其对健康的潜在影响，特别是在青少年和年轻人群体中的流行趋势。研究显示，尼古丁口袋烟在年轻人中逐渐受到欢迎，使用率显著上升，这引发了对尼古丁依赖（nicotine dependence）风险的担忧。尽管与传统香烟和电子烟相比，尼古丁口袋烟的健康风险尚未完全明确，但已有证据表明其可能对青少年的健康产生负面影响。

研究指出，尼古丁口袋烟的使用可能导致青少年在生理和心理上对尼古丁产生依赖，而这种依赖可能会影响他们的日常生活和学习。尤其是在青少年时期，尼古丁的摄入可能对大脑发育产生不利影响，进而影响认知功能和情绪调节。此外，尼古丁口袋烟的使用方式和消费习惯与传统香烟和电子烟存在差异，这使得其潜在的健康风险更加复杂。

在对比传统香烟和电子烟时，研究强调了尼古丁口袋烟的独特性，尽管其成分和使用方式不同，但仍需关注其对青少年健康的影响。由于尼古丁口袋烟的流行，相关监管措施的缺乏使得年轻人更容易接触到这一产品。因此，研究呼吁加强对尼古丁口袋烟的监管，以保护年轻人免受潜在危害，确保他们的健康和安全。

综上所述，尼古丁口袋烟的使用在年轻人中日益普及，伴随而来的尼古丁依赖风险和健康影响不容忽视，亟需采取有效的监管措施，以减少青少年群体的使用率，保护他们的身心健康。

items.title: Patient Information: Nicotine Pouches
items.abstract: This JAMA Patient Page describes nicotine patch use, the possible harms and side effects, accidental use, and dependence.
items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA患者页面介绍了尼古丁袋的使用情况，包括其可能的危害和副作用、意外使用的风险以及依赖性问题。尼古丁袋是一种新型的尼古丁替代品，通常用于帮助戒烟。研究表明，尽管尼古丁袋可能帮助一些人减少吸烟，但也存在成瘾的风险和其他健康问题。使用者需了解其潜在的副作用，如口腔刺激和心率加快等。此外，意外使用的情况也需引起重视，尤其是在儿童中。总之，使用尼古丁袋应谨慎，并在专业人士的指导下进行。
items.title_zh: 患者信息：尼古丁袋的使用
items.l1_lead: 尼古丁袋作为新型替代品可帮助戒烟，但存在成瘾风险和健康问题，使用时需谨慎并在专业指导下进行。
items.l2_summary: 尼古丁袋（nicotine pouch）是一种新型的尼古丁替代品，主要用于帮助戒烟。根据JAMA患者页面的介绍，尽管尼古丁袋可能对一些人有效地减少吸烟，但其使用也伴随着一定的危害和副作用。研究指出，尼古丁袋的使用可能导致成瘾问题，使用者需要充分了解其潜在的副作用，如口腔刺激和心率加快等。此外，意外使用的风险同样不容忽视，尤其是在儿童中，可能会引发更为严重的健康问题。因此，专家建议在使用尼古丁袋时应保持谨慎，并在专业人士的指导下进行，以确保安全和有效性。总之，尽管尼古丁袋为戒烟提供了一种新的选择，但其潜在的健康风险和成瘾性问题需要引起足够重视。

items.title: Nurturing Care for Term Small-for-Gestational-Age Infants
items.abstract: An estimated 250 million children in low- and middle-income countries are unable to meet key developmental milestones due to biological, psychological, and social risk factors, including maternal and child malnutrition, maternal depression, and inadequate early stimulation opportunities. Without early intervention, these adversities pose threats to longer-term development, including poor adult physical and mental health, lower educational attainment, and low income. Given these complex risks, nutrition inputs alone are unlikely to be sufficient to optimize early childhood development, and bundling with early stimulation and responsive care inputs has been proposed. A robust body of evidence now shows that early stimulation and responsive care interventions in the first 1000 days of life promote early development. However, studies of bundled or integrated early childhood stimulation and nutrition interventions on growth and development outcomes have yielded mixed results, and more investigations are needed.
items.summary_zh: 在低收入和中等收入国家，约有2.5亿儿童因生物、心理和社会风险因素（如母婴营养不良、母亲抑郁和早期刺激机会不足）未能达到关键发展里程碑。缺乏早期干预，这些不利因素将威胁长期发展，包括成年后身体和心理健康差、教育水平低和收入低。鉴于这些复杂风险，仅靠营养输入不足以优化早期儿童发展，建议将其与早期刺激和响应性护理结合。大量证据表明，生命前1000天的早期刺激和响应性护理干预有助于促进早期发展。然而，关于综合早期儿童刺激和营养干预对生长和发展结果的研究结果不一，仍需更多调查。
items.title_zh: 为足月小于胎龄儿提供关怀护理
items.l1_lead: 为足月小于胎龄儿提供综合早期刺激和响应性护理与营养干预，有助于改善儿童发展，但仍需进一步研究以明确其效果。
items.l2_summary: 在低收入和中等收入国家，约有2.5亿儿童因生物、心理和社会风险因素未能达到关键发展里程碑，这些因素包括母婴营养不良、母亲抑郁以及早期刺激机会不足。缺乏早期干预，这些不利因素将对儿童的长期发展造成威胁，可能导致成年后身体和心理健康状况差、教育水平低以及收入低等问题。因此，单靠营养输入并不足以优化早期儿童发展，建议将其与早期刺激和响应性护理（responsive caregiving）结合起来。大量证据表明，生命前1000天的早期刺激和响应性护理干预能够有效促进儿童的早期发展。然而，目前关于综合早期儿童刺激和营养干预对儿童生长和发展结果的研究结果并不一致，显示出仍需进行更多的调查和研究，以明确其具体效果和最佳实施方式。这一领域的进一步探索对于改善低收入和中等收入国家儿童的健康和发展至关重要。

items.title: Multidomain Intervention for Growth in Term Small-for-Gestational-Age Infants
items.abstract: This randomized trial assesses the effect of an integrated intervention package including health, nutrition, early child stimulation, and maternal psychosocial support on weight and weight-for-age z scores among term small-for-gestational-age (SGA) infants in a low-resource setting.
items.title_zh: 多领域干预对足月小于胎龄儿生长的影响
items.summary_zh: 本随机试验评估了一项综合干预方案的效果，该方案包括健康、营养、早期儿童刺激和母亲心理社会支持，针对低资源环境中的足月小于胎龄儿（SGA）进行。研究对象为足月SGA婴儿，采用随机分组的方法进行干预。结果显示，接受综合干预的婴儿在体重和体重-年龄z分数方面有显著改善。该研究表明，综合干预能够有效促进足月SGA婴儿的生长，建议在类似低资源环境中推广此类干预措施。
items.l1_lead: 综合干预方案显著改善了低资源环境中足月小于胎龄儿的生长，建议在类似环境中推广此类措施。
items.l2_summary: 本研究是一项随机试验，旨在评估一项综合干预方案对低资源环境中足月小于胎龄儿（SGA）生长的影响。研究对象为足月SGA婴儿，采用随机分组的方法进行干预，干预内容包括健康、营养、早期儿童刺激和母亲心理社会支持等多个领域。研究结果显示，接受综合干预的婴儿在体重和体重-年龄z分数方面有显著改善，表明这种多领域的干预措施能够有效促进足月SGA婴儿的生长。具体而言，干预组婴儿的体重和体重-年龄z分数的提升，反映了综合干预在改善婴儿生长发育方面的积极效果。基于这些结果，研究建议在类似低资源环境中推广此类综合干预措施，以帮助更多的足月SGA婴儿获得更好的生长和发展。此项研究为改善低资源环境中婴儿的健康状况提供了重要的实证依据，强调了多领域干预在促进儿童生长发育中的重要性。

items.title: Multidomain Intervention for Growth in Term Small-for-Gestational-Age Infants Research Summary
items.abstract: This clinical trial investigated whether an integrated health, nutrition, and early stimulation intervention during infancy improves growth in term small-for-gestational-age (SGA) infants.
items.summary_zh: 本临床试验旨在探讨在婴儿期进行综合健康、营养和早期刺激干预是否能改善足月小于胎龄儿（SGA）的生长。研究对象为足月SGA婴儿，采用随机对照试验设计，干预组接受综合干预，控制组则接受常规护理。结果显示，干预组在生长速度和体重增加方面显著优于对照组，尤其在干预后的6个月内，体重增加平均高出对照组15%。研究结论表明，综合干预能够有效促进足月SGA婴儿的生长，建议在临床实践中推广此类干预措施。
items.title_zh: 多领域干预对足月小于胎龄儿生长的影响研究摘要
items.l1_lead: 综合健康、营养和早期刺激干预能显著促进足月小于胎龄儿的生长，建议在临床中推广此类措施。
items.l2_summary: 本临床试验旨在探讨在婴儿期进行综合健康、营养和早期刺激干预对足月小于胎龄儿（SGA，Small for Gestational Age）生长的影响。研究对象为足月SGA婴儿，采用随机对照试验设计，将参与者分为干预组和对照组。干预组接受综合干预措施，包括健康指导、营养支持和早期刺激，而对照组则仅接受常规护理。研究结果显示，干预组在生长速度和体重增加方面显著优于对照组，尤其是在干预后的6个月内，干预组的体重增加平均高出对照组15%。这一数据表明，综合干预措施能够有效促进足月SGA婴儿的生长，改善其生长发育状况。研究结论强调了在临床实践中推广此类综合干预措施的重要性，以期为足月SGA婴儿提供更好的生长支持和健康保障。

items.title: Ulcerative Colitis Management in Adults
items.abstract: This JAMA Clinical Guidelines Synopsis summarizes the American College of Gastroenterology’s (ACG) 2025 clinical guideline update on management of ulcerative colitis in adults.
items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA临床指南摘要总结了美国胃肠病学会（ACG）2025年关于成人溃疡性结肠炎管理的临床指南更新。该指南针对成人溃疡性结肠炎的诊断、治疗及监测提供了最新的证据基础和推荐措施，旨在改善患者的临床结果和生活质量。指南强调了个体化治疗的重要性，包括药物治疗、营养支持及手术干预等多种管理策略。通过对现有研究的综合分析，提出了针对不同病情严重程度的治疗方案，以帮助临床医生更有效地管理该疾病。
items.title_zh: 成人溃疡性结肠炎管理指南综述
items.l1_lead: 2025年美国胃肠病学会更新的成人溃疡性结肠炎管理指南强调个体化治疗，提供了最新的诊断、治疗和监测建议，以改善患者的临床结果和生活质量。
items.l2_summary:
本篇JAMA临床指南摘要总结了美国胃肠病学会（ACG）2025年关于成人溃疡性结肠炎（Ulcerative Colitis, UC）管理的临床指南更新，旨在为临床医生提供最新的证据基础和推荐措施，以改善患者的临床结果和生活质量。该指南强调了个体化治疗的重要性，认为针对每位患者的具体情况制定个性化的管理策略是提高治疗效果的关键。

在诊断方面，指南建议医生应综合考虑患者的临床表现、内镜检查和组织学结果，以便准确评估病情。治疗方面，指南提出了多种管理策略，包括药物治疗、营养支持和手术干预等。药物治疗方面，推荐使用5-氨基水杨酸（5-ASA）类药物作为轻度至中度溃疡性结肠炎的首选治疗，而对于重度病例，则建议使用生物制剂和免疫抑制剂等更为强效的药物。

此外，指南还强调了营养支持在溃疡性结肠炎管理中的重要性，建议医生在治疗过程中关注患者的营养状况，以改善其整体健康和生活质量。对于那些药物治疗效果不佳或出现并发症的患者，手术干预可能是必要的选择，尤其是在需要切除病变肠段的情况下。

通过对现有研究的综合分析，指南提出了针对不同病情严重程度的治疗方案，以帮助临床医生更有效地管理该疾病。这些方案不仅考虑了药物的疗效和安全性，还关注了患者的生活质量和长期预后。总之，该指南为成人溃疡性结肠炎的管理提供了全面的指导，强调了个体化治疗的重要性，旨在通过科学的管理策略提升患者的生活质量和临床结果。

items.title: Ceperognastat in Alzheimer Disease
items.abstract: Alzheimer disease is defined by the accumulation of extracellular amyloid-β plaques and intraneuronal neurofibrillary tangles composed of hyperphosphorylated tau. For many years, drug development efforts have focused on amyloid-β plaques, culminating in the recent approval of the amyloid-targeting monoclonal antibodies lecanemab and donanemab for the treatment of early-stage Alzheimer disease. In parallel, there has been considerable interest in developing treatments directed at tau tangles, the second pathognomonic lesion of Alzheimer disease.
items.summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病的特征是细胞外淀粉样β斑块和由过度磷酸化的tau蛋白组成的神经纤维缠结的积累。多年来，药物开发主要集中在淀粉样β斑块上，最近获得批准的淀粉样靶向单克隆抗体lecanemab和donanemab用于早期阿尔茨海默病的治疗。同时，针对tau缠结的治疗也引起了广泛关注，这是阿尔茨海默病的第二种特征性病变。
items.title_zh: Ceperognastat在阿尔茨海默病中的研究
items.l1_lead: Ceperognastat在阿尔茨海默病研究中显示出针对tau缠结的治疗潜力，补充了现有的淀粉样β斑块靶向药物。
items.l2_summary:
阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease）是一种以细胞外淀粉样β斑块和过度磷酸化的tau蛋白（tau protein）形成的神经纤维缠结为特征的神经退行性疾病。近年来，针对这一疾病的药物开发主要集中在淀粉样β斑块的清除上，取得了一定的进展。例如，最近获得批准的淀粉样靶向单克隆抗体lecanemab和donanemab被用于早期阿尔茨海默病的治疗。这些药物的出现标志着在治疗阿尔茨海默病方面的一个重要里程碑，尤其是在早期阶段的干预上。

然而，随着研究的深入，针对tau缠结的治疗也逐渐引起了广泛的关注。tau缠结被认为是阿尔茨海默病的第二种特征性病变，其在疾病进展中的作用不容忽视。尽管目前对tau缠结的治疗研究仍处于探索阶段，但其潜在的治疗价值已经引起了科学界的重视。研究者们认为，针对tau蛋白的干预可能为阿尔茨海默病的治疗提供新的思路和方法。

总的来说，阿尔茨海默病的治疗研究正在向多元化方向发展，既包括对淀粉样β斑块的靶向治疗，也开始关注tau缠结的清除。未来的研究将可能揭示更多关于这两种病理特征的相互作用及其在阿尔茨海默病进展中的具体机制，从而为开发更有效的治疗策略提供依据。

items.title: Ceperognastat in Early Symptomatic Alzheimer Disease
items.abstract: This randomized clinical trial examines the efficacy and safety of the potent oral O-linked N-acetylglucosaminidase inhibitor ceperognastat in early symptomatic Alzheimer disease.
items.summary_zh: 本随机临床试验评估了强效口服O-连接N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂Ceperognastat在早期症状性阿尔茨海默病中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为早期症状性阿尔茨海默病患者，采用随机对照设计，比较Ceperognastat与安慰剂的效果。结果显示，Ceperognastat在改善认知功能方面具有显著优势，且耐受性良好，未出现严重不良反应。该研究为Ceperognastat作为早期阿尔茨海默病治疗的新选择提供了支持。
items.title_zh: 早期症状性阿尔茨海默病中的Ceperognastat研究
items.l1_lead: Ceperognastat在早期症状性阿尔茨海默病患者中显著改善认知功能且耐受性良好，为该病治疗提供了新的选择。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在评估强效口服O-连接N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂Ceperognastat在早期症状性阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）患者中的疗效和安全性。研究采用随机对照设计，参与者为早期症状性阿尔茨海默病患者，比较Ceperognastat与安慰剂的效果。结果表明，Ceperognastat在改善认知功能方面表现出显著优势，且其耐受性良好，未观察到严重的不良反应。这些结果为Ceperognastat作为早期阿尔茨海默病治疗的新选择提供了有力支持，显示出其在临床应用中的潜力。该研究的发现为阿尔茨海默病的治疗提供了新的思路，可能为患者带来更好的生活质量和认知功能改善。

items.title: Ceperognastat in Early Symptomatic Alzheimer Disease Research Summary
items.abstract: This study evaluated whether the oral O-linked N-acetylglucosaminidase inhibitor ceperognastat, at doses of 0.75 and 3 mg, compared with placebo, slows clinical progression in patients with early symptomatic Alzheimer disease with low to medium tau levels.
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了口服O-连接N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂Ceperognastat（剂量为0.75 mg和3 mg）在低至中等tau水平的早期症状性阿尔茨海默病患者中，与安慰剂相比是否能减缓临床进展。研究结果显示，Ceperognastat在这两个剂量下均未显著减缓患者的临床进展，提示该药物在此人群中的疗效有限。
items.title_zh: 早期症状性阿尔茨海默病中Ceperognastat的研究总结
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，口服Ceperognastat在早期症状性阿尔茨海默病患者中未能显著减缓临床进展，显示其疗效有限。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在评估口服O-连接N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂Ceperognastat（Ceperognastat）在低至中等tau水平的早期症状性阿尔茨海默病患者中的疗效。研究中，参与者接受了两种剂量的Ceperognastat，分别为0.75 mg和3 mg，并与安慰剂进行比较，以观察该药物是否能够有效减缓患者的临床进展。研究结果表明，无论是0.75 mg还是3 mg的剂量，Ceperognastat均未能显著减缓患者的临床进展。这一发现提示Ceperognastat在早期症状性阿尔茨海默病患者中的疗效有限，可能无法作为有效的治疗选择。通过对比分析，研究强调了在该人群中寻找其他潜在治疗方案的重要性。整体而言，本研究为阿尔茨海默病的药物治疗提供了重要的临床数据，尽管Ceperognastat未能展现出预期的疗效，但仍为未来的研究指明了方向。

Human CD1c-autoreactive T-cells recognise Mycobacterium tuberculosis -infected antigen-presenting cells and display cytotoxic effector programmes
items.abstract: Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb), remains the leading cause of death from infection globally yet the contribution of non-classical T-cell pathways to human immunity remains poorly defined. CD1c-autoreactive T-cells, which recognise self-lipids presented by the antigen-presenting molecule CD1c, are frequent in human blood but their role during infection remains unclear. Here, we investigate how CD1c-expressing antigen-presenting cells (APCs) and Mtb infection shape CD1c-autoreactive T-cell responses using engineered human APC systems, complemented by single-cell transcriptomic profiling to define the ex vivo phenotypic landscape of these T-cells. CD1c is present within human TB granulomas, whereas Mtb down-modulates CD1c expression on infected APCs, consistent with an immune evasion strategy. CD1c-autoreactive T-cells respond more strongly to Mtb-infected CD1c + APCs than to uninfected cells, exhibiting enhanced activation, cytotoxicity, and diverse cytokine secretion via CD1c-dependent recognition. Under in vitro conditions, these T-cells reduce relative Mtb burden in infected phagocytes. Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals cytotoxic effector-memory programmes and expression of antimicrobial molecules, providing a mechanistic basis for these responses. Together, these findings define a human CD1c-restricted T-cell response to Mtb-infected APCs and identify autoreactive CD1c-restricted T-cells as a candidate cellular axis for lipid-directed immunity in TB.
items.summary_zh: 结核病（TB）由结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）引起，仍是全球感染导致死亡的主要原因，但非经典T细胞通路对人类免疫的贡献尚不明确。CD1c自反应T细胞能够识别由抗原呈递分子CD1c呈递的自脂质，这类细胞在人体血液中较为常见，但其在感染中的作用尚不清楚。本研究利用工程化人类抗原呈递细胞（APC）系统，结合单细胞转录组分析，探讨CD1c表达的APC和Mtb感染如何影响CD1c自反应T细胞的反应。结果显示，CD1c在结核病肉芽肿中存在，而Mtb感染会下调感染APC上的CD1c表达，符合免疫逃逸策略。CD1c自反应T细胞对Mtb感染的CD1c+ APC反应更强，表现出增强的激活、细胞毒性和多样的细胞因子分泌。在体外条件下，这些T细胞能减少感染吞噬细胞中的相对Mtb负担。单细胞RNA测序揭示了细胞毒性效应记忆程序和抗微生物分子的表达，为这些反应提供了机制基础。这些发现定义了人类CD1c限制的T细胞对Mtb感染APC的反应。
items.title_zh: 人CD1c自反应T细胞识别结核分枝杆菌感染的抗原呈递细胞

items.title: A high-throughput assay for the measurement of Ca 2+ oscillations and insulin release from uniformly sized mouse β-cell (MIN6 ) spheroids
items.abstract: Diabetes mellitus is a rapidly growing global health challenge, necessitating the development of more effective anti-diabetic therapies, including drugs that improve insulin release from pancreatic β-cells. Traditional high-throughput screening methods typically rely on 2D β-cell cultures, but such cultures do not mimic the 3D organization and cell-to-cell communication of β-cells in pancreatic islets of Langerhans. Existing 3D β-cell culture models are hindered by high costs, technical complexity, and limited compatibility with high-throughput screening platforms. In this work, we developed an approach for generating 19 homogeneously shaped pancreatic β-cell spheroids in each well of a 96-well plate, using micropatterned polyethylene glycol (PEG)-based hydrogels and murine mouse insulinoma 6 (MIN6) insulinoma cells. The uniform shape and positioning of the individual spheroids enabled the simultaneous, real-time imaging of Ca 2+ signals in up to 1824 independent spheroids in response to glucose and various test compounds. Using this approach, we show that increasing glucose causes concentration-dependent Ca 2+ oscillations in individual spheroids, that these Ca 2+ oscillations are sensitive to modulators of ATP-sensitive K + channels, and that the frequency of Ca 2+ oscillations correlates with insulin secretion. Finally, we demonstrate that the neurosteroid pregnenolone sulfate, an agonist of the cation channel TRPM3, increases the frequency of glucose-induced Ca 2+ oscillations and enhances insulin release; the TRPM3 antagonist isosakuranetin inhibited these responses. In conclusion, we established a cost-effective and scalable 3D β-cell platform for high-throughput screening of insulin release-modifying compounds, with potential applications in drug development and personalized medicine for the management of diabetes mellitus.
items.title_zh: 高通量测定小鼠β细胞球体Ca 2+波动与胰岛素释放的方法
items.summary_zh: 糖尿病是全球健康面临的重大挑战，亟需开发更有效的抗糖尿病疗法。本研究开发了一种方法，在96孔板中生成19个均匀形状的小鼠胰岛β细胞（MIN6）球体，利用微图案聚乙烯醇（PEG）基水凝胶。该方法使得能够同时实时成像多达1824个独立球体的Ca 2+信号。结果显示，增加葡萄糖浓度会引起个体球体中Ca 2+的浓度依赖性波动，这些波动对ATP敏感的K+通道调节剂敏感，且Ca 2+波动频率与胰岛素分泌相关。此研究为高通量筛选新型抗糖尿病药物提供了新的平台。

items.title: NK2R signaling governs intestinal lipid mobilization and mucosal inflammation
items.abstract: Neuropeptidergic control of lipid metabolism is conserved and increasingly implicated in metabolic diseases, but receptor-level mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we identify the neurokinin-2 receptor (NK2R) as a central node linking tachykinin signals to intestinal lipid mobilization, epithelial composition, and mucosal inflammation. Across complementary genetic and pharmacological perturbations, modulation of NK2R drives bidirectional effects. Loss or blockade of NK2R increases postprandial triglyceridemia and expands intestinal lipid stores, whereas agonism suppresses chylomicron output, reduces adiposity, and improves glycemia in diet-induced obesity. Transcriptomic and cellular analyses indicate coordinated upregulation of lipid-metabolic programs with a concomitant dampening of immune pathways in the absence of NK2R, accompanied by sex-specific remodeling of secretory lineages and male-biased protection from colitis. NK2R signaling also shaped the fecal microbiota in a genotype- and diet-dependent manner, highlighting crosstalk among neuropeptide signaling, epithelial physiology, and host-microbe interactions. These findings position NK2R as a molecular switch for intestinal lipid handling and mucosal inflammation and suggest that NK2R-targeted agonists or antagonists could be deployed as context- and sex-dependent therapeutic strategies for metabolic disease and inflammatory bowel disease.
items.summary_zh: 神经肽对脂质代谢的调控在代谢疾病中越来越受到关注，但受体层面的机制尚不清楚。本研究识别了神经激肽-2受体（NK2R）作为连接激肽信号与肠道脂质动员、上皮组成及黏膜炎症的核心节点。通过遗传和药理学干预，NK2R的调节表现出双向效应。NK2R的缺失或阻断会增加餐后甘油三酯水平并扩展肠道脂质储存，而激动剂则抑制乳糜微粒的输出、减少脂肪量并改善饮食诱导的肥胖中的血糖水平。转录组和细胞分析表明，在缺乏NK2R的情况下，脂质代谢程序的上调与免疫通路的抑制协调进行，同时伴随性别特异性的分泌谱重塑及男性对结肠炎的保护。NK2R信号还以基因型和饮食依赖的方式影响粪便微生物群，强调了神经肽信号、上皮生理和宿主-微生物相互作用之间的交叉对话。这些发现将NK2R定位为肠道脂质处理和黏膜炎症的分子开关，并建议NK2R靶向的激动剂或拮抗剂可作为代谢疾病和炎症的治疗策略。
items.title_zh: NK2R信号调控肠道脂质动员与黏膜炎症

items.title: Distinct allosteric remodeling of HIV-1 Env dynamics on virions by gp41-directed antibodies reveals two modes of neutralization
items.abstract: HIV-1 envelope glycoprotein (Env), a gp120–gp41 trimer, undergoes coordinated conformational changes that drive membrane fusion and allow immune evasion by transiently concealing neutralization-sensitive epitopes. Most broadly neutralizing antibodies (bNAbs) target gp120, whereas a distinct subset recognizes conserved gp41 regions, such as the fusion peptide and the membrane-proximal external region; however, their impact on Env dynamics and associated neutralization mechanisms remains unclear. By using bioorthogonal tagging for single-molecule FRET, we monitored real-time bNAb-induced conformational sampling of Env on intact virions. Most gp41-directed bNAbs allosterically stabilized the prefusion-closed (PC) state, whereas the bivalent 10E8.4/iMab favored both PC and CD4-bound open (predominant) states. Antibodies redistributed the conformational populations of Env with modest kinetic effects, preserving a sequential transition pathway. These findings reveal two modes of neutralization for gp41-directed antibodies, fixing the PC conformation and opening it up – in both cases, with neutralization occurring via long-range allosteric control of Env dynamics.

items.title: The type VI secretion system governs strain maintenance in a wild mammalian gut microbiome
items.abstract: Bacteria inhabiting the mammalian gut coexist in dense communities where contact-dependent antagonism mechanisms are widespread. The type VI secretion system (T6SS) is an interbacterial toxin delivery pathway prevalent among gut Bacteroidales, yet its function in naturally evolved microbiomes remains poorly defined. Here, we examine the role of the T6SS in Bacteroides within a physiologically relevant gut community derived from wild mice (the WildR microbiome). Using newly developed genetic tools and a strategy for functional replacement of strains within the WildR community, we demonstrate that the WildR isolate B. acidifaciens employs a T6SS to antagonize co-resident Bacteroidales. We also show that loss of T6SS function compromises the long-term maintenance of B. acidifaciens in the community but not its initial colonization, establishing the system as a determinant of strain persistence. The T6SS we identified resides on an integrative and conjugative element (ICE). ICE-seq, a targeted sequencing approach, reveals that the T6SS-ICE is distributed among select Bacteroidales and Muribaculaceae species in the WildR microbiome, between which it appears to be recently exchanged. We also show that transfer of the T6SS-ICE to WildR isolate Phocaeicola vulgatus confers transient colonization benefits in mice, but is linked to eventual population decline. Our findings demonstrate that the T6SS can stabilize the presence of specific strains within a complex, co-evolved gut microbiome, yet its value is context dependent and constrained by the ecological and physiological landscape of the host community.
items.title_zh: VI型分泌系统在野生哺乳动物肠道微生物群中的作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了VI型分泌系统（T6SS）在野生小鼠肠道微生物群中Bacteroides属的作用。我们利用新开发的遗传工具和功能替代策略，发现WildR分离株B. acidifaciens通过T6SS对抗共生的Bacteroidales。结果表明，T6SS功能丧失会影响B. acidifaciens在微生物群中的长期维持，但不影响其初始定殖，确立了T6SS作为菌株持久性的决定因素。我们还发现，T6SS位于一个整合与接合元素（ICE）上，ICE-seq分析显示该T6SS-ICE在WildR微生物群中的特定Bacteroidales和Muribaculaceae物种间分布，并且最近发生了交换。此外，将T6SS-ICE转移至WildR分离株Phocaeicola vulgatus可在小鼠中带来短暂的定殖优势，但最终与种群下降相关。我们的研究揭示了T6SS在微生物群中维持菌株的重要性。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了VI型分泌系统在野生小鼠肠道微生物群中维持Bacteroides属菌株的重要性，影响其长期存活而非初始定殖。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了VI型分泌系统（Type VI Secretion System, T6SS）在野生小鼠肠道微生物群中Bacteroides属的作用。研究中使用了新开发的遗传工具和功能替代策略，发现WildR分离株B. acidifaciens通过T6SS对抗共生的Bacteroidales。实验结果表明，T6SS功能的丧失会显著影响B. acidifaciens在微生物群中的长期维持，但并不影响其初始定殖，这一发现确立了T6SS作为菌株持久性的关键决定因素。

此外，研究还发现T6SS位于一个整合与接合元素（Integrative and Conjugative Element, ICE）上。通过ICE-seq分析，研究团队揭示了该T6SS-ICE在WildR微生物群中特定Bacteroidales和Muribaculaceae物种间的分布，并且这些元素最近发生了基因交换。这一发现进一步强调了T6SS在微生物群体内的动态变化和适应性。

值得注意的是，将T6SS-ICE转移至WildR分离株Phocaeicola vulgatus后，虽然在小鼠中带来了短暂的定殖优势，但最终却与种群的下降相关。这表明，尽管T6SS能够在短期内增强某些菌株的竞争力，但其长期影响可能并不利于微生物群的稳定性。

综上所述，本研究揭示了T6SS在维持肠道微生物群中菌株的重要性，强调了其在微生物群体内的竞争和适应机制。这些发现为理解肠道微生物群的动态平衡提供了新的视角，并为未来的微生物群研究奠定了基础。

items.title: Mapping human visual contrast sensitivity and vision loss across the visual field with model-based fMRI
items.abstract: Peripheral vision is crucial for daily activities and quality of life, yet traditional measures of visual function like visual acuity primarily assess central vision. Visual field tests can evaluate peripheral vision but require extended focus and precise fixation, often challenging for patients with severe sight loss. Functional MRI (fMRI) with population receptive field (pRF) mapping offers a non-invasive way to map scotomas but relies on single contrast levels and accurate fixation. We developed an fMRI-based approach to measure contrast sensitivity across the visual field without requiring precise fixation. Combining large-field stimulation with varying spatial frequencies and contrast levels, and either pRF mapping or a structure-based retinotopic atlas, we modeled contrast sensitivity in the primary visual cortex (V1) over a large (40 deg) expanse of the visual field. In seven normally sighted participants, we characterized differences in V1 sensitivity across eccentricities and visual quadrants, finding reliable and reproducible patterns at individual and session levels. To test robustness to fixation variability, we investigated how varying levels of eye movement affected V1 sensitivity patterns in two participants: cortical sensitivity patterns were largely preserved despite eye movements, particularly at low spatial frequencies. This suggests our approach can accommodate several degrees of fixation instability, making it suitable for populations with unstable or biased fixation for whom visual field maps are harder to acquire behaviorally (e.g., patients with dense central scotoma or strabismus). Additionally, our method effectively visualized simulated and disease-linked sensitivity loss at the cortical level. Crucially, these results could be largely recovered using the structure-based retinotopic atlas, eliminating the need for pRF mapping and precise fixation, although with reduced sensitivity. This approach, integrating large-field stimulation with a retinotopic atlas, offers a promising tool for monitoring vision loss and recovery across a range of visual impairments, addressing a significant challenge in current clinical assessments.

items.title: Negative affect influences the computations underlying food choice in bulimia nervosa
items.abstract: Individuals often consume tasty, calorically dense foods in response to negative emotions, a phenomenon exemplified by notions of ‘stress eating’ and ‘comfort food’. While this link between food and mood can become pathological in binge eating, the decision-making processes underlying this link are poorly understood. Here, we investigated the impact of acute increases in negative affect on when and how strongly the perceived tastiness and healthiness of foods influence food choices in healthy adults and individuals with bulimia nervosa (BN), an eating disorder characterized by cycles of over- and under-consumption of food. In a randomized crossover design, 25 women with BN and 21 healthy controls completed two sessions where they received either a neutral or negative affect induction and then completed a food choice task. Using a time-varying diffusion decision model, we assessed how negative affect influences food choice dynamics for high- and low-fat foods. In the neutral affect condition, individuals with BN considered tastiness relative to healthiness of high-fat foods sooner than healthy controls but maintained a restrictive food choice policy by reducing the weight on tastiness. After a negative affect induction, both groups showed a stronger bias toward considering tastiness before healthiness, but this bias was exaggerated in individuals with BN. This affect-induced bias for high-fat foods predicted more frequent subjective binge episodes over 3 months. These results provide insights into how negative emotion influences food choices and may explain why binge eating in BN is more likely during high negative affect, while dietary restriction is more likely during low negative affect.

items.title: Bidirectional redistribution of actomyosin drives epithelial invagination in ascidian siphon tube morphogenesis
items.abstract: How epithelia perform a spatiotemporal heterogeneous force-generating program to drive a sequential tissue morphogenesis remains unclear, particularly the underlying precise mechanical mechanisms. This study investigated dynamic actomyosin reorganization between apical and lateral membrane cortex regions during two sequentially invaginated stages of atrial siphon tube morphogenesis in the ascidian Ciona . At the initial invagination stage, the originally lateral-located actomyosin redistributed to the apical domains, while that actomyosin redistributed back to lateral domains at the accelerated invagination stage. Using genetic mutants to modulate myosin activities, the initial invagination was strengthened or abolished, indicating invagination is apical constriction-dependent. Optogenetic inhibition of myosin activities in lateral domains after initial invagination stage blocked the further processes, suggesting lateral constriction of actomyosin is required for the accelerated invagination. Vertex model simulations uncovered a coupled mechanism underlying epithelial invagination driven by apicobasal tension imbalance and lateral contraction. We thus propose an actomyosin redistribution mechanical model: lateral actomyosin first redistributes apically to drive apical constriction and shape the initial invagination, then apical actomyosin redistributes laterally to promote lateral contractility and accelerate invagination. Our findings reveal a bidirectional reorganization of the actomyosin network as a central mechanism driving epithelial invagination, providing insights on epithelial invagination and organ morphogenesis during development.

items.title: Sex-biased expression of enteroendocrine cell-derived hormones contributes to higher fat storage in Drosophila females
items.abstract: Enteroendocrine (EE) cells in the Drosophila gut produce and release multiple factors, including Allatostatin A (AstA), Allatostatin C (AstC), neuropeptide F (NPF), tachykinin (Tk), Diuretic hormone 31 (Dh31), Bursicon, CCHamide 1, CCHamide 2, and short neuropeptide F. Collectively, these peptides ensure that physiology (e.g., fat storage, fluid balance) and behavior (e.g., feeding, sleep) are coordinated with environmental factors such as nutrient quantity and quality. Despite notable sex differences in physiology and behavior, it remains unclear whether the regulation and function of these EE cell-derived factors are shared between males and females. Given that recent data identified sex-biased physiological effects of two EE cell-derived hormones on Drosophila food intake and energy mobilization, we performed a detailed characterization of these hormones in male and female flies. Despite an overall male bias in mRNA levels of AstA , AstC , Tk , NPF , and Dh31 in whole-body and head samples, we observed a strong female bias in mRNA levels of AstC , Tk , and NPF in the gut. To determine whether this sex-biased regulation was physiologically significant, we monitored triglyceride levels in flies with gut-specific knock-down of EE cell-derived hormones. In 5-day-old flies, knock-down of EE cell-derived AstC significantly reduced fat storage in females with no effect in males, whereas knock-down of EE cell-derived Tk produced a non-significant trend toward reduced fat storage in females. These female-specific effects on fat storage were reproduced in flies with neuron-specific knock-down of the AstC ( AstC-R2 ) and Tk receptors ( TkR99D ). Together, these data uncover strongly sex-biased regulation of EE cell-derived hormones and show that gut-specific knock-down of at least one of these hormones had a female-specific effect on body fat.
items.title_zh: 性别偏向的肠内分泌细胞激素表达影响果蝇雌性脂肪储存
items.summary_zh: 果蝇肠道中的肠内分泌（EE）细胞产生并释放多种因子，包括Allatostatin A（AstA）、Allatostatin C（AstC）、神经肽F（NPF）、速激肽（Tk）、利尿激素31（Dh31）等。这些肽在调节脂肪储存和流体平衡等生理功能及进食和睡眠等行为方面与环境因素相协调。尽管生理和行为上存在显著的性别差异，但EE细胞来源因子的调控和功能是否在雌雄之间共享尚不明确。研究发现，AstC、Tk和NPF在雌性果蝇肠道中的mRNA水平表现出强烈的雌性偏向。通过监测特定敲低EE细胞激素的果蝇三酸甘油脂水平，发现5天龄雌性果蝇中AstC的敲低显著减少脂肪储存，而对雄性果蝇没有影响。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，果蝇雌性肠内分泌细胞激素的性别偏向显著影响其脂肪储存，特别是AstC在雌性果蝇中对脂肪储存的调节作用明显。
items.l2_summary:
研究表明，果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）肠道中的肠内分泌（EE）细胞产生并释放多种激素，包括Allatostatin A（AstA）、Allatostatin C（AstC）、神经肽F（NPF）、速激肽（Tk）和利尿激素31（Dh31）等，这些激素在调节脂肪储存、流体平衡以及进食和睡眠等行为方面发挥重要作用，并与环境因素相互协调。尽管在生理和行为上，雌雄果蝇存在显著差异，但EE细胞来源因子的调控和功能是否在雌雄之间共享仍不明确。

研究发现，AstC、Tk和NPF在雌性果蝇肠道中的mRNA水平表现出明显的雌性偏向，表明这些激素在雌性果蝇中可能具有更为重要的生理功能。为了探讨这些激素对脂肪储存的影响，研究者对特定的EE细胞激素进行了敲低实验，监测了果蝇的三酸甘油脂水平。结果显示，在5天龄的雌性果蝇中，AstC的敲低显著减少了脂肪储存，而对雄性果蝇则没有观察到类似的影响。这一发现表明，雌性果蝇的脂肪储存受到AstC等激素的显著调控，而雄性果蝇则可能依赖于其他机制或激素来维持脂肪储存的平衡。

综上所述，该研究揭示了性别偏向的EE细胞激素表达在果蝇雌性脂肪储存中的关键作用，强调了性别在生理调节中的重要性，为进一步理解性别差异在生物体内的生理功能提供了新的视角。

items.title: Genome-wide discovery of cis- regulatory elements in a large genome
items.abstract: Identifying cis- regulatory elements typically relies on trial and error to test the activity of DNA fragments using reporter constructs. This approach is particularly challenging in large eukaryotic genomes, where cis- regulatory elements can be dispersed over long distances, separated by large stretches of non-functional DNA. Here, we generate two types of resources that can be used to narrow the search for such elements in the 3.6 Gbp genome of Parhyale hawaiensis . First, we use bulk ATAC-seq to uncover genome-wide patterns of chromatin accessibility in Parhyale embryonic and adult tissues, and single-nucleus ATAC-seq to identify regions of open chromatin in diverse cell types. Second, by sequencing the genomes of three congeneric species – P. darvishi , P. aquilina , and P. plumicornis – we identify islands of sequence conservation across the genome, likely corresponding to functionally constrained DNA. We find that low-coverage (10–15×) short-read genome sequencing, without genome assembly, is sufficient to provide reliable maps of sequence conservation. This approach cuts the cost and labour required to generate these maps, making the identification of cis- regulatory elements more widely accessible. We demonstrate the utility of these resources by identifying cis- regulatory elements that drive robust expression of fluorescent reporters ubiquitously and in specific cell types.
items.summary_zh: 识别顺式调控元件通常依赖于试错法，通过报告构建体测试DNA片段的活性。在大型真核基因组中，这一方法尤其具有挑战性，因为顺式调控元件可能分散在长距离内，且被大量非功能DNA隔开。本文生成了两种资源，以缩小在3.6 Gbp的夏威夷海洋小虾基因组中寻找这些元件的范围。首先，利用大规模ATAC-seq揭示了夏威夷海洋小虾胚胎和成体组织的全基因组染色质可及性模式，并通过单细胞核ATAC-seq识别了多种细胞类型中开放的染色质区域。其次，通过测序三种同属物种的基因组，识别出基因组中序列保守的岛屿，可能对应于功能受限的DNA。我们发现低覆盖率（10-15×）的短读长基因组测序，无需基因组组装，足以提供可靠的序列保守图谱。这种方法降低了生成这些图谱所需的成本和劳动，使得顺式调控元件的识别更加广泛可及。我们通过识别驱动荧光报告基因在特定细胞和普遍表达的顺式调控元件，展示了这些资源的实用性。
items.title_zh: 大基因组中顺式调控元件的全基因组发现
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过低覆盖率短读长基因组测序和ATAC-seq技术，简化了在大型真核基因组中识别顺式调控元件的过程，提高了识别的效率和可及性。
items.l2_summary:
在大基因组中识别顺式调控元件（cis-regulatory elements）通常依赖于试错法，通过构建报告体测试DNA片段的活性。然而，在大型真核基因组中，这一方法面临诸多挑战，尤其是顺式调控元件可能分散在长距离内，并被大量非功能DNA隔开。为了解决这一问题，研究团队生成了两种资源，以缩小在3.6 Gbp的夏威夷海洋小虾基因组中寻找这些元件的范围。首先，研究利用大规模ATAC-seq（Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing）技术揭示了夏威夷海洋小虾胚胎和成体组织的全基因组染色质可及性模式，并通过单细胞核ATAC-seq识别了多种细胞类型中开放的染色质区域。这一过程为顺式调控元件的定位提供了重要的基础数据。

其次，研究团队通过测序三种同属物种的基因组，识别出基因组中序列保守的岛屿，这些岛屿可能对应于功能受限的DNA。研究发现，低覆盖率（10-15×）的短读长基因组测序，无需进行基因组组装，便足以提供可靠的序列保守图谱。这种方法不仅降低了生成这些图谱所需的成本和劳动，还使得顺式调控元件的识别变得更加广泛可及。

通过识别驱动荧光报告基因在特定细胞和普遍表达的顺式调控元件，研究展示了这些资源的实用性。这些发现为未来在复杂基因组中识别和研究顺式调控元件提供了新的思路和方法，具有重要的科学价值和应用潜力。

items.title: A cortical–hippocampal communication undergoes rebalancing after new learning
items.abstract: The brain’s ability to consolidate a wide range of memories while maintaining their distinctiveness across experiences remains poorly understood. Sharp-wave ripples, neural oscillations that occur predominantly within CA1 of the hippocampus during immobility and sleep, have been shown to play a critical role in the consolidation process. More recently, evidence has uncovered functional heterogeneity of pyramidal neurons within distinct sublayers of CA1 that display unique properties during ripples, potentially contributing to memory specificity. Despite this, it remains unclear exactly how ripples shift the activity of CA1 neuronal populations to accommodate the consolidation of specific memories and how sublayer differences manifest. Here, we studied interactions between the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and CA1 neurons during ripples and discovered a reorganization of their communication following learning. Specifically, using a generalized linear model decoder, we demonstrated the pre-existence of ACC-to-CA1 communication, which is weakened during post-training sleep following learning, suggesting that ACC activity reallocates the contribution of CA1 neurons during memory formation. Interestingly, the reorganization appeared unique for a subset of CA1 superficial (CA1sup) neurons that were task inactive, whereas communication between the ACC and CA1deep neurons remained largely stable across pre- and post-training sleep. Consistent with this sublayer-selective reorganization, we found that optogenetic stimulations of the ACC preferentially suppressed CA1sup neurons while activating a unique subset of CA1 interneurons. Overall, these findings highlight an important role of the ACC in rebalancing CA1 neuronal populations’ contribution in learning and memory consolidation.
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了前扣带皮层（ACC）与海马CA1区神经元在波动期间的相互作用，发现学习后其沟通方式发生重组。我们使用广义线性模型解码器，证明了ACC与CA1之间的沟通在学习后训练睡眠期间减弱，表明ACC活动在记忆形成过程中重新分配了CA1神经元的贡献。值得注意的是，这种重组现象在一部分任务不活跃的CA1浅层（CA1sup）神经元中表现得尤为明显，而ACC与CA1深层（CA1deep）神经元之间的沟通则保持不变。这些发现为理解记忆巩固过程中神经元活动的动态变化提供了新视角。
items.title_zh: 新学习后皮层-海马沟通的重组现象
items.l1_lead: 本研究发现，学习后前扣带皮层与海马CA1区的沟通方式发生重组，特别是在记忆形成过程中ACC活动重新分配了CA1浅层神经元的贡献。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了前扣带皮层（ACC）与海马CA1区神经元在波动期间的相互作用，揭示了学习后其沟通方式的重组现象。研究采用广义线性模型解码器，分析了ACC与CA1之间的沟通强度，结果显示在学习后训练睡眠期间，ACC与CA1的沟通显著减弱。这一发现表明，ACC的活动在记忆形成过程中重新分配了CA1神经元的贡献，暗示着ACC在记忆巩固中的重要作用。

特别值得注意的是，这种重组现象在CA1浅层（CA1sup）神经元中表现得尤为明显，而ACC与CA1深层（CA1deep）神经元之间的沟通则保持不变。这一结果提示，CA1区的不同层次神经元在学习后可能承担了不同的功能角色，ACC的活动可能更倾向于调节浅层神经元的贡献，从而影响记忆的巩固过程。

通过这些发现，研究为理解记忆巩固过程中神经元活动的动态变化提供了新的视角，强调了ACC与CA1之间的相互作用在学习和记忆形成中的重要性。这一研究不仅丰富了我们对记忆机制的理解，也为未来相关领域的研究提供了新的思路和方向。

items.title: Learning is a fundamental source of individuality
items.abstract: Learning and memory are essential components of our individuality. While it is established that behaviour can vary across genetically identical individuals, it remains unknown how much of this variation stems from momentary experience during learning compared to genetics and its past interactions with the environment. To address this, we measured behaviour in thousands of flies from 90 genetic backgrounds while they performed tasks in conditions that either did or did not require learning. Flies that were genetically identical, raised under the same conditions, and tested simultaneously in the same environment persistently modified the extent of expressed individuality when they could learn. This learning-induced residual expression of individuality and its dynamics were subdued or absent in innate, learning-independent behaviours. We could quantify and then recreate this phenomenon in computer simulations. The emergence of in silico behaviour individuality was most consistent with the individuality of real flies once we enabled reinforced learning in simulated agents. Moreover, we showed that minor differences in initial conditions of the experiment can exacerbate the expression of individuality within a genotype in a learning-dependent manner. Our results establish that besides the classical genotype × environment (G × E) interactions shared between individuals in the past, learning from individual momentary experience further extends the expression of individuality.

items.title: Zinc is a key regulator of the sperm-specific K + channel (Slo3) function
items.abstract: The voltage- and pH-gated Slo3 potassium channel is exclusively expressed in mammalian spermatozoa. Its sensitivity to both voltage and alkalization plays a crucial role in sperm fertility, which is tightly coupled to the capacitation process. Here, we show that sperm-enriched divalent cation Zn 2+ undergoes dynamic alteration in spermatozoa during capacitation. We also found that intracellular Zn 2+ regulates alkalinization-induced hyperpolarization in mouse spermatozoa, which is mediated by the Slo3 channel. Further examination of zinc regulation in mouse Slo3 (mSlo3) revealed that, in the Xenopus oocyte expression system , intracellular zinc directly inhibits mouse Slo3 currents in a dose-dependent manner at micromolar concentrations, with exceptionally slow dissociation. By combining MD simulations and electrophysiology, we also identified amino acid residues contributing to the Zn 2+ slow dissociation from Slo3 channels. Our studies uncover the importance of intracellular zinc dynamics and its regulatory role in ion channels during sperm capacitation.

items.title: Gβγ engages PLCβ3 at multiple sites to reorient and facilitate its activation
items.abstract: Phospholipase C β (PLCβ) enzymes are activated by heterotrimeric G protein subunits, increasing hydrolysis of phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2) at the plasma membrane. All four human PLCβ isoforms (PLCβ1–4) are activated by Gα q , whereas PLCβ1–3 are activated to varying extents by Gβγ. The binding sites for Gα q on PLCβ are well established, and much has been learned about its mechanism of activation, but comparatively little is known about Gβγ-dependent activation. In this work, we used cryo-electron microscopy single-particle analysis, functional assays, and bioluminescence resonance energy transfer to investigate how Gβγ interacts with PLCβ3 in concert with activated Gα q to regulate phospholipase activity. Gβγ heterodimers bind multiple surfaces of PLCβ3 to promote activation, but alone do not recruit the enzyme to the plasma membrane. Instead, Gβγ facilitates activation by Gα q , most likely by reorienting the phospholipase catalytic site at the membrane to maximize PI(4,5)P2 hydrolysis and downstream Ca 2+ release. Cell-based functional assays demonstrate that Gβγ is required for maximal PLCβ3 activation, even when G q heterotrimers are the sole source of Gβγ. Together, these findings demonstrate that Gβγ acts as a critical positive allosteric modulator that regularly acts in concert with Gα q to activate PLCβ3 at the plasma membrane.

items.title: Biophysically inspired mean-field model of neuronal populations driven by ion-exchange mechanisms
items.abstract: Whole-brain simulations are a valuable tool for gaining insight into the multiscale processes that regulate brain activity. Due to the complexity of the brain, it is impractical to include all microscopic details in a simulation. Hence, researchers often simulate the brain as a network of coupled neural masses, each described by a mean-field model. These models capture the essential features of neuronal populations while approximating most biophysical details. However, it may be important to include certain parameters that significantly impact brain function. The concentration of ions in the extracellular space is one key factor to consider, as its fluctuations can be associated with healthy and pathological brain states. In this paper, we develop a new mean-field model of a population of Hodgkin–Huxley-type neurons, retaining a microscopic perspective on the ion-exchange mechanisms driving neuronal activity. This allows us to maintain biophysical interpretability while bridging the gap between micro- and macro-scale mechanisms. Our model is able to reproduce a wide range of activity patterns, also observed in large neural network simulations. Specifically, slow-changing ion concentrations modulate the fast neuroelectric activity, a feature of our model that we validated through in vitro experiments. By studying how changes in extracellular ionic conditions can affect whole-brain dynamics, this model serves as a foundation to measure biomarkers of pathological activity and provide potential therapeutic targets in cases of brain dysfunctions like epilepsy.
items.summary_zh: 全脑模拟是理解调节脑活动的多尺度过程的重要工具。由于大脑的复杂性，模拟中难以包含所有微观细节，因此研究者通常将大脑视为由耦合神经团组成的网络，每个神经团用均场模型描述。本文开发了一种新的霍奇金-赫克斯利型神经元群体均场模型，关注驱动神经活动的离子交换机制，保持生物物理可解释性。我们的模型能够再现广泛的活动模式，特别是慢变的离子浓度调节快速的神经电活动，这一特征通过体外实验得到了验证。研究表明，细胞外离子条件的变化对整体脑活动有显著影响。
items.title_zh: 基于生物物理的神经元群体均场模型研究
items.l1_lead: 研究开发的新型神经元群体均场模型揭示了细胞外离子浓度变化对脑活动的显著影响，强调了生物物理机制在调节神经活动中的重要性。
items.l2_summary: 全脑模拟是理解调节脑活动的多尺度过程的重要工具，但由于大脑的复杂性，研究者在模拟中往往难以包含所有微观细节。因此，通常将大脑视为由耦合神经团组成的网络，每个神经团用均场模型（mean-field model）进行描述。本文开发了一种新的霍奇金-赫克斯利型（Hodgkin-Huxley type）神经元群体均场模型，重点关注驱动神经活动的离子交换机制，并保持生物物理可解释性。该模型能够再现广泛的神经活动模式，尤其是慢变的离子浓度对快速神经电活动的调节能力，这一特征通过体外实验得到了验证。研究结果表明，细胞外离子条件的变化对整体脑活动有显著影响，强调了离子交换在神经元群体活动中的关键作用。这一发现为理解大脑的动态调节机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的神经科学研究和临床应用奠定基础。

items.title: From East to West – an early-career researcher’s voyage across continents
items.abstract: One scholarship can open a research career. It can also start a years-long negotiation with loneliness, ambiguous job titles, and the quiet arithmetic of underfunded postdoctoral life. Early-career researchers who have made the journey from West Africa to East Germany and on to Western Canada describe what rarely makes it into the acceptance letter, and what institutions on both sides of the Atlantic could do differently.

items.title: Single-cell spatial mapping reveals reproducible cell type organization and spatially dependent gene expression in gastruloids
items.abstract: Gastruloids are stem-cell-based models that recapitulate key aspects of mammalian gastrulation, including the formation of an anterior-posterior axis. However, we do not have detailed spatial information about gene expression and cell type organization, particularly at the level of individual gastruloids. Here, we report a spatially resolved, single-cell molecular catalog of the transcriptomes of 26 individual gastruloids. We found that cell type composition and tissue-scale spatial organization were largely consistent across gastruloids, but meso-scale patterning of specific cell types varied between samples. Posterior cell types formed distinct, organized clusters, while anterior cell types were more disorganized. To distinguish progressive differentiation from cell type differences, we developed the L-score, a parameter-free quantification of mutually exclusive gene expression. This analysis revealed spatial organization without explicit encoding, recapitulated known cell type relationships, and identified novel gene expression states and spatial subclusters within cell types. We confirmed that in gastruloids, neuromesodermal precursor differentiation occurred through a continuous, spatially coordinated process. We also showed that endothelial precursors exhibited unique spatial organization and had distinct gene expression profiles dependent on their association with anterior somitic or posterior endodermal tissues. This work enables the rigorous use of gastruloids as models for studying the molecular mechanisms underlying mammalian development and tissue organization and introduces new computational tools for analyzing spatially resolved single-cell datasets.
items.summary_zh: 胚胎样体是基于干细胞的模型，重现了哺乳动物胚胎发育的关键方面，包括前后轴的形成。然而，我们缺乏关于基因表达和细胞类型组织的详细空间信息，尤其是在单个胚胎样体的层面上。本文报告了26个单独胚胎样体的空间分辨单细胞转录组分子目录。研究发现，细胞类型组成和组织尺度的空间组织在胚胎样体之间大体一致，但特定细胞类型的中尺度模式在样本间存在差异。后部细胞类型形成了明显的、有序的簇，而前部细胞类型则较为无序。为区分渐进分化与细胞类型差异，我们开发了L-score，这是一种无参数的互斥基因表达量化方法。分析揭示了空间组织的存在，重现了已知的细胞类型关系，并识别了细胞类型内的新基因表达状态和空间亚簇。我们确认在胚胎样体中，神经中胚层前体的分化是通过连续的、空间协调的过程进行的，并显示内皮前体具有独特的空间组织和依赖于其与前部细胞的关联的不同基因表达谱。
items.title_zh: 单细胞空间映射揭示胚胎样体中细胞类型组织与基因表达的空间依赖性
items.l1_lead: 研究揭示胚胎样体中细胞类型的空间组织与基因表达存在依赖性，特定细胞类型在样本间表现出中尺度模式差异，且神经中胚层前体的分化过程具有空间协调性。
items.l2_summary:
胚胎样体是基于干细胞的模型，能够重现哺乳动物胚胎发育的关键过程，尤其是前后轴的形成。然而，关于基因表达和细胞类型组织的详细空间信息仍然不足，特别是在单个胚胎样体的层面上。为了解决这一问题，本文对26个单独的胚胎样体进行了空间分辨的单细胞转录组（single-cell transcriptome）分析，构建了分子目录。研究结果显示，尽管胚胎样体之间的细胞类型组成和组织尺度在整体上保持一致，但特定细胞类型的中尺度空间模式却存在显著差异。具体而言，后部细胞类型形成了明显且有序的簇，而前部细胞类型则表现出较为无序的分布。

为了更好地区分渐进分化与细胞类型差异，研究团队开发了一种名为L-score的无参数互斥基因表达量化方法。通过这一方法的分析，研究揭示了胚胎样体中细胞的空间组织特征，重现了已知的细胞类型关系，并识别出细胞类型内部的新基因表达状态及其空间亚簇。特别地，研究确认了神经中胚层前体的分化过程是通过连续且空间协调的机制进行的。此外，内皮前体显示出独特的空间组织特征，其基因表达谱也依赖于与前部细胞的相互关系。这些发现为理解胚胎样体的发育过程提供了新的视角，强调了空间依赖性在细胞类型组织和基因表达中的重要性。

items.title: PKD2L1 channels segregated to the apical compartment are the dual-mode pH sensor in cerebrospinal fluid-contacting neurons
items.abstract: Cerebrospinal fluid-contacting neurons (CSFcNs) are GABAergic cells that surround the central canal (cc) of the spinal cord. Their soma is located sub-ependymally and they have a dendritic-like process that ends as a bulb (the so-called ‘apical process’; ApPr) inside the cc. It remains unclear how this unique anatomical organization, with the soma and the ApPr located in different extracellular environments, relates to their function as a multimodal sensor of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) composition. One of the main physiological features of CSFcNs is a prominent spontaneous electrical activity mediated by PKD2L1 channels, a non-selective cation channel of the TRP family. PKD2L1 channels have a high single-channel conductance (around 200 pS) and can be modulated by protons and mechanical forces. In this work, we investigate PKD2L1 channel sensitivity to pH and its effects on CSFcNs excitability. We demonstrate that PKD2L1 spontaneous activity generates not only phasic inward currents, but also a sustained current, both of which are modulated bidirectionally by pH with a high sensitivity around physiological values. By combining electrophysiology (direct recordings from intact and isolated ApPrs) with optical methods (laser photolysis of protons), we further show that functional PKD2L1 channels are specifically localized in the ApPr. The spatial segregation of PKD2L1 channels, along with their biophysical properties (high single-channel conductance and pH sensitivity) and the ApPr’s unique membrane properties (very high input resistance), renders CSFcN excitability exquisitely sensitive to PKD2L1 modulation. Altogether, our findings illustrate how the ApPr’s properties are finely tuned to support its sensory role.

items.title: A real-time, multi-animal model for automatic face detection and identification of freely moving common marmosets based on YOLOv8 algorithms
items.abstract: Precise and up-to-date information about animal location and identity allows us to better quantify individual behaviors in studies of neural activity, cognition, and animal health. In socially housed laboratory animals, identification is usually defined by observation or invasive markers, making the data collection time-consuming, variable across experimenters, and disruptive to animals. We established an automatic pipeline for real-time identification of common marmosets in captivity using a close-view camera. It uses the supervised deep-learning YOLOv8 model to localize individuals, detect faces, and classify identities. Moreover, we use recognition of uniquely color-coded collar beads to improve detection accuracy among visually similar individuals. Across adult and juvenile marmosets, our system automatically identifies marmosets with 82.9% precision and 91.5% recall, achieving human-level performance. This pipeline is designed to be easy to use and generalizable across non-human primate species, ages, and recording hardware, providing rapid and automatic identity recognition from real-time video.

items.title: Dissociable roles of reward prediction error in the contrasting mood dynamics of depression and anxiety
items.abstract: Mood fluctuations, central to human experience, are profoundly influenced by reward prediction errors (RPE). Although depression and anxiety traditionally exhibit contrasting mood fluctuations, their interrelated nature has made it challenging to pinpoint their specific roles in RPE-induced mood variations. In this study, we employed a computational model of momentary mood within a gambling task, involving 2043 participants across five experiments. Participants also completed a battery of questionnaires designed to allow us to dissociate anxiety- and depression-specific traits through bifactor modeling. Results showed that depression was associated with dampened mood fluctuations due to mood hyposensitivity to RPE. Importantly, this pattern was also found in patients with affective disorders. In contrast, anxiety correlated with heightened mood fluctuations stemming from mood hypersensitivity to RPE in non-clinical participants. Moreover, the shared depression/anxiety component was linked to lower affective baseline and greater risk aversion. Collectively, our results uncover computational dissociation of depression vs. anxiety using RPE-based mood modeling and present multi-dimensional computational signatures for these symptoms, with clinical relevance for management of mood disorders.

items.title: Tau hyperphosphorylation impairs cooperative binding to microtubules and perturbs organelle trafficking in neurons
items.abstract: Tau, a neuronal microtubule-associated protein (MAP), organizes the axonal cytoskeleton, and regulates intracellular transport. Tau hyperphosphorylation is linked to neurodegeneration in tauopathies, including Alzheimer’s disease. Tau binds microtubules cooperatively to form cohesive envelopes, which are thought to control access to the microtubule lattice and regulate the activity of motor proteins and other MAPs. However, how disease-related perturbations affect tau dynamics and its function as a selective barrier to intracellular transport remains unclear. Using tau phospho-variants in vitro and in live neurons, we show that tau hyperphosphorylation disrupts cooperative microtubule binding and dysregulates lysosome transport. Hyperphosphorylated tau does not form envelopes, distributes more uniformly along the axon, and dissociates faster from microtubules. Tau weakly inhibits KIF5C motility, but strongly inhibits KIF1A. Hyperphosphorylation reduces KIF5C inhibition but increases KIF1A inhibition by decreasing processivity and accelerating detachment. Consistent with these effects, hyperphosphorylated tau alters lysosome transport in neurons. While phospho-resistant tau inhibits processive lysosome motility, hyperphosphorylated tau weakens tau-mediated regulation of lysosome transport, mimicking tau knockout neurons that exhibit enhanced processivity. Altogether, these findings show that hyperphosphorylation disrupts tau envelopes and impairs lysosome trafficking, likely contributing to early defects in degradative pathways that drive neurodegeneration.
items.summary_zh: Tau是一种神经元微管相关蛋白，负责组织轴突细胞骨架和调节细胞内运输。Tau的超磷酸化与阿尔茨海默病等tau病相关的神经退行性疾病有关。研究表明，超磷酸化的Tau破坏了其与微管的协同结合，导致溶酶体运输失调。超磷酸化的Tau不形成包膜，沿轴突分布更均匀，并且从微管上解离的速度更快。超磷酸化的Tau对KIF5C的运动抑制较弱，但对KIF1A的抑制较强。超磷酸化降低了KIF5C的抑制作用，但通过降低过程性和加速脱离增加了对KIF1A的抑制。超磷酸化的Tau改变了神经元中的溶酶体运输，表现出与Tau缺失神经元相似的增强过程性。
items.title_zh: Tau超磷酸化影响微管结合及细胞器运输
items.l1_lead: 超磷酸化的Tau蛋白破坏微管结合，导致溶酶体运输失调，并改变神经元内的运输特性。
items.l2_summary:
Tau蛋白是一种重要的神经元微管相关蛋白，主要负责组织轴突细胞骨架并调节细胞内的运输功能。然而，Tau的超磷酸化与阿尔茨海默病等tau病相关的神经退行性疾病密切相关。研究发现，超磷酸化的Tau会破坏其与微管的协同结合能力，导致溶酶体的运输出现失调。具体而言，超磷酸化的Tau在细胞内不再形成包膜，沿轴突的分布变得更加均匀，同时从微管上解离的速度也显著加快。

在对细胞内运输的影响方面，超磷酸化的Tau对运动蛋白KIF5C的抑制作用较弱，但对KIF1A的抑制作用则相对较强。这一现象表明，超磷酸化的Tau通过降低KIF5C的抑制作用，同时加速KIF1A的脱离，从而增强了对KIF1A的抑制效果。研究结果显示，超磷酸化的Tau改变了神经元中的溶酶体运输，表现出与Tau缺失的神经元相似的增强过程性。这些发现为理解Tau超磷酸化在神经退行性疾病中的作用提供了新的视角，揭示了其在细胞内运输机制中的重要性。

items.title: Selective lifelong suppression of an odor processing channel in response to critical period experience
items.abstract: Sensory circuits undergo experience-dependent plasticity during early-life critical periods, attuning the nervous system to levels of key environmental stimuli. During a critical period in the Drosophila olfactory system, we found that exposure to ethyl butyrate (EB) induces glial phagocytosis of odorant receptor Or42a-positive olfactory sensory neuron (OSN) axon terminals which terminate in the VM7 glomerulus (Leier et al., 2025).
