Results Eighty-seven patients received 137 PNPs during the study period. The average overall liking score was 5.7 ({+/-}2.1) on a 1-9 scale, and median consumption rate was 51% [Interquartile Range 19-100]. Consumption rates positively correlated with overall liking (R2 = 0.50, p < 0.001). Patients' willingness to reorder was 3.5 ({+/-}2.3) on a 1-7 scale, and reorder rate 63%. The perceived value of a PNP service in a hospital setting (scale 1-7) was scored 5.3 ({+/-}1.7) by patients and 4.5 ({+/-}1.1) by staff. Conclusions PNPs were evaluated as moderately positive in terms of acceptability and value by both patients and staff. However, further optimization of the product is needed before evaluating clinical efficacy.
items.authors: Melchers, M.; van der Haar, S.; Hoevenaars, F. P.; Wopereis, S.; Ummels, M.; van Bokhoven, K.; Hoppenbrouwers, M.; Rijfers, A.; Menkveld, M.; Noort, M. W.; van Zanten, A. R.; Kouw, I. W.
items.title_zh: 医院环境中的个性化营养产品接受性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：个性化营养有潜力通过适应个体饮食需求和偏好来改善住院患者的营养摄入和临床结果。本研究旨在评估住院患者及医院工作人员对个性化营养产品（PNP）的接受性。方法：在住院成年患者中进行了一项为期十天的前瞻性概念验证研究。患者接受了根据个人口味偏好和健康状况定制的3D打印PNP。患者在住院超过24小时后可每日重新订购。通过称重PNP在消费前后的变化来评估消费情况。使用问卷评估接受性、感官反馈和整体体验。医院工作人员也评估了感官反馈和接受性。结果：87名患者在研究期间共接受了137个PNP，整体喜好评分平均为5.7（±2.1），中位消费率为51%[四分位范围19-100]。

items.title: Maternal age-related differences in the timing of pregnancy loss in a nationwide ART cohort
items.abstract: Study question: Are maternal age and a history of previous pregnancy losses associated with the timing of pregnancy loss for women undergoing ART treatment? Summary answer: Among women who underwent ART treatment, younger women had a higher risk of very early biochemical pregnancy losses. Women with previous pregnancy losses overall experienced pregnancy losses at an earlier gestational age. What is known already: Maternal age and history of pregnancy loss are two of the strongest, independent determinants of pregnancy loss risk. Study design, size, duration: This retrospective cohort study comprises all embryo transfers in Sweden between 2007 and 2022 (n = 202,008). The Swedish Quality Register for Assisted Reproduction (Q-IVF) provides information on confirmed pregnancies from two weeks after embryo transfer. Additional information was retrieved from the Swedish Medical Birth Register and the National Patient Register. Participants/materials, setting, methods: We studied 202,008 embryo transfers resulting in 80,673 biochemically verified pregnancies and 21,240 pregnancy losses. We assessed the associations between two exposures (maternal age and history of pregnancy loss) and four outcomes (implantation failure, pregnancy loss, the proportion of pregnancy losses occurring within the biochemical pregnancy window, and the gestational duration when the pregnancy loss was diagnosed). Fixed and mixed linear and logistic regression models were used, the latter to account for unmeasured confounding shared across pregnancies from the same mothers. Through analyses of subgroups including oocyte recipients (n = 3,558) and women undergoing treatment due to male infertility (n = 41,721), we attempted to tease out the effects of potential unmeasured confounders, such as maternal oocyte aneuploidies. Main results and the role of chance: Mean maternal age was 34 years, 23 % had a history of pregnancy loss, implantation failure occurred after 60 % of embryo transfers and pregnancy loss occurred in 26 % after successful implantation. Higher maternal age was associated with increased risk of implantation failure (OR = 1.02 per year; 95% CI = 1.02, 1.02), and pregnancy loss after successful implantation (OR = 1.05 per year; 95% CI = 1.05, 1.06). We observed no relationship between maternal age and the risk of implantation failure or pregnancy loss among women undergoing ART with donated oocytes. Among those who experienced pregnancy loss, the proportion of pregnancy losses within the biochemical window decreased with increasing maternal age (OR = 0.94 per year; 95% CI = 0.93, 0.94), a result consistent across all subgroups and regardless of oocyte origin. The number of previous pregnancy losses was associated with a lower risk of implantation failure (OR = 0.82; 95% CI = 0.81, 0.84), but not with pregnancy loss in the index pregnancy after accounting for within-women correlations using mixed-effects models (OR = 1.02; 95% CI= 0.99, 1.04). Limitations, reasons for caution: Since all women studied underwent ART treatment, the findings may not apply to naturally conceived pregnancies. The gestational duration of pregnancy losses reflects the time at diagnosis, and thus is an upper bound for the pregnancy loss. Wider implications of the findings: This study confirms (oocyte) maternal age and history of pregnancy loss as influential in risk of implantation failure and pregnancy loss, and suggests that maternal age may delay the timing of the pregnancy loss, particularly among pregnancy losses occurring within the biochemical pregnancy window.
items.authors: Evers, F.; Ytterberg, K.; Ramirez-Jimenez, A. R.; Zhao, Y.; Nyeboe, P.; Magnus, M. C.; Juodakis, J.; Jacobsson, B.; Sole-Navais, P.
items.title_zh: 母龄对全国ART队列妊娠丧失时机的影响
items.summary_zh: 研究问题：母龄及既往妊娠丧失史是否与接受ART治疗女性的妊娠丧失时机相关？总结回答：在接受ART治疗的女性中，年轻女性面临更高的早期生化妊娠丧失风险。总体而言，既往有妊娠丧失史的女性在更早的妊娠周数经历妊娠丧失。已知信息：母龄和妊娠丧失史是妊娠丧失风险的两个最强独立决定因素。研究设计：本回顾性队列研究涵盖2007至2022年间瑞典的所有胚胎移植（n = 202,008）。瑞典辅助生殖质量注册（Q-IVF）提供了胚胎移植后两周确认妊娠的信息。研究对象为202,008次胚胎移植，结果为80,673例生化妊娠和21,240例妊娠丧失。我们评估了母龄和妊娠丧失史与妊娠丧失等四个结果之间的关联。

items.title: Resection of highly functionally connected glioma regions predicts long-term cognitive preservation
items.abstract: Background. Glioma surgery requires balancing maximal tumor resection against preservation of neurological and cognitive function. Intraoperative direct electrical stimulation guides this balance but is invasive and not always feasible. Preoperative magnetoencephalography (MEG) can identify tumor regions with high functional connectivity (HFC) to the rest of the brain. These HFC areas contain more malignant glioma cells and relate to poorer short-term outcome when resected. We aimed to determine whether HFC voxel resection relates to postoperative neurological and cognitive outcomes. Methods. In this preregistered analysis, 54 adults with diffuse glioma underwent resting-state MEG before resection. Imaginary coherence identified voxels with significantly higher connectivity against their contralateral controls, and these HFC voxels within the resection cavity were counted. Neurological status was assessed at short-term (~1 week) and long-term (~1 year) follow-up, and neuropsychological assessment took place at baseline and long-term follow-up. Logistic regressions related resected HFC voxels to decline at each timepoint, adjusting for Karnofsky performance status, sex and resectability index. Results. Resected HFC voxels were not associated with neurological decline at short-term (48% declined; odds ratio [OR] 0.98, P = .50) or long-term follow-up (27% declined; OR 0.99). For cognition, more resected HFC voxels were associated with less long-term decline (48% declined; OR 0.85, P = .02); a binarized analysis was consistent (OR 0.076, P = .01), indicating that tumor volume did not drive this result. Conclusions. Resecting more HFC voxels associates with preserved long-term cognition, without apparent neurological cost. Non-invasive MEG connectivity mapping may help optimize the onco-functional balance in glioma surgery.
items.authors: van Lingen, M. R.; Jaiswal, A.; Nagarajan, S.; Jayabal, V.; Klein, M.; Verburg, N.; de Witt Hamer, P.; Hillebrand, A.; Douw, L.

items.title: Temporal dynamics of grooming reciprocity in crested macaques: Strongly bonded individuals reciprocate grooming more quickly
items.abstract: Primates maintain cooperative relationships largely through grooming reciprocity, yet studies disagree on the timescales over which grooming is returned. Part of this disagreement stems from statistical issues: inconsistent definitions of a reciprocation window, combined with the exclusion of unreciprocated grooming, leave the debate unresolved. We still do not know if primates exchange grooming within the short windows predicted by biological market theory or over much longer timescales. Whilst survival analysis can identify reciprocation windows objectively by retaining unreciprocated grooming as censored data, previous studies have applied it inconsistently. This inconsistency leaves the true time frames over which primates reciprocate grooming somewhat blurred. Here, we use a statistical approach that addresses these problems to examine grooming reciprocity in crested macaques (Macaca nigra), a socially tolerant macaque species. We applied survival analysis to identify each group's short-term reciprocation window without imposing arbitrary cut offs, and Bayesian survival models to test whether social bond strength and eigenvector centrality predicted reciprocation latency. Short-term reciprocation occurred rarely (29% of events in one group and 5% in the other); most reciprocation occurred over longer timescales than previous research commonly assumes. Stronger bonds predicted faster reciprocation; this finding suggests that crested macaques express social investment in valued partners through how promptly they return grooming, meaning that the timing of exchange carries information about relationship value. Eigenvector centrality showed no credible effect, though our small sample size and dense groups prevent us from interpreting this outcome more robustly. Substantial variation between dyads remained unexplained, pointing to partnerspecific properties we have yet to identify. These findings caution against assuming that reciprocity operates over short windows. They show that social predictors, such as bond strength, remain essential to understanding when primates return grooming. This work provides a baseline for testing whether grooming is exchanged for other social commodities, and for comparing reciprocation timescales across macaque species that differ in social tolerance.
items.authors: Collins, L.; Gaston, A.; Kaminski, J.; Micheletta, J.; Joly, M.
items.title_zh: 冠猕猴梳理互惠的时间动态：紧密联系个体更快回报梳理
items.summary_zh: 灵长类动物通过梳理互惠维持合作关系，但关于梳理回报的时间尺度存在争议。这部分争议源于统计问题：互惠窗口的定义不一致，以及未回报梳理的排除，使得讨论未能解决。我们仍不清楚灵长类动物是否在生物市场理论预测的短时间窗口内交换梳理，还是在更长的时间尺度上。本文采用生存分析方法，客观识别冠猕猴（Macaca nigra）群体的短期互惠窗口，未强加任意截止点，并使用贝叶斯生存模型测试社会联系强度和特征向量中心性是否预测互惠延迟。短期互惠发生较少（一个群体29%的事件，另一个群体5%），大多数互惠发生在比以往研究常假设的更长时间尺度上。更强的社会联系预测了更快的回报。

items.title: Preoptic transcriptomes during courtship reveal the molecular basis of behavioral coordination in a highly social cichlid
items.abstract: Human and non-human animals often coordinate their behavior, a phenomenon thought to strengthen relationships by enabling sequential assessment of an interaction partners quality as a mate or rival, a process that directly affects evolutionary fitness. There is increasing evidence that behavioral coordination is reflected by synchronized neural activity of the on interacting partners, though few studies have examined synchronization at the level of gene expression. Here, we use Burtons Mouthbrooder cichlid, Astatotilapia burtoni, to examine how neural transcriptomes are synchronized while male-female pairs engaged in variable amounts of reproductive behavior. A. burtoni females naturally display highly coordinated reproductive behavior with a male partner only directly prior to spawning, yet this behavior can be experimentally induced with exogenous prostaglandin F2 alpha (PGF2a), which also acts by releasing pheromones to promote male courtship behavior. We quantified reproductive behavior and circulating sex steroid hormones of PGF2a-treated pairs. We then used transcriptome analysis of the preoptic area - a key node in the regulation of reproductive behavior across vertebrates - and identified gene co-expression modules that showed sex-specific activity in modulating reproductive behavior. Our results, which implement a novel approach to measure transcriptome synchronization, demonstrate a remarkable degree of male-female POA transcriptome synchronization that depends largely on the reproductive responsiveness of the female, mirroring how natural reproduction is driven by female behavior. Together, our work advances our understanding of the molecular mechanisms by which interacting individuals align their actions and how they experience social interaction.
items.authors: Miller-Crews, I.; Hofmann, H. A.
items.title_zh: 求偶期间前视区转录组揭示社交非洲慈鲷行为协调的分子基础
items.summary_zh: 人类和非人类动物常常协调行为，这一现象被认为有助于通过顺序评估互动伙伴的配偶或竞争者质量，从而增强关系。本文以巴顿口鲷（Astatotilapia burtoni）为研究对象，探讨在雄性与雌性配对进行不同程度的繁殖行为时，神经转录组如何同步。雌性在产卵前自然表现出高度协调的繁殖行为，但可通过外源性前列腺素F2α（PGF2a）诱导，该物质还通过释放信息素促进雄性求偶行为。我们量化了PGF2a处理配对的繁殖行为和循环性别类固醇激素。随后，我们对调节脊椎动物繁殖行为的关键节点——前视区进行转录组分析，识别出在调节繁殖行为中表现出性别特异性活性的基因共表达模块。我们的结果为转录组同步测量提供了新方法。

items.title: The GndA microprotein promotes cell growth during heat shock in Escherichia coli
items.abstract: Hundreds of bacterial small open reading frames (sORFs) encoding microproteins of fewer than fifty amino acids have recently been identified. Biological functions have been ascribed to an increasing number of microproteins, some of which play roles in bacterial stress responses. In this work, we provide evidence that GndA, a frameshifted 36-amino acid microprotein encoded in an internal open reading frame overlapping the 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase (6PGD) coding sequence (CDS), functions in the response to heat shock. We demonstrate independent contributions of GndA and 6PGD to cell growth at high temperature. GndA is hydrophobic and associates with the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex and respiratory complex I (RCI). Consistent with a role in cellular homeostasis, GndA mutations alter the transcriptional response to heat shock. These results demonstrate that GndA promotes bacterial cell growth at high temperature independently of the 6PGD protein that it overlaps. GndA thus expands the paradigm of bacterial microproteins that function in cellular stress responses.
items.authors: Mohsen, J. J.; Bertolotti, N. R.; Jiang, K.; Mohsen, M. G.; DeRosa, C. M.; Dewani, N.; Quinto, L.; Dabdoub, G.; Erkalo, B.; Landajuela, A.; Karatekin, E.; Isaacs, F. J.; Slavoff, S. A.
items.title_zh: GndA微蛋白在大肠杆菌热休克中促进细胞生长
items.summary_zh: 最近发现数百个编码少于50个氨基酸的细菌小开放阅读框（sORFs），其中一些微蛋白在细菌应对压力中发挥作用。本研究提供证据表明，GndA是一种由内部开放阅读框编码的36个氨基酸的框移微蛋白，参与热休克反应。我们证明了GndA和6-磷酸葡萄糖脱氢酶（6PGD）在高温下对细胞生长的独立贡献。GndA具有疏水性，并与丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体和呼吸复合体I（RCI）结合。GndA突变改变了对热休克的转录响应，表明其在细胞稳态中的作用。这些结果表明，GndA在高温下促进细菌细胞生长，与其重叠的6PGD蛋白无关，从而扩展了细菌微蛋白在细胞应激反应中的功能范式。

items.title: AtaA as a Self-Immobilizing Scaffold for Enzymatically Active Surfaces through Oxidative Tyrosine Coupling
items.abstract: Protein nanofibers hold great promise as genetically programmable scaffolds for constructing functional material interfaces. AtaA, a giant trimeric autotransporter adhesin from Acinetobacter sp. Tol 5, forms an elongated architecture from the bacterial cell surface, enabling the cells to adhere directly to a wide variety of abiotic surfaces. However, the potential use of AtaA as a scaffold with additional biological functions remains largely unexplored. In this study, we investigated the use of AtaA as a self-immobilizing scaffold for constructing enzymatically active surfaces via horseradish peroxidase (HRP)-catalyzed tyrosine coupling. We prepared a recombinant AtaA nanofiber fragment (NhNs-AtaA) and its derivative containing two tyrosine-containing loop structures (YL-NhNs-AtaA). Both recombinant proteins retained their adhesive properties. Treatment with HRP and H2O2 generated high-molecular-weight products from both proteins, and dityrosine fluorescence emission indicated the formation of tyrosine-derived covalent cross-links. Y-Loop insertion further increased the consumption of monomeric AtaA and promoted the formation of high-molecular-weight products. The removal of arginine, which was included during purification, further increased the loss of monomeric AtaA in both constructs, indicating that intermolecular protein association influenced productive AtaA cross-linking. NhNs-AtaA and YL-NhNs-AtaA were combined with Y-tagged bacterial alkaline phosphatase (BAP-Y). HRP-mediated coupling generated high-molecular-weight products consistent with the cross-linked AtaA-BAP-Y conjugates and enabled the retention of BAP activity on AtaA-coated surfaces without prior chemical modification. Although Y-Loop insertion enhanced polymerization in solution, it reduced AtaA adhesion and consequently lowered surface-bound phosphatase activity, revealing a trade-off between cross-linking reactivity and native adhesive function. These findings establish AtaA as a self-immobilizing protein nanofiber scaffold for constructing enzymatically active surfaces, and suggest the potential extension of this strategy to other AtaA-based interfaces.
items.authors: Yokoe, Y.; Yoshimoto, S.; Miniamihata, K.; Sugimoto, R.; Nagatani, A.; Nara, A.; Kamiya, N.; Hori, K.; Ishikawa, M.
items.title_zh: AtaA作为自我固定的酶活性表面支架研究
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质纳米纤维作为可遗传编程的支架在构建功能材料界面方面具有巨大潜力。本研究探讨了来自不动杆菌Tol 5的巨型三聚体自转运粘附素AtaA作为自我固定支架的应用，通过辣根过氧化物酶（HRP）催化酪氨酸偶联构建酶活性表面。我们制备了重组的AtaA纳米纤维片段（NhNs-AtaA）及其包含两个酪氨酸环结构的衍生物（YL-NhNs-AtaA）。两种重组蛋白均保留了粘附特性。HRP和H2O2处理后，产生了高分子量产物，二酪氨酸荧光发射表明形成了酪氨酸衍生的共价交联。Y-Loop的插入进一步增加了单体AtaA的消耗，并促进了高分子量产物的形成。去除在纯化过程中加入的精氨酸，进一步增加了两种构建体中单体AtaA的损失，表明分子间蛋白质相互作用影响了AtaA的有效交联。

items.title: Gag proteolysis drives HIV-1 envelope conformational closure through the gp41 cytoplasmic tail
items.abstract: HIV-1 must present a fusion-competent envelope glycoprotein (Env) to enter host cells while concealing the very conformation targeted by broadly neutralising antibodies (bnAbs). How the virus resolves this conflict has remained unclear. Using a minimally invasive nanobody-labelling strategy targeting Env's V4 loop, we combine single-virus FRET, fluorescence lifetime cross-correlation spectroscopy, and DNA-PAINT super-resolution microscopy to resolve Env conformation on individual, intact virions from the primary isolate JR-FL. We show that immature virions predominantly display an open Env conformation, while Gag maturation drives acquisition of the tightly closed, fusion-competent State 1 that harbours the principal bnAb epitope. Truncating the Env cytoplasmic tail abolishes this regulation, identifying the gp41 tail as the conduit linking Gag lattice maturation to Env's conformational fate. We further show that bnAb b12 preferentially binds open Env on immature virions, supporting a decoy mechanism that shields mature virions from immune recognition, with direct implications for HIV-1 vaccine design.
items.authors: Padilla-Parra, S.; Williamson, D. J.; Zaza, C.; Carlon-Andres, I.; Holmes, H.; Gentili, A.; Thrush, J.; Daly, J.; Keegan, M.; Doores, K. J.; Malinauskas, T.; Neil, S.; Malim, M. M.; Simoncelli, S.
items.title_zh: Gag蛋白水解驱动HIV-1包膜构象闭合
items.summary_zh: HIV-1需呈现具融合能力的包膜糖蛋白（Env）以进入宿主细胞，同时又需隐藏被广泛中和抗体（bnAbs）靶向的构象。我们采用一种针对Env V4环的微创纳抗体标记策略，结合单病毒FRET、荧光寿命交叉相关光谱和DNA-PAINT超分辨率显微镜，解析了来自初级分离株JR-FL的单个完整病毒颗粒上的Env构象。结果显示，未成熟病毒颗粒主要呈现开放的Env构象，而Gag成熟驱动获得紧闭的、具融合能力的状态1，该状态包含主要的bnAb表位。截断Env细胞质尾部则消除了这种调控，确定gp41尾部为连接Gag晶格成熟与Env构象命运的通道。此外，我们发现bnAb b12优先结合未成熟病毒的开放Env，支持了一种诱饵机制，保护成熟病毒免受免疫识别，对HIV-1疫苗设计具有直接影响。

items.title: Integrating cell-state and enhancer constraints discriminates models of PU.1 regulation during hematopoietic differentiation
items.abstract: Distinct PU.1 levels are associated with progenitor, B-cell, and macrophage states during hematopoietic differentiation. A previous dynamical-systems model attributed these levels to multistability generated by PU.1 autoregulation coupled to feedback between PU.1 abundance and cell-cycle progression, but its predictions were not quantitatively evaluated against the motivating measurements. Here, we test this mechanism using reported measurements of PU.1 abundance, its synthesis rate, and cell-cycle duration, and develop progressively more mechanistic alternatives. The original growth-feedback model neither represents the two reported progenitor groups nor reproduces the nonmonotonic relationship between PU.1 abundance and cell-cycle length. Even with experimentally measured cell-type-specific growth rates, PU.1 autoregulation alone does not reproduce the observed PU.1 abundance and synthesis rates across cell states. Reproducing the cell-state measurements requires an additional cell-state-dependent input to PU.1 production. Guided by enhancer regulation, we model positive feedback between PU.1 and C/EBP and constrain it with reporter measurements, but this architecture cannot jointly reproduce the reporter and cell-state datasets. Adding RUNX1 permits data-consistent stable states when high effective cooperativity in PU.1-dependent C/EBP activation is allowed. Thus, combined dynamical and cis-regulatory constraints support additional regulation of PU.1 production beyond autoregulation, cell-type-specific dilution, and C/EBP feedback. The RUNX1-extended architecture provides one biologically grounded realization and generates experimentally testable hypotheses for differentiation networks.
items.authors: Igoshin, O. A.; Zhang, Y.
items.title_zh: 整合细胞状态与增强子约束区分PU.1在造血分化中的调控模型
items.summary_zh: 在造血分化过程中，不同的PU.1水平与前体细胞、B细胞和巨噬细胞状态相关。之前的动力系统模型将这些水平归因于PU.1自我调节与PU.1丰度和细胞周期进程之间的反馈所产生的多稳态，但其预测未经过定量评估。本文利用PU.1丰度、合成速率和细胞周期持续时间的测量数据测试该机制，并逐步发展更具机制性的替代方案。原始的生长反馈模型无法代表两个前体细胞组，也无法再现PU.1丰度与细胞周期长度之间的非单调关系。即使使用实验测得的细胞类型特异性生长速率，PU.1自我调节也无法再现不同细胞状态下的PU.1丰度和合成速率。再现细胞状态测量需要额外的细胞状态依赖性输入。通过增强子调控，我们建模PU.1与C/EBP之间的正反馈，并用报告测量进行约束，但该架构无法共同再现报告和细胞状态数据集。引入RUNX1允许在PU.1依赖的C/EBP激活中实现数据一致的稳定状态。

items.title: Conformational dynamics of ND2 antiporter-like subunit in intact and truncated complex I
items.abstract: Respiratory complex I is a large redox-driven proton pump and contributes to the proton motive force required for ATP generation in mitochondria and bacteria. It has been extensively studied with structural and biochemical approaches leading to enhanced understanding of its three- dimensional architecture. Despite significant progress in deciphering its catalytic function, the redox-coupled proton pumping mechanism remains unclear and extensively debated. The three membrane-bound antiporter-like subunits ND2, ND4 and ND5 are responsible for pumping protons from the negatively charged side (N-side) of the membrane to the positively charged side (P-side). Emerging evidence supports the role of ND5 subunit in releasing pumped protons to the P-side of the membrane, but the question whether ND2 and ND4 also contribute to proton release remains unanswered. Here, we performed atomistic molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of an intact and a truncated model of complex I in which ND5 and ND4 subunits are removed in-silico. The simulation data reveals a previously unobserved conformational change in the P-side region of ND2 subunit that occurs much more easily in a truncated model of complex I, as also estimated based on free energy calculations. The conformational change, in part triggered by the artificial exposure of ND2 subunit to lipid bilayer, results in a local hydration of the region, similar to what has been observed in recent cryo-EM structure of plant CI:CIII2 supercomplex. We discuss the functional relevance of observed conformational transitions and identify residues that can be manipulated with biochemical approaches to shed light on proton pumping by complex I.
items.authors: Abettan, A.; Lasham, J.; Endres, E.; Sharma, V.
items.title_zh: ND2反向转运蛋白亚基在复合体I中的构象动态研究
items.summary_zh: 呼吸复合体I是一个大型的氧化还原驱动质子泵，负责产生线粒体和细菌中ATP所需的质子动力势。尽管在其催化功能的解析上取得了显著进展，但氧化还原耦合的质子泵机制仍不清晰。膜结合的反向转运蛋白样亚基ND2、ND4和ND5负责将质子从膜的负电侧（N侧）泵送到正电侧（P侧）。近期证据支持ND5亚基在将泵送的质子释放到P侧的作用，但ND2和ND4是否也参与质子释放仍未解答。本文通过原子分子动力学（MD）模拟了完整和截断的复合体I模型，发现ND2亚基在P侧区域发生了之前未观察到的构象变化，该变化在截断模型中更易发生。构象变化部分是由于ND2亚基与脂质双层的人工接触引发，导致局部水合现象。

items.title: Complex folding kinetics of multi-domain proteins disentangled with periodic forces by magnetic tweezers
items.abstract: Force spectroscopy yields direct access to the interplay between free energy and transition kinetics of proteins and nucleic acids. Yet, complex molecules such as multi-domain proteins exhibit multiple intermediates during unfolding and refolding with different or similar stabilities and kinetics ranging from milliseconds to hours. In particular, conditions at equilibrium or near equilibrium are often impossible to find for multi-domain systems and traditional out-of-equilibrium experiments challenging to analyze. Here, we propose periodic forces to bridge different stabilities, selectively enhance intermediate populations, and a rigorous analysis framework to disentangle kinetics of multi-domain protein folding at quasi-equilibrium. Using high resolution magnetic tweezers, we apply well-defined periodic square functions of force with steady states that can be flexibly modulated. We demonstrate the analysis framework with a well-studied simple model system, the two-state folder {lambda}6-85. We show that periodic force experiments reproduce equilibrium kinetics and a simple theoretical framework opens the possibility to expand periodic force measurements to complex multidomain proteins. We apply the framework to the multi-domain protein mimic (Protein L)x8 and show how periodic forces can enhance populations of distinct intermediate states by tuning their frequency and amplitude. In a last example, we show how to dissect entangled states of a hybrid two-domain protein termed {lambda}-L, where 100-fold difference in kinetics of both domains would prevent equilibrium analysis. Expanding a two-state to a three-state periodic force protocol allowed for directed population of folding intermediates. We anticipate our method and analysis framework will expand the possibilities to decipher complex multi-domain folds and their multi-dimensional folding pathways.
items.authors: Quintana-Catano, C. A.; Hartmann, A.; Schlierf, M.
items.title_zh: 利用磁镊子研究多域蛋白的复杂折叠动力学
items.summary_zh: 力谱学为研究蛋白质和核酸的自由能与转变动力学之间的相互作用提供了直接途径。然而，多域蛋白在展开和重新折叠过程中表现出多种中间体，其稳定性和动力学各异，时间范围从毫秒到小时。尤其是在平衡或近平衡条件下，寻找适合多域系统的实验条件往往困难，传统的非平衡实验分析也具有挑战性。本文提出使用周期性力来连接不同的稳定性，选择性地增强中间体的数量，并建立严格的分析框架，以解开多域蛋白在准平衡状态下的折叠动力学。我们使用高分辨率的磁镊子，施加可灵活调节的周期性方形力函数。通过对简单模型系统λ6-85的分析，证明了周期性力实验能够重现平衡动力学，并为复杂多域蛋白的周期性力测量提供了理论基础。我们将该框架应用于多域蛋白模拟物(Protein L)x8，展示了通过调节频率和幅度，周期性力如何增强不同中间态的数量。

items.title: Plunge freezing tweezers with ultrasonic excitation for reducing preferred particle orientation in cryo-EM
items.abstract: Preferred particle orientation, which results from the adsorption of proteins to the air-water interface, is a frequently encountered issue in single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM). Particles then present only a limited number of views, which are oversampled during data acquisition at the expense of throughput, while other views may be missing altogether. In severe cases, a high-resolution reconstruction becomes unattainable. We have recently established that ultrasonic excitation of the sample during vitrification improves the angular distribution by detaching particles from the air-water interface and reshuffling their orientations. Here, we describe an implementation of this principle for a plunge freezing apparatus, in which the ultrasonic transducer is integrated into the head of the pair of tweezers holding the sample, and show that this design is able to reduce preferred orientation. We demonstrate this for hemagglutinin, the canonical example of preferred orientation, and show that the fraction of side and tilted views increases with the excitation amplitude. This allows us to obtain a complete reconstruction of the trimer at 2.5 [A].
items.authors: Wenz, J.; Flor, M.; Krueger, C. R.; Drabbels, M.; Lorenz, U. J.
items.title_zh: 超声激励下的急冻镊子减少冷冻电镜中颗粒取向偏好
items.summary_zh: 在单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）中，蛋白质吸附在气-水界面上导致的颗粒取向偏好是一个常见问题。这使得颗粒仅呈现有限的视角，导致数据采集时过度采样某些视角，而其他视角可能完全缺失，严重时无法获得高分辨率重建。我们最近发现，在玻璃化过程中对样品进行超声激励可以改善角度分布，帮助颗粒脱离气-水界面并重新排列取向。本文描述了一种将超声换能器集成到样品夹持镊子头部的急冻装置的实现，展示了该设计能够减少取向偏好。以血凝素为例，我们证明了随着激励幅度的增加，侧视和倾斜视的比例增加，从而在2.5 Å分辨率下获得三聚体的完整重建。

items.title: Toll-like receptor expression across histological states of Epidermodysplasia Verruciformis
items.abstract: Epidermodysplasia verruciformis (EV) is characterized by susceptibility to cutaneous {beta}-human papillomaviruses, persistent viral lesions and an increased risk of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC). We investigated whether expression of Toll-like receptors 3, 4, 5 and 9 (TLR3, TLR4, TLR5 and TLR9) differs across histological states within EV. Immunoreactivity was quantified by digital H-score using QuPath in 97 specimens from 28 patients, comprising 13 lesion-free skin samples, 15 flat warts and 69 cSCCs. Prespecified comparisons evaluated flat wart versus lesion-free skin, cSCC versus non-neoplastic tissue and invasive versus in situ cSCC, with invasive tumour differentiation assessed secondarily. Patient-clustered generalized estimating equations and false-discovery-rate (FDR) correction were used for inference. After correction for multiple testing, TLR9 H-scores were higher in flat warts than in lesion-free skin ({beta}=60.58; q=0.0332). Compared with non-neoplastic tissue, cSCC showed lower TLR3 ({beta}=-81.40; q=0.00745), higher TLR4 ({beta}=55.59; q=0.04793) and lower TLR9 expression ({beta}=-34.80; q=0.03412). TLR5 showed a nominal increase in cSCC that did not meet the FDR threshold. None of the four receptors differed significantly between invasive and in situ cSCC, and no differentiation trend remained significant after FDR correction. These findings show receptor-specific differences in TLR expression across histological states of EV, particularly involving TLR3, TLR4 and TLR9, although the diagnostic and prognostic significance of these tissue patterns remains to be established.
items.authors: Froes Junior, L. A. R.; Pereira, C. C. d. A.; Silva, L. L. d. C.; Saldanha, M. G.; Pereira, N. V.; Pereira de Oliveira, W. R.; Sotto, M. N.
items.title_zh: 表皮发育不良中Toll样受体的表达研究
items.summary_zh: 表皮发育不良（EV）特征为对皮肤β型人乳头瘤病毒的易感性、持续的病毒性病变及皮肤鳞状细胞癌（cSCC）风险增加。本研究探讨了Toll样受体3、4、5和9（TLR3、TLR4、TLR5和TLR9）在EV不同组织学状态下的表达差异。我们对来自28名患者的97个标本进行了免疫反应性定量分析，包括13个无病变皮肤样本、15个扁平疣和69个cSCC。结果显示，扁平疣的TLR9 H-score显著高于无病变皮肤（β=60.58；q=0.0332）。与非肿瘤组织相比，cSCC的TLR3表达降低（β=-81.40；q=0.00745），TLR4表达升高（β=55.59；q=0.04793），而TLR9表达降低（β=-34.80；q=0.03412）。TLR5在cSCC中有名义性增加，但未达到FDR阈值。侵袭性和原位cSCC之间四个受体的表达无显著差异，FDR校正后无显著分化趋势。

items.title: A Nanomechanical Fingerprint of Centromeric Methylation Co-Localization in TNBC Chromosomal Instability
items.abstract: Centromeric heterochromatin is maintained by a self-reinforcing loop between DNA methylation (5mC) and histone H3 lysine 9 trimethylation (H3K9me3), yet whether this coupling is preserved at the level of individual chromosomes in cancer has been inaccessible to conventional epigenomic assays, which average signals across cell populations and cannot resolve single-chromosome heterogeneity. Here, we use antibody-functionalized atomic force spectroscopy to simultaneously map 5mC and H3K9me3 at the centromeres of individual metaphase chromosomes from non-tumorigenic, luminal, and triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) cell models. Co-localized 5mC/H3K9me3 sites are mechanically stiffer than sites carrying either mark alone across the panel, revealing a cooperative biophysical signature of epigenetic crosstalk. Luminal chromosomes acquire the highest mark density, co-localization, and stiffness, whereas TNBC chromosomes show reduced density and diminished, though not absent, co-localization and stiffness, converging toward the low baseline of non-tumorigenic epithelium. TGF-{beta}1-induced epithelial-mesenchymal transition reproduces this attenuated phenotype in luminal cells, linking it directly to a process central to TNBC aggressiveness. These biophysical parameters classify cancer versus non-tumorigenic chromosomes with near-perfect, cross-validated accuracy, and further resolve the two TNBC subtypes using colocalization-derived features alone (macro-F1 = 0.933). These results establish the mechanical consequence of epigenetic mark co-localization as a single-chromosome-resolvable signature of centromeric organization, attenuated in aggressive breast cancer, and demonstrate a force-spectroscopy platform for mechano-epigenetic profiling of cancer chromosomes.
items.authors: Agrawal, T.; Chakraborty, S.; Khanna, S.; Sahoo, S.; Jolly, M. K.; Kumar, S. A.; PAUL, D.; Majumder, S.; Mukherjee, S.; Rakshit, T.
items.title_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌染色体不稳定性中的着丝粒甲基化共定位的纳米机械指纹
items.summary_zh: 着丝粒异染色质通过DNA甲基化（5mC）与组蛋白H3赖氨酸9三甲基化（H3K9me3）之间的自增强环路维持。然而，传统的表观基因组检测无法在癌症中解析单个染色体的这种耦合。我们使用抗体功能化的原子力显微镜同时映射非肿瘤性、腔道型和三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）细胞模型中单个中期染色体的5mC和H3K9me3。共定位的5mC/H3K9me3位点在机械上比单独标记的位点更坚硬，揭示了表观遗传相互作用的协同生物物理特征。腔道型染色体具有最高的标记密度、共定位和刚度，而TNBC染色体则显示出降低的密度和减弱的共定位及刚度，趋向于非肿瘤性上皮的低基线。TGF-β1诱导的上皮-间质转化在腔道型细胞中再现了这种减弱表型，直接与TNBC的侵袭性过程相关。这些生物物理参数几乎完美地将癌症与非肿瘤性染色体分类。

items.title: Transient tubular membrane injury is converted into persistent fibrosis through a macrophage-fibroblast relay
items.abstract: A central unresolved problem in acute kidney injury (AKI) is how a transient epithelial insult is converted into persistent fibrotic repair that drives progression toward chronic kidney disease. Although tubular, immune and stromal responses are individually well recognized, the mechanistically continuous relay linking these three compartments has remained unresolved. Here we define a directional information-conversion pathway spanning injured tubular epithelial cells, macrophages and fibroblasts. Time-resolved single-cell profiling identified a TREM2/SPP1 macrophage state that emerged as post-ischemic repair became fibrotic. Tubular injury remodeled phosphatidylserine (PS) species, increased oxidized PS and PS externalization, and generated a membrane-lipid context for TREM2 sensing, supported by PS masking, defined liposomes and orthogonal binding assays. Structure-function analysis separated R47-dependent phospholipid recognition from K183-dependent DAP12 coupling, linking membrane damage to SYK activation and NF-kB/AP-1-driven Spp1 transcription. Macrophage-derived SPP1 then activated ITGAV/ITGB1-associated FAK-SMAD2/3 signaling, fibroblast contraction and matrix production. Crucially, repair-phase SPP1 neutralization and post-injury Cx3cr1-lineage Trem2 deletion attenuated fibrosis, with delayed Trem2 deletion protective in both ischemic and obstructive injury. Human single-cell, spatial, urinary and tissue analyses showed cross-species and cross-scale convergence. These findings resolve how transient tubular membrane damage is successively transformed across three cellular compartments into persistent, yet interruptible, fibrotic repair.
items.authors: Wang, P.; Ruan, Y.; Rao, T.; Li, B.; Cheng, F.; Li, W.
items.title_zh: 巨噬细胞-成纤维细胞中继将暂时性肾小管膜损伤转化为持久性纤维化
items.summary_zh: 急性肾损伤（AKI）中一个未解决的核心问题是，如何将暂时性上皮损伤转化为驱动慢性肾病进展的持久性纤维化修复。我们定义了一个横跨受损肾小管上皮细胞、巨噬细胞和成纤维细胞的定向信息转化通路。时间分辨的单细胞分析识别出一种TREM2/SPP1巨噬细胞状态，该状态在缺血后修复转变为纤维化过程中出现。肾小管损伤重塑了磷脂酰丝氨酸（PS）种类，增加了氧化PS和PS外化，并为TREM2感知生成了膜脂质环境。巨噬细胞来源的SPP1激活了与ITGAV/ITGB1相关的FAK-SMAD2/3信号通路，促进了成纤维细胞收缩和基质生成。关键是，修复阶段的SPP1中和和损伤后Cx3cr1谱系Trem2缺失减轻了纤维化，而延迟的Trem2缺失在缺血和阻塞性损伤中均具有保护作用。

items.title: Generating Structural Ensembles of Disordered Proteins with Diffusion Models
items.abstract: Generative models of protein structures have accelerated scientific discovery. However, the leading structure-prediction models are trained primarily on crystal structures, limiting their ability to sample the conformations of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). All-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can probe the diversity of IDP conformational ensembles, but these simulations are slow and costly. Leveraging the speed of generative models and the accuracy of MD, we develop Zephyr, an SE(3) equivariant diffusion model trained on simulated IDP ensembles. The model generates the structure of a single protein sequence in two phases: a coarse-grained structure is first sampled and heavy atoms are subsequently denoised onto this structure. We evaluate our method on two fronts: ensemble accuracy and sampling efficiency. Across five test systems, the model reproduces key geometric and energetic metrics of the MD ensembles, while sampling at least 63 times faster.
items.authors: Trottier, O.; Gwozdecky, J. H.; Rauscher, S.
items.title_zh: 利用扩散模型生成无序蛋白质的结构集合
items.summary_zh: 生成蛋白质结构的模型加速了科学发现。然而，现有的结构预测模型主要基于晶体结构训练，限制了其对内源性无序蛋白质（IDPs）构象的采样能力。全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟能够探测IDP构象集合的多样性，但这些模拟速度慢且成本高。我们开发了Zephyr，一个基于模拟IDP集合训练的SE(3)等变扩散模型。该模型分两阶段生成单个蛋白质序列的结构：首先采样粗粒度结构，然后将重原子去噪到该结构上。我们在集合准确性和采样效率两个方面评估了该方法。在五个测试系统中，该模型重现了MD集合的关键几何和能量指标，同时采样速度至少快63倍。

items.title: Red states modulate energy localization between the antenna and trap in PSI
items.abstract: The core antenna of the photosystem I (PSI) complex of oxygenic photosynthesis operates at near perfect quantum efficiency, making it one of the most efficient energy conversation devices in nature. The presence of low energy or red chlorophylls (chls) is nearly universal in this core antenna, and these red chls are known to extend the light harvesting capacity and control the rate of energy migration in PSI. Surprisingly, the significance of the structural position of the red chls in PSI remains unknown. In this study, we introduced mutations that generate specific red sites in the PSI core antenna, consistent with those observed in natural species. Using CryoEM, we characterized the structural changes at these red sites. Using transient absorption spectroscopy, we measured the effects of red chlorophyll at specific sites on energy transfer and trapping in PSI to identify their functional significance. While one site funneled energy to the reaction center, the other slowed equilibration in the antenna. These opposing effects indicate different functions are associated with the different red chlorophyll location, reconciling previous seemingly incompatible suggestions as to their functional role.
items.authors: Asido, M.; Khatun, H.; Khmelnitskiy, A.; Reppert, M.; Schlau-Cohen, G. S.; Mazor, Y.
items.title_zh: 红色叶绿素在光合系统I中的能量定位调节
items.summary_zh: 光合系统I（PSI）复合体的核心天线在接近完美的量子效率下运作，是自然界中最有效的能量转换装置之一。红色叶绿素（chls）在这一核心天线中的存在几乎是普遍的，已知它们能够扩展光捕获能力并控制PSI中的能量迁移速率。然而，红色叶绿素在PSI中的结构位置的重要性仍然未知。本研究通过引入突变生成与自然物种相符的特定红色位点，利用冷冻电子显微镜（CryoEM）表征这些位点的结构变化。通过瞬态吸收光谱法，我们测量了特定位点的红色叶绿素对PSI中能量转移和捕获的影响，以识别其功能重要性。结果显示，一个位点将能量引导至反应中心，而另一个则减缓了天线中的平衡。这些相反的效应表明，不同红色叶绿素位置与不同功能相关，调和了先前关于其功能角色的看似不兼容的建议。

items.title: High-Throughput Morphological Profiling of Patient-Derived Human Liver Organoids for Hepatotoxicity Hazard Identification and Compound Prioritization
items.abstract: Drug-induced liver injury (DILI) remains a major challenge in drug development because existing in vitro models poorly predict clinical hepatotoxicity. We coupled patient-derived human liver organoids (HLOs) with high-content imaging and automated machine learning (ML) to detect hepatotoxicity-associated phenotypes by morphological profiling. HLOs from six DILI patients and one healthy donor (n = 7) retained donor-specific baseline phenotypes in hepatocyte maturity, metabolism, and morphology. ML models trained per line on MAD-robustized, well-level-aggregated median features achieved compound-level AUROCs of 0.88 (95% CI 0.86-0.90) to 0.91 (95% CI 0.89-0.93) and balanced accuracies of 0.81-0.84 in distinguishing 54 hepatotoxicants from 20 non-hepatotoxic controls. Averaging predictions across all seven lines at an optimized threshold gave 94.4% sensitivity (95% CI 84.6-98.8%) and 85.0% specificity (95% CI 62.1-96.8%), substantially outperforming HLO cytotoxicity assays and cancer cell line profiling. Lines were moderately-to-highly concordant (Pearson r = 0.66-0.85), and benchmark concentration modeling revealed reproducible inter-line differences in phenotypic sensitivity (median 4.0-fold, several compounds exceeding 20-fold). Exposure anchoring of benchmark concentrations to human-equivalent plasma concentrations, using in vitro mass-balance dosimetry and curated plasma free fractions, placed organoid points of departure within 100-fold of clinical Cmax for 60 of 66 compounds (23-fold residual offset, 95% CI 12-45), and placed two of the three misclassified negative controls an order of magnitude above clinical Cmax. Sulindac injury signatures were significantly enhanced by TNF co-treatment, demonstrating capacity to detect pro-inflammatory-mediated DILI. This platform preserves inter-line variability while enabling reproducible, scalable multi-line consensus hazard classification; because compounds were tested over a common nominal concentration range, the readout defines hepatocellular hazard, which must be combined with exposure as an independent input to estimate clinical DILI risk.
items.authors: Meyer, S. R.; Garcia, M. A.; Zhao, N.; Boisvert, S. F.; McConnachie, M.; Zhang, C. J.; Halligan, B. S.; Tidball, A. M.; Tucker, A.; Kaganove, J.; Wotring, J. W.; Yates, J. A.; Flores, D.; Fontana, R. J.; Sexton, J. Z.
items.title_zh: 高通量形态特征分析患者来源人肝类器官以识别肝毒性风险
items.summary_zh: 药物性肝损伤（DILI）在药物开发中仍然是一个重大挑战，因为现有的体外模型对临床肝毒性的预测能力较差。本研究结合患者来源的人肝类器官（HLOs）、高内容成像和自动化机器学习（ML），通过形态特征分析检测与肝毒性相关的表型。来自六名DILI患者和一名健康供体的HLOs保留了供体特异性的肝细胞成熟度、代谢和形态基线特征。针对每条细胞系训练的ML模型在区分54种肝毒性物质与20种非肝毒性对照时，达到了0.88至0.91的AUROC和0.81-0.84的平衡准确率。七条细胞系的预测平均值在优化阈值下显示出94.4%的灵敏度和85.0%的特异性，显著优于HLO细胞毒性测定和癌细胞系分析。不同细胞系间的表型敏感性存在可重复的差异，基准浓度建模揭示了中位数为4.0倍的差异，部分化合物超过20倍。

items.title: State-selective nanobodies to probe Guanylate-binding protein coat assembly and function
items.abstract: Cell-autonomous immunity against gram-negative bacterial pathogens relies on Guanylate-binding proteins (GBPs). GBPs are interferon-inducible guanosine triphosphate hydrolases that coat cytosolic bacteria and promote non-canonical inflammasome activation. GBP coat assembly is initiated by GBP1, which binds bacterial lipopolysaccharide and recruits further paralogs in a hierarchical and nucleotide-dependent manner. Dissecting the contributions of individual GBPs has remained challenging because the seven human paralogs are structurally similar and undergo nucleotide-driven conformational changes that are difficult to resolve in cellular and biochemical experiments. Here, we developed a nanobody toolbox for the state-selective probing of human GBP coat assembly. We identify eight nanobodies with distinct paralog, domain, and conformational specificities and define their binding profiles and epitopes using complementary biophysical assays and cryogenic electron microscopy. We further demonstrate the utility of selected nanobodies by demonstrating their functionality in membrane reconstitution assays and in infected cells. A dimer-disrupting nanobody blocks progression of GBP-coat assembly from soluble GBP1 assemblies to LPS-associated coats, suggesting a stage-specific structural transition during coat formation. In contrast, a dimer selective nanobody binds assembled coats without measurably perturbing their organisation and is robustly recruited to GBP1-positive bacteria in infected cells, indicating that this dimer interface remains intact and accessible in coat-associated GBP1. Together, these nanobodies establish a set of state-selective reagents to distinguish, perturb, and probe GBP assemblies in structural, biochemical, and cellular studies
items.authors: Pagani, L. L.; Kuhm, T. I.; Pinto, C.; Perton, E. G.; Arents, M.; Nguyen, P. N. M.; Steyaert, J.; Pardon, E.; Jakobi, A. J.
items.title_zh: 选择性纳米抗体探究鸟苷酸结合蛋白外壳组装与功能
items.summary_zh: 细胞自主免疫对抗革兰氏阴性细菌病原体依赖于鸟苷酸结合蛋白（GBP）。GBP是干扰素诱导的鸟苷三磷酸水解酶，能够包裹细胞质细菌并促进非经典炎症小体的激活。GBP外壳的组装由GBP1启动，其通过结合细菌脂多糖并以层级和核苷酸依赖的方式招募其他同源物。由于七种人类同源物在结构上相似且经历难以在细胞和生化实验中解析的核苷酸驱动构象变化，个体GBP的贡献一直难以剖析。我们开发了一种纳米抗体工具箱，以选择性探测人类GBP外壳的组装。我们识别出八种具有不同同源物、结构域和构象特异性的纳米抗体，并通过互补的生物物理测定和冷冻电子显微镜定义其结合特性和表位。我们进一步展示了选定纳米抗体在膜重构实验和感染细胞中的功能性。一个破坏二聚体的纳米抗体阻止了GBP外壳从可溶性GBP1组装体向LPS相关外壳的进展，表明在外壳形成过程中存在阶段特异的结构转变。

items.title: Integrating Developmental Neurotoxicity Prediction with Adverse Outcome Pathway Reasoning
items.abstract: Experimental assessment of developmental neurotoxicity (DNT) is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale across large chemical inventories. New approach methodologies (NAMs), including computational approaches based on machine learning, deep learning, and large language models (LLMs), offer new ways to screen and prioritize chemicals. However, these emerging computational approaches have largely focused on predicting toxicity endpoints, with less attention to the mechanisms underlying those predictions. For DNT assessment, understanding this mechanistic basis is equally important. In this study, we integrated LLM inference with the adverse outcome pathway (AOP) framework to connect DNT predictions with plausible mechanisms. We constructed an AOP-informed benchmark linking ChEMBL target-activity measurements for 5,861 compounds to 14 AOPs representing five neurodevelopmental outcomes and evaluated ten LLMs for the prediction of molecular initiating events (MIEs), key events (KEs), key event relationships (KERs), and adverse outcomes (AOs), as well as the generation of mechanistic explanations. Explanation quality was evaluated using both a naive LLM judge and a rubric-based LLM judge. Across the zero-shot models, the highest observed macro-F1 scores were 0.818 for MIEs and 0.463 for AOs, but only 0.056 for KEs and 0.034 for KERs, identifying downstream pathway reconstruction as the principal challenge. Few-shot prompting substantially improved performance, with Gemini 3.8 Flash under four-shot prompting achieving macro-F1 scores of 0.956 for AOs, 0.813 for MIEs, 0.492 for KEs, and 0.457 for KERs. Both LLM-judge configurations indicated improved mechanistic explanation quality with few-shot examples, although strong outcome prediction did not consistently ensure recovery of the recorded pathway. Our results demonstrate the potential of AOP-informed LLMs to support DNT assessment by linking predicted neurodevelopmental outcomes to plausible biological mechanisms and enabling predictions to be evaluated at both the outcome and pathway levels.
items.authors: Fan, Y.; Xiao, S.; Gao, F.
items.title_zh: 整合发育神经毒性预测与不良结果途径推理
items.summary_zh: 发育神经毒性（DNT）的实验评估成本高、耗时长且难以在大规模化学清单中推广。新方法学（NAMs），包括基于机器学习、深度学习和大型语言模型（LLMs）的计算方法，为筛选和优先考虑化学品提供了新途径。然而，这些新兴计算方法主要集中在预测毒性终点，较少关注预测背后的机制。本文将LLM推理与不良结果途径（AOP）框架相结合，连接DNT预测与合理机制。我们构建了一个基于AOP的基准，将5861种化合物的ChEMBL靶点活性测量与代表五种神经发育结果的14个AOP关联，并评估了十种LLM在分子启动事件（MIEs）、关键事件（KEs）、关键事件关系（KERs）和不良结果（AOs）预测及机制解释生成中的表现。结果显示，MIEs的宏观F1分数最高为0.818，而AOs为0.463，但KEs和KERs的分数仅为0.056和0.034，揭示了下游途径重建的挑战。

items.title: A Kiss-and-Ride Mechanism for Lipid Exchange at Membrane Contact Sites
items.abstract: Lipid transfer proteins (LTPs) mediate non-vesicular lipid transport at membrane contact sites, yet how transient membrane tethering contributes to lipid transfer remains poorly understood. Here, we use the single-domain yeast phosphatidylserine transporter Osh6, a member of the oxysterol-binding protein-related protein family, to investigate tethering-dependent lipid transport. We show that Osh6 can access two transport modes depending on membrane composition: conventional shuttling between membranes and a tethering-dependent mode in which the opposing membrane facilitates cargo extraction from the donor membrane. Combining lipid transport and membrane-tethering measurements with kinetic analysis, lipid partitioning, and in vivo complementation, we provide evidence for a transient membrane-bridged intermediate during lipid transfer. Productive phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate (PI4P) extraction destabilizes this bridged state, allowing cargo-loaded Osh6 to disengage and continue the transport cycle. We term this mechanism kiss-and-ride, in which transient membrane contact facilitates cargo extraction ("kiss") before the cargo-loaded protein disengages ("ride"). Consistent with this model, PI4P transport is preserved in a lidless Osh6 mutant with impaired membrane dissociation, whereas phosphatidylserine transport is strongly reduced, revealing distinct mechanistic requirements for the two cargoes. Together, our findings reveal a tethering-dependent transport mode in a cup-like LTP and suggest that membrane contact sites can actively shape the mechanism of lipid transport rather than merely bringing donor and acceptor membranes into proximity.
items.authors: Ballekov, A.; Eisenreichov, A.; Holic, R.; Griac, P.; Boura, E.; Humpolickova, J.
items.title_zh: 膜接触位点脂质交换的吻接机制
items.summary_zh: 脂质转运蛋白（LTPs）在膜接触位点介导非囊泡脂质运输，但瞬时膜连接如何促进脂质转移仍不清楚。本研究使用单域酵母磷脂酰丝氨酸转运蛋白Osh6，探讨依赖于连接的脂质运输。结果表明，Osh6可以根据膜组成选择两种运输模式：常规的膜间穿梭和依赖连接的模式，其中对侧膜促进货物从供体膜中提取。通过结合脂质运输、膜连接测量、动力学分析和体内互补实验，我们提供了脂质转移过程中存在瞬时膜桥接中间体的证据。有效的磷脂酰肌醇4-磷酸（PI4P）提取会使该桥接状态不稳定，从而使负载货物的Osh6脱离并继续运输循环。我们将这一机制称为吻接机制，其中瞬时膜接触促进货物提取（“吻”），然后负载货物的蛋白质脱离（“骑”）。与此模型一致，缺乏盖子的Osh6突变体在膜解离受损的情况下仍能保持PI4P运输，而磷脂酰丝氨酸运输显著减少，揭示了不同的机制需求。

items.title: Two Genomes, One Metabolome: Mitonuclear Incompatibility Remodels Developmental Metabolism and Fitness in Drosophila
items.abstract: Mitochondrial-nuclear (hereafter mitonuclear) genetic variation can alter cellular bioenergetics and metabolism via jointly encoding the subunits of oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) system. Here we tested whether genetic variation in biochemical and bioenergetic phenotype can scale up across higher levels of biological organization to affect organismal development. We used a panel of (mtDNA); nDNA genotypes created by asymmetric substitution of divergent mtDNA between Drosophila melanogaster and its sister species D. simulans. Two genotypes (ore); OreR and (ore); Aut carry coevolved mitonuclear genomes from D. melanogaster, whereas the other two (w501); Aut and (w501); OreR harbor D. simulans mitochondrial DNA introgressed onto D. melanogaster nuclear backgrounds. We utilized untargeted metabolomics to track down the comprehensive biochemical footprint of the joint genomic architecture in the metabolome of these genotypes. We show that in (w501); OreR larvae with mitonuclear genome incompatibility there is extensive and coordinated metabolic remodeling of carbon, nitrogen, and redox balance, characterized by increased glycolysis, limited TCA cycle, amino acid scarcity, reduced nucleic acid balance, lipid remodeling, with compensatory activation of antioxidant pathways. This biochemical rewiring puts a physiological constraint that prioritizes maintenance metabolism over larval growth, leading to reduced body size, slow locomotion and delayed development, despite a compensatory increase in feeding in these larvae. These findings underscore the context dependency of mitonuclear interactions, which can uniquely scale up to influence organismal energy budget trade-offs, fitness and life-history evolution.
items.authors: Singh, A.; Frias, B.; Deaver, B. M.; Edwards, A. C.; Cambara, J. K.; Matoo, O. B.
items.title_zh: 两个基因组，一个代谢组：线粒体-核基因不相容重塑果蝇发育代谢与适应性
items.summary_zh: 线粒体-核（以下简称线粒体-核）遗传变异可以通过共同编码氧化磷酸化（OXPHOS）系统的亚基来改变细胞的生物能量学和代谢。本研究测试了生化和生物能量表型的遗传变异是否能够在更高的生物组织层次上影响生物体发育。我们使用了由果蝇黑腹果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）与其姐妹种果蝇（D. simulans）之间的线粒体DNA（mtDNA）不对称替代创建的核DNA（nDNA）基因型面板。结果显示，在具有线粒体-核基因组不相容性的（w501）OreR幼虫中，碳、氮和氧化还原平衡的代谢重塑显著且协调，表现为糖酵解增加、TCA循环受限、氨基酸稀缺、核酸平衡降低、脂质重塑，以及抗氧化途径的补偿性激活。这种生化重接线对生理施加了约束，优先考虑维持代谢而非幼虫生长。

items.title: Novel modifications to fructose metabolism are associated with adaptation to high-sugar diets in bats
items.abstract: High-sugar diets in mammals are associated with a number of metabolic diseases including diabetes and obesity. However, frugivorous and nectivorous bats specialize in consuming diets high in simple sugars while remaining healthy. To investigate the metabolic adaptations in bats with high-sugar diets, we conducted targeted metabolomics on blood samples collected during the first ten minutes after glucose or fructose feeding in five bat species whose natural diets vary in sugar content. By comparing changes in blood metabolite levels over time both between feeding treatments and across dietary guild, we have been able to identify shifts in sugar processing that likely support the healthy metabolism of simple sugars mammals with high-sugar diets. Notably, despite both sugars being readily absorbed, only fructose feeding induced significant changes in other metabolites within ten minutes after feeding. Species who naturally consume more sugar showed both faster production of metabolic intermediates and lowered production of common deleterious byproducts of fructose metabolism than species with comparatively lower-sugar diets. The prioritization and refinement of fructose metabolism is therefore likely a more key aspect of how bats with high-sugar diets are able to avoid the diseases typically associated with excessive sugar consumption than modifications to glucose metabolism.
items.authors: Jamison, J.; Miranda Gutierez, A.; Oelbaum, P.; Marron, G.; Sadier, A.; Ortega, J.; Simmons, N. B.; Welch, K. C.
items.title_zh: 蝙蝠高糖饮食的果糖代谢新变化研究
items.summary_zh: 高糖饮食与多种代谢疾病相关，但以水果和花蜜为食的蝙蝠在高糖饮食下依然健康。为研究蝙蝠在高糖饮食中的代谢适应，我们对五种自然饮食中糖含量不同的蝙蝠血样进行了靶向代谢组学分析，样本在进食后十分钟内收集。通过比较不同喂养处理和饮食类别间血液代谢物水平的变化，我们发现果糖代谢的优先化和精细化可能是蝙蝠避免高糖饮食相关疾病的关键。结果显示，尽管葡萄糖和果糖均易被吸收，但只有果糖喂养在进食后十分钟内显著改变了其他代谢物。自然摄入更多糖的物种代谢中间产物的生成速度更快，且果糖代谢的有害副产物生成更少。

items.title: CONSTITUTIVE STIM1L DELETION ALTERS STORE-OPERATED CALCIUM ENTRY KINETICS BUT DOES NOT PERTURB THE DEVELOPMENT AND FUNCTION OF MOUSE SKELETAL MUSCLE
items.abstract: Store-operated calcium entry (SOCE) is a ubiquitous calcium (Ca2+) signalling mechanism that replenishes endoplasmic and sarcoplasmic reticulum Ca2+ stores. We previously identified STIM1L, a skeletal muscle-enriched STIM1 splice variant that enables rapid SOCE activation in human myotubes. To determine its physiological role in vivo, we generated a constitutive knockout mouse model that selectively abolishes STIM1L expression while preserving the canonical STIM1 isoform. Stim1l-KO mice developed normally and exhibited no overt abnormalities, but both sexes showed reduced voluntary wheel-running activity, suggesting neuromuscular perturbation. Skeletal muscle deprived of STIM1L did not show any histological alterations or changes in fibre- type and size. Likewise, force-frequency relationships and fatigue resistance measured ex vivo in isolated extensor digitorum longus and soleus muscles were indistinguishable from control muscles. This lack of difference may be explained by the increased expression of STIM1 in several skeletal muscles and suggests that changes in the voluntary running activity of Stim1l-KO mice may arise from STIM1L loss in non-muscular tissues, including the central nervous system. Notwithstanding, primary myotubes derived from Stim1l-KO mice displayed a marked delay in SOCE activation kinetics, whereas SOCE amplitude remained comparable to controls. This was consistent with a compensatory STIM1 upregulation maintaining overall Ca2+ entry capacity. Interestingly, electrically evoked Ca2+ transients in intact Stim1l-KO flexor digitorum brevis fibres exhibited significantly faster decay kinetics than controls. This revealed another role of STIM1L in Ca2+ handling in skeletal muscle that appears independent of its contribution to SOCE activation. Together, these findings establish STIM1L as a regulator of SOCE activation kinetics and indicate an additional role in myofibre Ca2+ clearance, while suggesting that compensatory upregulation of canonical STIM1 may preserve muscle structure and contractile function in its absence in mice.
items.authors: Dopont, O.; Lopez, G.; Lilliu, E.; Castets, P.; Koenig, X.; Frieden, M.; Koenig, S.
items.title_zh: STIM1L缺失改变钙储存操作性进入动力学但不影响小鼠骨骼肌发育与功能
items.summary_zh: 储存操作性钙进入（SOCE）是一种普遍的钙信号机制，能够补充内质网和肌浆网中的钙离子储存。我们之前鉴定了STIM1L，这是一种在骨骼肌中富集的STIM1剪接变体，能够快速激活SOCE。为确定其在体内的生理作用，我们构建了一个选择性去除STIM1L表达的全身性敲除小鼠模型，同时保留经典的STIM1异构体。Stim1l-KO小鼠正常发育且无明显异常，但两性均表现出自愿跑轮活动减少，提示神经肌肉功能受扰。缺失STIM1L的骨骼肌未见组织学改变或纤维类型和大小变化。离体测量的伸肌和腓肠肌的力-频率关系及疲劳抵抗与对照组无显著差异，可能由于其他骨骼肌中STIM1表达增加所致。尽管如此，Stim1l-KO小鼠来源的初级肌管在SOCE激活动力学上显示明显延迟，而SOCE幅度与对照组相当。

items.title: A Novel ACLY Inhibitor Induces Transcriptional and Metabolic Reprogramming to Overcome Tyrosine kinase inhibitor Resistance in Lymphoma
items.abstract: Background: Metabolic plasticity contributes to therapeutic resistance in T-cell lymphoma, but the metabolic dependencies underlying tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) resistance remain poorly understood. ATP citrate lyase (ACLY), which converts citrate to cytosolic acetyl-CoA, links glucose metabolism to lipogenesis and acetylation-dependent regulation. We hypothesized that ACLY represents an actionable metabolic vulnerability in lymphoma. Methods: Structure-guided drug discovery and biochemical screening were used to identify the novel ACLY inhibitor VCB1. VCB1 was evaluated against recombinant human ACLY and in TKI-sensitive and TKI-resistant lymphoma models. Antitumor activity was assessed by proliferation, cell-cycle analysis, apoptosis, and immunoblotting, followed by integrated transcriptomic, metabolomic, and lipidomic profiling. Results: Our xenograft study showed that ACLY dependence in ALK+ALCL. We discovered novel ACLY inhibitor VCB1 directly inhibited recombinant ACLY with uM potency (IC, 0.9 uM) and strongly suppressed lymphoma cell growth. In ALK inhibitor-sensitive SUPM2, VCB1 showed an IC of 0.299 uM and retained potency in lorlatinib-resistant SUPM2-LR1000 cells (1.62 uM), whereas BMS-303141 was substantially less active (17.46 and 22.07 uM). VCB1 similarly inhibited BTK inhibitor sensitive and resistant mantle cell lymphoma cell growth (IC, 0.28 and 0.278 uM), compared with BMS-303141 (30.5 and 37.01 uM). Multi-omics profiling revealed suppression of de novo lipogenesis, including ACACA, FASN, and PPARGC1B, together with extensive remodeling of triglyceride, phospholipid, cardiolipin, ceramide, and acylcarnitine species and increased expression of fatty-acid oxidation genes. VCB1 activated the integrated stress response (ISR), inducing ATF4, PPP1R15A, DDIT3, DDIT4 and SESN2, while disrupting purine and pyrimidine metabolism and reducing nucleotide biosynthetic genes, including CAD, DHODH, UCK2, and ATIC. VCB1 further activated an ACLY/ISR/CHAC1 axis associated with reduced GCLC/GCLM expression, glutathione depletion, and a decreased GSH/GSSG ratio, indicating impaired redox homeostasis. TKI-resistant cells exhibited distinct lipid-metabolic remodeling consistent with metabolic plasticity. VCB1 also altered immune-regulatory programs involving PDCD1, TIGIT, CD247, CD226, NFATC2, and inflammatory cytokines. Functionally, VCB1 induced cell cycle arrest and apoptosis. Conclusions: ACLY represents an integrated metabolic and signaling vulnerability in lymphoma. VCB1 suppresses lymphoma growth across TKI-sensitive and resistant models by disrupting lipid and nucleotide metabolism, metabolic adaptation and ISR and redox homeostasis supporting ACLY inhibition as a therapeutic strategy for TKI-resistant lymphoma.
items.authors: Pattabiraman, N.; Lobello, C.; Rushmore, D.; Wang, S.; Mologni, L.; Borgh, H.; Nath, K.; Zhang, W.; Goldman, A.; Nejati, R.; Wasik, M.; Basappa, J.
items.title_zh: 新型ACLY抑制剂诱导转录和代谢重编程以克服淋巴瘤TKI耐药性
items.summary_zh: 背景：代谢可塑性在T细胞淋巴瘤的治疗耐药中起重要作用，但酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（TKI）耐药的代谢依赖性尚不清楚。ATP柠檬酸裂解酶（ACLY）将柠檬酸转化为细胞质乙酰辅酶A，连接了葡萄糖代谢与脂质合成及乙酰化调控。我们假设ACLY是淋巴瘤中的可操作代谢脆弱点。方法：通过结构引导药物发现和生化筛选识别新型ACLY抑制剂VCB1，并在TKI敏感和耐药的淋巴瘤模型中进行评估。结果：我们的异种移植研究显示ALK+ALCL对ACLY的依赖性。VCB1以0.9 uM的效力直接抑制重组ACLY，并显著抑制淋巴瘤细胞生长。在ALK抑制剂敏感的SUPM2中，VCB1的IC为0.299 uM，并在lorlatinib耐药的SUPM2-LR1000细胞中保持效力（1.62 uM），而BMS-303141的活性显著较低（17.46和22.07 uM）。VCB1同样抑制BTK抑制剂敏感和耐药的套细胞淋巴瘤细胞生长（IC分别为0.28和0.278 uM）。

items.title: A Novel NO Donor 3A72 Activates Mitochondrial-Associated Endoplasmic Reticulum Membrane Structures to Induce Ferroptosis in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
items.abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) remains a major clinical challenge due to a lack of effective interventions and severe drug resistance. Disrupting tumor metabolism using nitric oxide (NO) donors to drive ferroptosis represents a promising therapeutic strategy. Here, we developed 3A72, a novel furan-coumarin-based NO donor with potent anti-TNBC efficacy. In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrated that 3A72 significantly suppresses TNBC cell proliferation and restricts xenograft tumor growth. Notably, its efficacy matches the first-line drug paclitaxel but with enhanced safety and reduced systemic toxicity. Mechanistically, 3A72 induces ferroptosis in triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) cells via a synergistic dual-pathway mechanism. Initially, 3A72 releases intracellular NO to trigger cytoplasmic calcium overload, followed by high-affinity binding to both inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor (IPR) and acyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 4 (ACSL4). Binding to IP3R provokes mitochondrial calcium overload and a massive burst of reactive oxygen species (ROS), while concurrent ACSL4 activation drives essential membrane phospholipid remodeling. Crucially, our transcriptomic and structural predictions reveal that while ACSL4 exhibits a broader distribution across organelle membranes, its functional association with IP3R spatially converges at the endoplasmic reticulum membranes associated with mitochondria (MAMs). This subcellular niche closely couples IPR-mediated ROS generation with ACSL4-driven lipid remodeling, accelerating lethal malondialdehyde (MDA) accumulation and triggering irreversible ferroptosis. Overall, these findings highlight the MAMs calcium-lipid metabolic hub as a promising structural scaffold for antitumor drug development.
items.authors: Long, Y.; Jiang, Y.; Li, L.; Wu, X.; weng, J.; Chen, Y.; Liu, H.
items.title_zh: 新型NO供体3A72激活线粒体相关内质网膜结构诱导三阴性乳腺癌铁死亡
items.summary_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）因缺乏有效干预和严重的药物耐药性而成为临床重大挑战。利用一氧化氮（NO）供体干扰肿瘤代谢以驱动铁死亡是一种有前景的治疗策略。本研究开发了3A72，这是一种新型的呋喃-香豆素基NO供体，具有显著的抗TNBC疗效。体外和体内研究表明，3A72显著抑制TNBC细胞增殖并限制异种移植肿瘤生长。其疗效与一线药物紫杉醇相当，但安全性更高，系统毒性更低。机制研究表明，3A72通过协同双通路机制诱导TNBC细胞的铁死亡。3A72首先释放细胞内NO，引发细胞质钙超载，随后与肌醇1,4,5-三磷酸受体（IP3R）和长链脂酰-CoA合成酶家族成员4（ACSL4）高亲和力结合。与IP3R结合引发线粒体钙超载和大量活性氧（ROS）释放，而ACSL4的激活则驱动膜磷脂重塑。我们的转录组和结构预测显示，尽管ACSL4在细胞器膜上分布广泛，但其与IP3R的功能关联在内质网膜上空间汇聚。

items.title: Genome-Wide Association Mapping of Sudden Death Syndrome Resistance in Germplasm from the USDA Soybean Collection
items.abstract: Sudden Death Syndrome (SDS), caused by Fusarium virguliforme, can significantly impact soybean yields. To advance the understanding of SDS resistance in plant introductions, we conducted genome-wide association studies (GWAS) on a set of 351 accessions from the USDA Soybean Germplasm Collection. The analysis revealed seven single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) significantly associated with foliar SDS resistance; three significant QTL (on chromosomes 3, 9 and 11) were detected with Fixed and Random Model Circulating Probability Unification (FarmCPU) and four (on chromosomes 5, 6 and two on chromosome 7) with Bayesian-information and Linkage disequilibrium Iterative Nested Keyway (BLINK). Localized linkage disequilibrium blocks were estimated for these regions. Notably, all of them overlapped with regions where QTL associated with SDS resistance had been previously reported and where within, or close to, sequences annotated as implicated in plant defense mechanisms, such as toxin transporters and transcription factors. The architecture of SDS resistance appears quantitative and polygenic, with most loci explaining modest phenotypic variance. Six plant introductions in this study--PI 175188, PI 307889A, PI 323559, PI 578307C, PI 445683, and PI 323558--harbor favorable alleles at all seven loci, providing high-value resources for resistance introgression. This study underscores the value of leveraging the USDA Soybean Germplasm Collection for the discovery of resistance loci and provides a foundation for marker-assisted breeding to enhance SDS resistance in elite soybean lines.
items.authors: Miranda, L. M.; Mahan, A.; Xu, Z.
items.title_zh: 美国农业部大豆种质库突发死亡综合症抗性全基因组关联分析
items.summary_zh: 突发死亡综合症（SDS）由福氏菌（Fusarium virguliforme）引起，严重影响大豆产量。为深入了解植物引入体的SDS抗性，我们对美国农业部大豆种质库中的351个样本进行了全基因组关联研究（GWAS）。分析结果显示，七个单核苷酸多态性（SNP）与叶片SDS抗性显著相关；通过固定和随机模型循环概率统一（FarmCPU）检测到三个显著的数量性状位点（QTL，位于染色体3、9和11），通过贝叶斯信息和连锁不平衡迭代嵌套关键路径（BLINK）检测到四个（位于染色体5、6和两个在染色体7上）。这些区域的局部连锁不平衡块被估算，且均与先前报告的SDS抗性相关QTL区域重叠，且接近注释为植物防御机制相关的序列，如毒素转运蛋白和转录因子。SDS抗性的遗传结构呈现定量和多基因特征，大多数位点解释了适度的表型变异。本研究中六个植物引入体（PI 175188、PI 307889A、PI 323559、PI 578307C、PI 445683和PI 323558）在所有七个位点上均携带有利等位基因，为抗性引入提供了高价值资源。

items.title: A Novel Biofilm Amyloid Ligand for Caspase-11 Drives Hyperactivation in Dendritic Cells
items.abstract: Bacterial biofilms drive persistent infection and chronic inflammation, yet host sensing of biofilm-derived ligands remains poorly understood. Here we identify curli amyloid, an integral component of Enterobacteriaceae biofilms, as a novel activator of the non-canonical inflammasome in human and mouse dendritic cells (DCs). Curli both primes and activates the inflammasome, directly binding caspase-11 to engage NLRP3 and drive robust IL-1{beta} maturation without pyroptosis, establishing curli as a previously unrecognized trigger of DC hyperactivation. Mechanistically, this non-lytic signaling is marked by limited gasdermin D oligomerization without mitochondrial localization and NINJ1-dependent membrane rupture. Functionally, curli-hyperactivated DCs show enhanced migration to the draining lymph nodes in vivo, suggesting consequent augmented adaptive immunity. Finally, curli-containing biofilms also elicit IL-1{beta} secretion without cell death, identifying bacterial amyloid as a central driver of non-lytic inflammasome activation during immune recognition of biofilms.
items.authors: Mintri, S.; Hu, G.; Mathur, A.; Whiteman, L. M.; Dinis, A.; Le, B.; Grando, K.; Shumba, P.; Rathinam, V. A.; Lien, E.; Tukel, C.; Fitzgerald, K. A.; Gallucci, S.
items.title_zh: 新型生物膜淀粉样配体驱动树突状细胞超激活
items.summary_zh: 细菌生物膜导致持续感染和慢性炎症，但宿主对生物膜衍生配体的感知机制尚不清楚。本研究识别了肠杆菌生物膜的关键成分——curli淀粉样蛋白，作为人类和小鼠树突状细胞（DCs）中非经典炎症小体的新激活因子。Curli不仅能够预激活炎症小体，还能直接结合caspase-11，激活NLRP3并驱动IL-1β成熟，而不引发细胞焦亡，确立了curli作为DC超激活的新触发因子。机制上，这种非裂解信号表现为gasdermin D的有限聚合，没有线粒体定位和NINJ1依赖的膜破裂。功能上，curli超激活的DC在体内向引流淋巴结迁移增强，提示增强的适应性免疫。最后，含curli的生物膜也能诱导IL-1β分泌而不导致细胞死亡，确认细菌淀粉样蛋白在免疫识别生物膜过程中作为非裂解炎症小体激活的核心驱动因子。

items.title: Acetylated PLIN2 coordinates the innate immune system and oxylipin synthesis on lipid droplets to propagate inflammation
items.abstract: Research has implicated lipid droplets (LDs) and their associated proteins in inflammation and the innate immune response. The key LD protein Perilipin 2 (PLIN2) is tightly correlated with lipid storage and inflammation, but little is known about the mechanisms underlying its proinflammatory effects. Here, we show that PLIN2 is required for the inflammatory response to mitogens and the recruitment of pro-inflammatory proteins to the surface of LDs. PLIN2 directly binds arachidonic acid and interacts with key oxylipin synthetic enzymes such as PLA2 and COX2 to promote LD-localized oxylipin synthesis and propagate inflammatory signaling. Moreover, LPS induces PLIN2 hyperacetylation, and acetylation-dead PLIN2 mutants lose their proinflammatory properties in the presence of an inflammatory stimulus, as if PLIN2 were ablated. Thus, acetylated PLIN2 forms a key metabolon on LDs that is essential for the response and amplification of proinflammatory signaling.
items.authors: Najt, C. P.; Devarajan, M.; Kerr, E.; Churchill, A.; Boatner, L.; Gerrard, S.; Fess, B.; Guerrero, C.; Higgins, L.; Gelhaus, S. L.; Mashek, D. G.
items.title_zh: 乙酰化PLIN2协调先天免疫系统与脂滴上的氧脂合成以促进炎症
items.summary_zh: 研究表明，脂滴（LDs）及其相关蛋白在炎症和先天免疫反应中发挥重要作用。关键的脂滴蛋白Perilipin 2（PLIN2）与脂质储存和炎症密切相关，但其促炎作用的机制尚不清楚。本研究显示，PLIN2在对促分裂因子的炎症反应中是必需的，并促进促炎蛋白向脂滴表面的招募。PLIN2直接结合花生四烯酸，并与关键的氧脂合成酶如PLA2和COX2相互作用，促进脂滴上氧脂的合成并传播炎症信号。此外，LPS诱导PLIN2的高乙酰化，而乙酰化缺失的PLIN2突变体在炎症刺激下失去促炎特性，仿佛PLIN2被去除。因此，乙酰化的PLIN2在脂滴上形成一个关键的代谢复合体，对促炎信号的响应和放大至关重要。

items.title: Longitudinal linear-epitope profiling of SLE identifies novel antigens associated with disease and disease activity
items.abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is the prototypical systemic autoimmune disease defined by the production of autoantibodies directed against diverse self-antigens. Antinuclear antibodies (ANA) are central to SLE diagnosis, and anti-double-stranded DNA (anti-dsDNA) antibodies are clinically used to track disease activity. However, these biomarkers provide only partial insight into the full spectrum of autoimmune changes in patients. To expand the known landscape of SLE autoreactivity shared among patients and associated with disease activity, we performed an unbiased characterization of 1,268 SLE plasma samples from 695 SLE patients and 301 healthy controls using phage immunoprecipitation and sequencing (PhIP-seq). This technique preferentially displays linear epitopes, and thus provides a complementary set of autoreactivities to previously discovered autoreactive targets. Despite the marked clinical heterogeneity of SLE, machine learning applied to this data surfaced a shared, reproducible signature that robustly discriminates between SLE and healthy controls in two validation cohorts. Autoreactivities in SLE were significantly enriched for RNA-binding protein targets. Autoreactive proteins containing Basic Acidic Dipeptides (BAD) repeat domains, features associated with biomolecular condensate formation, distinguished patients with high disease activity (by SLEDAI score) from patients with no disease activity. Among all shared autoreactivities, a peptide derived from YTHDF2 emerged as the most prevalent target across SLE cohorts occurring in ~25% of SLE patients and displayed striking sequence similarity to a peptide derived from the Epstein Barr virus (EBV) lytic switch protein BZLF1. Competition assays demonstrated higher-affinity binding to the viral peptide, supporting a model in which antiviral humoral responses to EBV may drive secondary epitope spreading toward molecularly mimicked self-antigens. Remarkably, orthogonal validation using the Luminex bead platform containing a panel of only 10 peptides, including BZLF1, demonstrated strong discrimination between SLE and healthy controls (AUC = 0.95). Together, these findings identify a rich, greatly expanded landscape of autoreactivities in SLE, candidate biomarkers associated with high disease activity, and provide mechanistic insight linking EBV-driven immunity to epitope-specific autoimmunity in lupus.
items.authors: Hurabielle, C.; Wang, Y. V.; Castillo-Rojas, B.; Wang, C.-Y.; Caspar, C.; Asaki, J.; Dayao, M.; Calcoen, M.; Merrill, E. D.; Bodansky, A.; Klepper, A.; Chung, E. N.; Vissers, C.; Zorn, K. C.; Anderson, M. S.; Wilson, M.; Izmirly, P.; Buyon, J.; Yazdany, J.; Dall'Era, M.; Ye, C. J.; DeRisi, J. L.
items.title_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮线性表位纵向分析识别新抗原
items.summary_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种典型的系统性自身免疫疾病，以产生针对多种自我抗原的自身抗体为特征。抗核抗体（ANA）是SLE诊断的核心，抗双链DNA抗体（anti-dsDNA）用于监测疾病活动。然而，这些生物标志物仅提供了患者自身免疫变化的部分视角。为了扩展与疾病活动相关的SLE自身反应性知识，我们对695名SLE患者和301名健康对照的1,268份SLE血浆样本进行了无偏见的表征，采用了噬菌体免疫沉淀和测序（PhIP-seq）技术。结果显示，SLE患者的自身反应性在RNA结合蛋白靶标上显著富集，且含有基本酸性二肽（BAD）重复结构的自身反应性蛋白能够有效区分高疾病活动（根据SLEDAI评分）的患者。

items.title: The helminth-derived effector protein HpBARI trimerises to selectively target membrane bound ST2 receptor
items.abstract: The ST2 receptor is activated by the alarmin cytokine IL-33, inducing and controlling immune responses. ST2-mediated signalling contributes to protection from parasitic infection, but is also involved in asthma, inflammatory bowel disease, fibrosis and allergic inflammation, making inhibitors of ST2 desirable. While signalling is mediated by membrane-associated ST2 on immune cells, extracellular fluids also contain a soluble form of ST2 which acts as a decoy, soaking up IL-33. An effective ST2-targeting therapeutic will selectively target membrane-associated ST2. The intestinal helminth H. polygyrus bakeri suppresses ST2-mediated signalling to reduce helminth clearance from the gut, with the effector HpBARI2 directly binding to and inhibiting ST2. Here, we present the structure of the ST2:HpBARI2 complex. HpBARI2 forms a stable, planar trimeric structure, with three vertices each binding a single ST2. HpBARI2 occludes the IL-33 binding site of ST2 and constraints the receptor in a conformation incompatible with recruitment of signalling co-receptor IL-1RAcP. The trimeric valency of HpBARI2 results in preferential binding to multiple membrane-associated ST2 molecules rather than the soluble decoy receptor. Therefore, HpBARI2 combines steric blockade, conformational restriction and multivalent binding to potently and selectively inhibit ST2 signalling in the context of soluble ST2. This insight will guide design of improved therapeutics which target ST2.
items.authors: Jamwal, A.; Ong, N.; McSorley, H. J.; Hodge, S.; Higgins, M. K.
items.title_zh: 蠕虫衍生效应蛋白HpBARI选择性靶向膜结合ST2受体
items.summary_zh: ST2受体由警报素细胞因子IL-33激活，调控免疫反应。ST2介导的信号传导在寄生虫感染防护中发挥作用，但也与哮喘、炎症性肠病、纤维化和过敏性炎症相关，因此ST2抑制剂备受关注。肠道蠕虫H. polygyrus bakeri通过抑制ST2介导的信号传导来减少肠道内蠕虫的清除，效应蛋白HpBARI2直接结合并抑制ST2。我们展示了ST2:HpBARI2复合物的结构，HpBARI2形成稳定的平面三聚体结构，每个顶点结合一个ST2。HpBARI2遮蔽了ST2的IL-33结合位点，并限制受体处于与信号共受体IL-1RAcP结合不兼容的构象。HpBARI2的三聚体价态使其优先结合多个膜结合ST2分子，而非可溶性诱饵受体。因此，HpBARI2通过立体阻塞、构象限制和多价结合有效且选择性地抑制ST2信号传导。

items.title: CHAIR an antigen-resolved antibody-reactome resource for healthy adult immune aging
items.abstract: Antigen-recognition histories accumulate across adult life, but existing human aging resources largely emphasize host-state measurements rather than antigen-resolved humoral memory. We present CHAIR, the Chinese Healthy Aging Immune Resource, which integrates self-antigen, human virome and toxin/virulence-factor PhIP-seq with routine clinical measurements and T/B/NK phenotyping in clinically screened adults aged 20-94 years. The resource framework includes 1,008 unique PhIP-seq samples, 995 clinical records, 977 T/B/NK records and 853 participants with all three layers. Across modeled spaces comprising 23,584 self-antigen targets, 210 virome targets and 1,258 virulence-factor source targets, most measured antibody-reactivity architecture was consistent with broad preservation within domains, whereas age- and sex-associated signals were concentrated in focal targets and modules. Together, CHAIR provides a traceable, antigen-resolved reference framework based on clinically screened adults for investigating focal humoral remodeling across healthy adult aging.
items.authors: Sundell, G. N.; Chen, M.; Sha, Z.; Sun, X.; Yao, J.; Liu, J.; Hu, C.; Xu, H.; Dai, J.; Qi, H.; Ma, M.; Wu, J.; Li, Y.; Guo, S.; Lin, J.; Sheng, H.; Tao, S.-C.
items.title_zh: CHAIR：健康成人免疫衰老的抗原解析抗体反应资源
items.summary_zh: 抗原识别历史在成年生活中不断积累，但现有的人类衰老资源主要强调宿主状态测量，而非抗原解析的体液记忆。我们提出了CHAIR，即中国健康老龄化免疫资源，整合了自我抗原、人类病毒组和毒素/致病因子PhIP-seq，结合常规临床测量和T/B/NK表型分析，研究对象为20至94岁经过临床筛查的成年人。该资源框架包括1,008个独特的PhIP-seq样本、995份临床记录、977份T/B/NK记录，以及853名同时具备三层数据的参与者。在涵盖23,584个自我抗原靶标、210个病毒组靶标和1,258个致病因子源靶标的建模空间中，大多数测量的抗体反应结构在领域内保持广泛一致，而与年龄和性别相关的信号则集中在特定靶标和模块上。CHAIR为研究健康成人衰老过程中的体液重塑提供了可追溯的抗原解析参考框架。

items.title: Early-life adversity alters the adult blood proteome primarily in female mice
items.abstract: Background: Early-life adversity (ELA) is one of the strongest predictors of poor mental and physical health later in life, increasing an individual's risk for disorders ranging from depression to metabolic syndrome. However, whether and how ELA shapes immune memory through adulthood, subsequently affecting susceptibility to immune-associated diseases such as autoimmunity, remains elusive. Methods: To address this question, we employed a translationally and ethologically relevant mouse model of resource deprivation, the limited bedding and nesting model, to study the long-term effects of ELA on the immune system. ELA was induced by limited bedding and nesting material in the cage during postnatal days (P)2-9, which provokes fragmented and unpredictable maternal behavior in the dams, and results in chronic stress in the pups. Nucleic acid Linked ImmunoSandwich Assay (NULISA) was used to survey the proteome of adult (~P90) mice of both sexes that experienced ELA vs. control conditions. Results: Using a novel proteomic method, we detected significant upregulation in the levels of IL-17A in the adult blood, primarily in females. Within females, ELA also upregulated IL-13 and CCL3. Three proteins, HGF, PDGFA, and WNT16, were significantly downregulated in ELA mice of both sexes. Conclusions: Being a hallmark proinflammatory cytokine, IL-17A is found to increase in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), as well as in animals with lupus-like diseases in virtually all reports. Importantly, autoimmune diseases like SLE have a higher prevalence in women than men, and our data support this sex bias. Together, our data suggest that ELA shapes long-term immune function in a way that may increase risk for autoimmune diseases, with promise for the development of more targeted and personalized therapies for autoimmunity.
items.authors: Garvin, M. M.; Kim, A. R.; Bolton, J. L.; Liang, Y.
items.title_zh: 早期生活逆境改变成年小鼠血液蛋白组，主要影响雌性小鼠
items.summary_zh: 背景：早期生活逆境（ELA）是预测成年后心理和身体健康不良的重要因素，增加个体患抑郁症和代谢综合征等疾病的风险。研究ELA如何影响免疫记忆及其对自身免疫等免疫相关疾病的易感性仍不明确。方法：本研究采用有限床垫和巢材模型，模拟资源匮乏的环境，研究ELA对免疫系统的长期影响。ELA通过在出生后第2至9天限制床垫和巢材，导致母鼠行为不稳定，幼鼠经历慢性压力。使用核酸连接免疫夹心测定法（NULISA）分析经历ELA与对照条件的成年小鼠（约P90）血液蛋白组。结果：我们发现成年小鼠血液中IL-17A水平显著上调，主要在雌性小鼠中。雌性小鼠中，ELA还上调了IL-13和CCL3，而HGF、PDGFA和WNT16三种蛋白在ELA小鼠中显著下调。结论：IL-17A作为一种典型的促炎细胞因子，在系统性疾病患者中水平升高。

items.title: Can Large Language Models Diagnose Primary Immunodeficiency from Patient-Described Symptoms?
items.abstract: Patients with primary immunodeficiency (PI) face prolonged diagnostic delays and may increasingly turn to large language models (LLMs) to interpret their symptoms during this period. We evaluated whether an LLM could recognize PI from symptom descriptions derived from interviews with 21 PI patients. In prior work, we showed that GPT-4o identified PI in 96% of cases when prompted with physician-written patient histories (Rider et al., 2025). Here, when prompted with symptom descriptions in patients' own words, GPT-5.2 identified PI in only 7 cases (33%), although it suggested general immune system concerns in 17 cases (81%). This expert-versus-patient gap may indicate that LLMs are sensitive to the language and framing of symptom descriptions, performing substantially worse when patients describe their own symptoms in everyday language than when clinicians summarize patient histories in structured medical terms. This study underscores the need to carefully evaluate how LLMs are used in patient-facing applications.
items.authors: Reteig, L. C.; Woloshin, S.; Maglione, P. J.; Farmer, J. R.; Ong, M.-S.
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否根据患者描述的症状诊断原发性免疫缺陷？
items.summary_zh: 原发性免疫缺陷（PI）患者面临较长的诊断延迟，可能会越来越依赖大型语言模型（LLMs）来解读症状。我们评估了LLM是否能从21名PI患者的症状描述中识别PI。在之前的研究中，我们发现GPT-4o在医生撰写的病史提示下，识别PI的准确率为96%（Rider等，2025）。而在本研究中，当使用患者自述的症状描述时，GPT-5.2仅在7例（33%）中识别出PI，尽管在17例（81%）中提出了一般免疫系统问题。这一专家与患者之间的差距表明，LLMs对症状描述的语言和框架非常敏感，患者用日常语言描述症状时表现明显不佳。本研究强调了在患者面对的应用中，需谨慎评估LLMs的使用。
items.l1_lead: 大型语言模型在识别原发性免疫缺陷患者自述症状时表现不佳，仅能准确识别33%的病例，提示需谨慎评估其在临床应用中的有效性。
items.l2_summary: 原发性免疫缺陷（PI）患者在确诊过程中常常面临较长的延迟，因此他们可能越来越依赖大型语言模型（LLMs）来帮助解读自身症状。为了评估LLMs在这一领域的有效性，我们对21名PI患者的症状描述进行了研究。在之前的研究中，发现GPT-4o在医生撰写的病史提示下，能够以96%的准确率识别PI（Rider等，2025）。然而，在本次研究中，当使用患者自述的症状描述时，GPT-5.2仅在7例（33%）中成功识别出PI，尽管在17例（81%）中提出了一般免疫系统问题。这一结果显示出专家与患者之间的显著差距，表明LLMs对症状描述的语言和框架非常敏感。当患者使用日常语言描述症状时，LLMs的表现明显不佳。这项研究强调了在患者面对的应用中，需谨慎评估LLMs的使用，尤其是在症状描述的准确性和有效性方面。

items.title: Mental Stress-Induced Myocardial Ischemia and Cardiovascular Events in Women after a Premature Myocardial Infarction: A Prospective Cohort Study
items.abstract: Background. Women with premature myocardial infarction (MI) have worse outcomes than similarly aged men despite less severe disease, and stress-related factors have been implicated. We examined sex differences in the association of mental stress-induced myocardial ischemia (MSIMI) with cardiovascular outcomes after premature MI and explored vascular and inflammatory mechanisms.
