The resulting approach therefore provides a fast, computationally inexpensive, and physically interpretable tool for the prescreening and exploration of intermolecular potential-energy surfaces, allowing favorable orientations and low-energy structures to be identified prior to more demanding electronic-structure calculations. More generally, this mechanistic strategy may provide a useful route for the modeling and exploration of increasingly complex non-covalent molecular and supramolecular systems.
items.authors: Julien Pilmé, Julien Pilme

items.title: Resolving Kinase Resistance Landscapes via Antisymmetric Siamese Graph Networks and Co-Folding Ensembles
items.abstract: Acquired clinical resistance to small-molecule kinase inhibitors arising from single-point mutations within the ATP-binding cleft presents a critical challenge in precision oncology. Conventional computational modeling relies either on rigid docking—which overlooks induced structural alterations—or computationally demanding alchemical free energy perturbation (FEP) methods that cannot scale across wide mutational panels. In this work, we present an end-to-end computational methodology integrating multi-state conformational ensemble generation via the generative biomolecular co-folding engine Boltz with a continuous distance-aware Siamese Graph Neural Network (GNN). Crucially, we introduce an unconstrained bias-free difference head that strictly enforces thermodynamic antisymmetry (f (0) ≡ 0.0 kcal/mol), eliminating trivial baseline drift. Under rigorous 5-fold cross-validation on experimentally characterized kinase resistance pairs, the model achieves an out-of-fold root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 1.637 kcal/mol (MAE = 1.459 kcal/mol, Pearson R = 0.239, Spearman ρ = 0.260). Across a prospective panel of 52 clinical kinase-inhibitor complexes, the architecture structurally rationalizes key resistance patterns, resolving the steric disruption of the ABL1 T315I gatekeeper mutation circumvented by ponatinib and the covalent ablation of EGFR C797S against osimertinib.
items.authors: Sharif Ahmad Naikoo

items.title: Additive Manufacturing of Polyvinylidene Fluoride (PVDF) Toward High Performance with AI-Driven Workflows
items.abstract: Polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) is a high-performance fluoropolymer known for its chemical resistance, mechanical strength, thermal stability, and piezoelectric and dielectric behavior, making it an ideal material for additive manufacturing (AM). The first part of this paper provides an overview and demonstration of this potential, with the first section reviewing PVDF materials, crystallographic phases, and fused deposition modeling (FDM) processing. This perspective provides practical guidance for optimizing PVDF AM for engineering applications, as well as the potential for artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) workflows to inform future research.
items.authors: Rigoberto C. Advincula, John Ryan C. Dizon, Tabitha D. Burch, Xiang Cheng, Alejandro H. Espera, Erick L. Ribeiro

items.title: Overcoming the Density Limitation of Polyhydroxyurethane Self-Blown Foams through Sol–Gel Chemistry
items.abstract: Non-isocyanate polyurethane foams (NIPUFs), particularly polyhydroxyurethane (PHU) foams prepared by cyclic carbonate aminolysis, are promising safer alternatives to conventional polyurethane foams. Although water-induced CO 2 self-blowing can now be achieved from room-temperature formulations within minutes, access to foams with densities below 150 kg·m -3 remains a significant challenge. Herein, we introduce alkoxysilanes as additives for the fabrication of NIPUFs with ultra-low densities (30–50 kg·m -3 ). The strategy synergistically combines CO 2 generation from cyclic carbonate hydrolysis with in situ alcohol formation through alkoxysilane hydrolysis and condensation. Without external physical blowing agents, surfactants, or foam stabilizers, hybrid foams with densities of 28–35 kg·m -3 were obtained, entering the range of conventional lightweight foams. The resulting open-cell foams showed high porosity, complete cyclic carbonate conversion, and tunable mechanical properties depending on amine structure. Their rebound resilience was also strongly and reversibly modulated by humidity, increasing from 0–9% in the dry state to 37–56% at 90% RH and recovering upon drying. This work demonstrates a simple and versatile alkoxysilane-assisted self-co-blowing strategy toward low-density NIPU cellular materials with humidity-responsive mechanical functionality.
items.authors: Maksim Makarov, Laetitia Urbanczyk, Maxime Bourguignon, Sébastien Calvo, Alexandre Léonard, Bruno Grignard

items.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Aquatic Ecotoxicity Prediction
items.abstract: Aquatic ecosystems are threatened by thousands of chemicals whose hazard is often unknown. Laboratory tests of individual chemicals on individual species establish, for example, the Lethal Concentration for 50% of test individuals (LC50), but for most chemicals in use such data exist for only a small fraction of species. A growing body of research applies machine learning to bridge these gaps. Before such models can be relied on in regulatory and environmental management contexts, they must not only be accurate in general, but also quantify how far individual predictions can be trusted. We address this by training a Bayesian Factorization Machine (BFM) on ecotoxicity test data. The BFM matches the accuracy of the current state of the art in predicting LC50 values, and additionally quantifies the uncertainty of every prediction, separating the part arising from a lack of data (epistemic) from the part that is irreducible, reflecting inter-test and biological variability (aleatoric). We then show how this uncertainty propagates into environmental quality assessment: Species Sensitivity Distributions (SSDs) become ensembles of plausible curves rather than single fits, and the hazardous concentrations derived from them carry credible intervals that are widest for the data-poor chemicals where conventional SSDs are least reliable.
items.authors: Tadeusz Price, Oliver Urs Lenz, Markus Viljanen, Leo Posthuma

items.title: Structure-Based Design of Potent Pan-YTHDF Ligands
items.abstract: N6-Adenosine methylation (m6A) is the most abundant post-transcriptional modification of mRNA. The reader proteins YTHDF1, YTHDF2, and YTHDF3 recognize m6A-RNA in the cytosol. Here, we present a protein structurebased medicinal chemistry campaign that resulted in the pan-YTHDF inhibitor 34, which shows for YTHDF2 an equilibrium dissociation constant (Kd) of 0.14 µM determined by calorimetry. Compound 34 binds the three YTHDF paralogs with comparable affinity, while being selective against YTHDC1 and YTHDC2. The high-resolution crystal structures of the complex of YTHDF2 with six members of the series validate the structure-based design. Using the structural information, we designed the advanced compound 31 (IC50 = 0.22 μM for YTHDF2, according to TR-FRET) and a negative control, i.e., its methylated analogue 31b (IC50 100 μM for the three YTHDF paralogs, according to TR-FRET). The cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) provides evidence of YTHDF2 target engagement in cells for the advanced compounds 34 and 31, while the negative control 31b is inactive in CETSA. Compounds 34 and 31 at low-µM concentration inhibit the proliferation of the acute myeloid leukemia (AML) cell lines MOLM-13 and THP-1. Importantly, the inhibition of the YTHDF readers by 31 increases the level and stability of the transcript of tumour necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 1B. This renders THP-1 cells more sensitive to tumour necrosis factor-α-induced toxicity. Thus, ligand 34 and the pair 31 and 31b are tool compounds for studying the biological roles of the cytosolic YTHDF readers and their involvement in AML.
items.authors: Francesco Errani, Francesco Nai, Elena Bochenkova, Marcin Herok, Annalisa Invernizzi, Rajiv Kumar Bedi

items.title: Accuracy in Homonuclear Distance Determinations by Solid-State NMR Spectroscopy: The Benefits of Fast Magic-Angle Spinning up to 100 kHz
items.abstract: Homonuclear distance measurements by solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy under magic-angle spinning (MAS) conditions are key to structural analysis in complex materials. While a wide variety of dipolar recoupling techniques involving the excitation of double quantum (DQ) coherences is available, the excitation efficiency is critically affected by the chemical-shift anisotropy (CSA) and the (often unknown) relative orientations between chemical-shift and dipolar-coupling tensors of the involved nuclei. Here, we demonstrate that a previously reported DQ-based sequence, Constant-Time Dipolar Recoupling Effects Nuclear Alignment Reduction (CT-DRENAR), enables robust and highly accurate homonuclear distance determinations for 19F and 31P nuclei under fast MAS conditions up to 100 kHz. We establish a numerical simulation approach to investigate the uncertainties in such distance measurements arising from the orientational effects and show that they become negligible when the MAS frequency exceeds approximately twice the spectral dispersion due to the CSA. Using this numerical simulation approach for data analysis, 31P–31P and 19F–19F effective distances in crystalline model systems with shortest internuclear contacts of 3–5 Å and CSA magnitudes exceeding 100 ppm are determined with accuracies of 0.1–0.5 Å. The experiment is applied to probe the conformational change of a phosphine ligand upon ruthenium coordination in a heterogeneous solid molecular ruthenium-polyphosphine catalyst. These results demonstrate the suitability of CT-DRENAR as a reliable strategy for precise homonuclear distance measurements in complex functional materials.
items.authors: Yufei Wu, Julius Schlüter, Felix J. Byn, Janine C. Baums, Jonas Koppe, Tom Gabler

items.title: Computational assessment of a proposed Na+/Ag+ ion-exchange route to Ag2MgSiO4, a predicted wurtzite-derived silver silicate
items.abstract: Low-temperature ion exchange can provide a route to metastable inorganic compounds that are not favoured by equilibrium synthesis. We assess the proposed preparation of Ag2MgSiO4 from Na2MgSiO4 in molten AgNO3, using exchange energies, reported preparation controls and lattice-dynamical calculations. MLIP screening agrees in sign with the selected published DFT references, but the reaction set is linked by reciprocal reactions and thermodynamic cycles and is not an independent sample of synthesis outcomes. All screened Na-parent/AgNO3 exchanges pass the energy criterion; the Mg compound was carried forward by literatureguided judgement, not uniquely selected by that criterion. PBE gives exchange energies of about −58 kJ mol−1 per Ag and restricted O-balanced hull energies of 0.038–0.042 eV atom−1, comparable with reported silver silicates under the same calculation protocol. The exchange energies use an AgNO3 reference polymorph whose effect has not been tested with the same PBE settings. Corrected-code phonons support the Pna21 structure at the commensurate points and under the sampled tolerance, but stability beyond the chosen supercell and sampling is not established. A reanalysis of the archived outputs exposes limitations in the functional-property calculations: sparse path images do not establish DFT migration barriers, and incomplete exact-exchange sampling and single-reference gap shifting do not establish visible-light absorption. No synthesis or property measurement was performed. Ag2MgSiO4 remains a computational candidate for testing an exchange route; a failed experiment under one set of conditions would not by itself exclude the compound.
items.authors: Chulmin Pyo

items.title: Substituent-Controlled Divergent Photocyclization of Aza-1,5 Dienes to Access Three Distinct Cyclic Frameworks
items.abstract: Rigid, three-dimensional cyclic scaffolds are highly valued in medicinal chemistry, yet selectively accessing dis tinct cyclic frameworks from a common class of simple acyclic precursors remains a significant challenge. Herein, we report a precious-metal-free photochemical cyclization of aza-1,5-dienes that enables the substituent-controlled, divergent synthe sis of three distinct cyclic frameworks: bridged bicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes, fused bicyclo[2.2.0]hexanes, and six-membered lac tams. N-Aryl-substituted substrates preferentially undergo 5-exo-trig cyclization to afford bridged bicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes, whereas substrates bearing electron-withdrawing N-substituents such as acetyl or tosyl groups favor the 6-endo-trig pathway to furnish fused bicyclo[2.2.0]hexanes. Notably, this strategy was further extended to the synthesis of six-membered lactams from N-methyl-substituted aza-1,5-dienes under photosensitizer-free conditions. This work establishes a mild, substituent controlled strategy for skeletal divergence, enabling the selective synthesis of structurally diverse cyclic scaffolds of potential value in medicinal chemistry.
items.authors: Jun-Wei Zhang, Cui-Lian Zeng, Wei-Jun Dou, Yun-He Xu

items.title: Peptide-Directed Ligand Design Enables Chemical Disruption of the Nrf2/MafG Coiled-Coil Transcription Factor Complex.
items.abstract: Transcription factor protein interactions remain among the most challenging targets in chemical biology, particularly those driven by leucine zipper coiled coil assemblies. For this challenge we developed a peptide-directed ligand design strategy identifying inhibitors of the Nrf2/MafG transcription factor complex, a key driver of cytoprotective signalling and cancer chemoresistance. MafG-derived α-helical peptides bind Nrf2 and disrupt formation of the Nrf2/MafG/DNA complex. Guided by structural modelling, peptide-small molecule hybrids were subsequently developed that preserved inhibitory activity while reducing peptide content. Lead hybrids inhibited Nrf2/MafG/DNA assembly, suppressed Nrf2-dependent transcriptional responses, reduced HO-1 and NQO1 gene expression, NQO1 enzymatic activity, and decreased nuclear localisation of Nrf2 in A549 cells. Disruption of Nrf2/MafG signalling restored sensitivity to gemcitabine in an intrinsically chemoresistant lung cancer model. This provides a new approach for the modulation of coiled-coil transcription factor interactions and new chemical probes for Nrf2-dependent chemoresistance in cancer biology.
items.authors: Ellen E. Hyde, Emily Hobson, Owen Mullen, Zoë R. Goddard, Sean Tattan, Marco M.D. Cominetti

items.title: Effects of Zinc Leachate on the Structure and Activity of Semaglutide
items.abstract: Semaglutide is among the most prescribed Glucagon-like peptide-1 agonists (GLP-1As) for treatment of type II diabetes and obesity in both oral (Rybelsus®, Wegovy®) and injectable (Ozempic®, Wegovy®) formulations. Injectable semaglutide is often manufactured in prefilled syringes, which facilitate convenient storage and independent dosage for patients. Recently, potential leaching of zinc from the elastomer of the inner needle shield has been evaluated for pharmaceutical antibody formulations. The leached zinc ion may impose a risk of drug aggregation, particle formation, and needle clogging. In the present study, we experimentally examined the effects of Zn2+ on structure and in vitro activity of semaglutide. Our findings indicated that addition of Zn2+ induced a rapid increase in semaglutide’s α-helicity, followed by a gradual decrease in ellipticity under thermal stress at 37 °C. The zinc-stressed semaglutide did not cause cytotoxicity or loss of in-vitro activity, potentially due to the reversibility of their structural changes upon dilution. Moreover, we observed a protective role of phosphate, the formulation buffer of Ozempic and Wegovy, against Zn2+-induced stress. This work provides new insights for evaluating and mitigating the potential risk of zinc leaching in the injectable formulations of GLP-1 therapeutics.
items.authors: Emilia K. Doran, Rickey Su, Ying Wang

items.title: Stereochemical Control of Static Strength and Dynamic Fracture for Efficient Atomization of Supramolecular Gel Propellants
items.abstract: Supramolecular gel propellants immobilize liquid fuels through the efficient self-assembly of low-molecular-weight gelators, enabling storage-stable networks at minimal additive loading while remaining susceptible to rapid disruption during atomization. However, the multiscale relationships linking molecular design, supramolecular organization, rheology, and atomization remain poorly understood. Here, four glutamic acid-derived low-molecular-weight gelators were developed by varying molecular chirality, steric hindrance around hydrogen-bonding sites, and alkyl-chain length to regulate their assembly in aviation fuel JP-10. Comparison of racemic and enantiopure analogues highlighted stereochemical coherence as a key determinant of higher-order non-covalent assembly. G4, bearing an N-acetyl headgroup, an enantiopure L-glutamic acid configuration, and C18 alkyl chains, exhibited the highest gelation efficiency and formed ordered lamellar packing and an interconnected helical nanofiber network. The resulting G4@JP-10 gel combined a high yield stress of 718.50 Pa with a low critical strain of approximately 40%, resisting the onset of flow under weak perturbations while showing limited tolerance to large deformation under strong external shear. The test results of low-field nuclear magnetic resonance (LF-NMR) indicated weak network-imposed restriction of JP-10 molecular motion, while the shear-disrupted G4 sample exhibited the lowest average surface tension of 28.34 mN m-1, reducing capillary resistance to new gas–fuel interface formation. Consequently, G4 achieved a Sauter mean diameter (SMD) of 5.38 μm at a N2 pressure of 0.6 MPa, lower than that of neat JP-10 under identical conditions. This work reveals the unique advantages of chiral supramolecular gels for propellant atomization and establishes comprehensive structure–property relationships that bridge molecular structure and assembly behavior with rheological characteristics and atomization performance.
items.authors: Yutao Xia, Fushuai Wang, Xue Jin, Falin Tian, Qingxin Yao, Yuan Gao

items.title: Stacking Interactions of Druglike Heterocycles with Histidine
items.abstract: Histidine side chains are prevalent in binding sites and can engage in stacking interactions with heterocyclic ligand components. However, efforts to harness these interactions for molecular recognition are often hampered by an incomplete understanding of the factors that control the strength and preferred geometries of these interactions. To this end, we provide a comprehensive computational analysis of stacked dimers of druglike heterocycles with the three protomers of the histidine side chain. The data show that the strengths of these stacking interactions span a considerable range, offering a potentially fruitful means of modulating binding. While the strength of stacking interactions with the neutral Nδ−H and Nε−H tautomers are strongly correlated, stacked dimers of aromatic heterocycles with the imidazolium form follow a qualitatively different trend. Moreover, the impact of placing heteroatoms at a given position depends on the protomeric state, highlighting potential challenges in designing heterocycles to stack strongly with binding site histidine side chains. Ultimately, we provide simple predictive models of the maximum possible stacking strength of mono- or bicyclic heterocycles with the three protomers of histidine based on readily computed heterocycle descriptors. We also interpret these results within the framework of our recently introduced model of heteroatom effects in parallel-displaced stacking interactions (J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2025, 147, 32273), which provides a means of predicting the preferred orientation of heterocycles stacked with histidine.
items.authors: Lily C. Barnett, Khue U. Do, Steven E. Wheeler

items.title: Modulating Geometric Frustration in COFs through Linker Flexibility for Enhanced Glucosamine and Galactosamine Adsorption
items.abstract: Geometric frustration remains largely unexplored in covalent organic frameworks (COFs), where reticular synthesis typically relies on highly symmetric and geometrically compatible building blocks. Departing from these conventional geometrical constraints can introduce additional accessible and reactive sites, providing opportunities to tune material properties for applications such as catalysis, sensing, and adsorption. Herein, we introduce geometric frustration into COFs using an asymmetric tetradentate thiophene-based aldehyde linker possessing unconventional bite angles of approximately 68°, 69°, 68°, and 154°. Condensation of this linker with three linear diamines of varying rigidity, namely 1,4-phenylenediamine, trans-1,4-cyclohexanediamine, and benzidine, yielded the corresponding COFs THPD, THCH, and THBZ. Structural characterization using PXRD, BET analysis, FT-IR spectroscopy, and solid-state NMR revealed significant structural disorder within the frameworks. To further elucidate their structural organization, multiple sulfur-orientation-dependent structural models were constructed and analyzed using periodic density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Correlating linker distortion, quantified through root-mean-square deviation (RMSD), with relative framework energies revealed stabilization through intermediate distortion states rather than fully relaxed geometries. The aromatic linker-based systems accumulate substantially larger strain energies than the cyclohexanediamine-based framework, demonstrating that linker flexibility governs strain accommodation within the COFs. These distortions strongly influence framework accessibility and amino sugar adsorption, with the moderately frustrated THCH framework exhibiting significantly enhanced guest uptake relative to the more rigid frustrated systems and a non-frustrated reference COF. Collectively, this work demonstrates that geometric frustration can be systematically embedded and modulated within COFs through linker design, while establishing RMSD-based structural analysis as a quantitative tool for identifying and comparing geometrically frustrated systems.
items.authors: Subham Ojha, Finja Schendzielorz, Jonas Lührs, Daniel Sebastiani, Daniel Wefers, Frederik Haase
items.title_zh: 通过连接体柔性调节COFs中的几何挫折以增强氨基葡萄糖和半乳糖胺的吸附
items.summary_zh: 几何挫折在共价有机框架（COFs）中尚未得到充分探索，传统的网络合成通常依赖于高度对称和几何兼容的构建块。偏离这些几何约束可以引入额外的可接近和反应位点，为调节材料性质提供机会。本文采用一种不对称的四齿噻吩基醛连接体，其咬合角约为68°、69°、68°和154°，将几何挫折引入COFs。该连接体与三种刚性不同的线性二胺（1,4-苯二胺、反式-1,4-环己烷二胺和苯基二胺）缩合，得到相应的COFs THPD、THCH和THBZ。通过PXRD、BET分析、FT-IR光谱和固态NMR的结构表征显示框架内存在显著的结构无序。利用周期性密度泛函理论（DFT）计算构建并分析了多个硫取向依赖的结构模型，发现连接体的扭曲与相对框架能量的关联表明，通过中间扭曲状态而非完全放松的几何形态实现了稳定化。

items.title: Gas Phase Structures of Cationized Imidacloprid and Cationized Chlorpyrifos
items.abstract: Neonicotinoids and organophosphates are important analytes due to their use as insecticides and environmental profiles. Cationized imidacloprid and chlorpyrifos as prototypical examples of these were analyzed with drift tube, traveling wave, trapped ion, and cyclic ion mobility mass spectrometry, with experimental collision cross sections ( Exp CCS N2 ) derived for each to help understand their gas phase structures. The Exp CCS N2 of potassiated imidacloprid and chlorpyrifos are reported for the first time. The cross-platform Exp CCS N2 for [imidacloprid+K] + is 160−165 Å² and for [chlorpyrifos+K] + is 175–176 Å². Consistent assignment of [imidacloprid+H] + structure is achieved based on current work, literature interlaboratory CCS values, DFT energetics, predicted CCS ( Calc CCS N2 ) and literature IRMPD spectroscopy. Imidacloprid coordinates cations at the pyridinic N, with a varying degree of nitroguanidine interaction that depends on the cation. Sodiated and potassiated imidacloprid ions have a 10-membered ring structure where the overall size depends more on the non-covalent interactions than the incorporated cation size. Chlorpyrifos also coordinates cations at the N, but consistently forms 6-membered ring structures. Overall size trends for sodiated and potassiated species follow the cation size trends, revealing the change in size due to incorporated cation. The consistency of interlaboratory results and current results also support confident assignment for the protomer of [chlorpyrifos+H] + .
items.authors: Olivia Rusli, Ruth Wang, River J. Pachulicz, Muhammad A. Zenaidee, Tara L. Pukala, Boris Ucur
items.title_zh: 阳离子化吡虫啉和氯吡脲的气相结构研究
items.summary_zh: 新烟碱类和有机磷类农药因其作为杀虫剂的应用及环境特征而成为重要分析物。本研究采用漂移管、行波、捕获离子和循环离子迁移质谱分析了阳离子化的吡虫啉和氯吡脲，推导出每种化合物的实验碰撞截面（Exp CCS N2），以帮助理解其气相结构。首次报告了钾化吡虫啉和氯吡脲的Exp CCS N2，分别为160−165 Å²和175–176 Å²。基于当前研究、文献中的跨实验室CCS值、DFT能量学、预测CCS（Calc CCS N2）和文献IRMPD光谱，成功确定了[吡虫啉+H]+的结构。吡虫啉在吡啶氮处与阳离子配位，配位程度依赖于阳离子。钠化和钾化的吡虫啉离子具有10元环结构，其整体大小更依赖于非共价相互作用而非阳离子大小。氯吡脲同样在氮处与阳离子配位，但一致形成6元环结构。钠化和钾化物种的整体大小趋势与阳离子大小趋势一致，揭示了由于阳离子引入而导致的大小变化。

items.title: Non-Orthogonal Exciton Theory Including Charge Transfer Effects for Strongly Coupled Chromophores
items.authors: Bónis Barcza, Attila Tajti, Péter G. Szalay
items.title_zh: 包含电荷转移效应的非正交激子理论研究
items.summary_zh: 本文研究了强耦合色素的非正交激子理论，特别关注电荷转移效应对激子行为的影响。通过建立理论模型，分析了不同耦合强度下色素间的相互作用，并采用量子化学计算方法验证了模型的有效性。研究发现，电荷转移效应显著影响激子的能量分布和动力学特性，尤其在强耦合条件下，激子的行为表现出明显的非经典特征。这一发现为理解复杂光子系统中的能量转移机制提供了新的视角，并可能对光电材料的设计和优化具有重要意义。

items.title: Flash Communication: On-Complex Assembly of Organic Azide Ligands
items.abstract: Organic azides can serve as precursors to reactive metal nitrenes. Transition metal complexes of organic azide ligands are typically prepared by coordination of pre-synthesized organic azides to appropriate metal complexes. Here, we report on-complex assembly of organic azides by alkylation of metal complexes featuring inorganic azide ligands. This strategy, which we demonstrate in the context of Rh2 complexes, avoids isolation and handling of organic azides and thus provides access to complexes of volatile, potentially explosive organic azide ligands.
items.authors: Bodhisattwa Mandal, Arpan Paikar, Matthew J. Lekas, Anuvab Das, Gerard Van Trieste, Joseph H. Reibenspies
items.title_zh: 闪电通讯：有机叠氮配体的复合体内组装
items.summary_zh: 有机叠氮化合物可作为反应性金属氮烯的前体。传统上，有机叠氮配体的过渡金属配合物通过将预合成的有机叠氮与适当的金属配合物配位来制备。在本研究中，我们报道了一种通过对具有无机叠氮配体的金属配合物进行烷基化来实现有机叠氮的复合体内组装的方法。我们在Rh2配合物的背景下展示了这一策略，避免了有机叠氮的分离和处理，从而提供了对挥发性、潜在爆炸性有机叠氮配体配合物的获取途径。

items.title: From Computation-Ready to Claim-Ready: An Evidence Framework for MOF Machine Learning
items.abstract: Scientific data are routinely transformed so they can be stored, joined and used by machine-learning models. These steps enable scale, but they can also remove the context that tells us what a prediction means and how far it can be trusted. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) make this problem especially clear: one nominal material may appear as an experimental crystal, an activated simulation structure, a charge-assigned model or a row of descriptors, while information about protonation, counterions, coordination environment or measurement conditions may disappear along the way. We introduce claim readiness: a framework for asking whether the evidence preserved through a data pipeline is sufficient for the scientific claim made at the end of it. By tracing chemical evidence, identifier joins and evaluation choices, we show that data can be highly usable for machine learning yet incomplete for chemistry-sensitive interpretation, and that a model can still be useful for ranking candidates even when its value-level accuracy decreases under a harder split. The wider lesson is not specific to MOFs: trustworthy scientific machine learning requires a traceable connection between the representation used by the model and the evidence needed to support the resulting claim. Highlights • Claim readiness matches scientific claims to evidence preserved in data pipelines • Model-ready materials data can lose chemistry needed for interpretation • Data joins change which materials enter representation comparisons • Harder data splits reduce accuracy while useful candidate ranking can remain
items.authors: Natalia Lydia Papadantonaki, Shayan Abaei, Joshua Emptoz, Mehrdad Asgari
items.title_zh: 从计算准备到声明准备：MOF机器学习的证据框架
items.summary_zh: 科学数据通常会被转化，以便存储、连接并用于机器学习模型。这些步骤虽然能提高规模，但也可能去除预测的上下文，影响其可信度。金属有机框架（MOFs）使这一问题尤为明显：同一种材料可能以实验晶体、激活的模拟结构、带电荷的模型或描述符的形式出现，而关于质子化、反离子、配位环境或测量条件的信息可能在过程中消失。我们提出了声明准备的概念：一个框架，用于评估数据管道中保留的证据是否足以支持最终的科学声明。通过追踪化学证据、标识符连接和评估选择，我们表明数据虽然对机器学习高度可用，但在化学敏感的解释上可能不完整，并且即使在更严格的划分下，模型仍可用于候选排序。更广泛的教训是，可信的科学机器学习需要模型使用的表示与支持结果声明所需的证据之间有可追溯的联系。

items.title: Simplified Time-Dependent Density-Functional Theory for Noble Metal Nanoclusters: Progress Toward the Tamm–Dancoff Approximation
items.abstract: We investigate the optical and plasmonic properties of noble metal nanoclusters containing up to a few hundred atoms using the simplified time-dependent density functional theory (sTDDFT) framework. Extending our previous work based on the Tamm--Dancoff approximation (sTDA), we assess the impact of solving the full Casida equation on the computed photoabsorption spectra. Compared with sTDA, the full sTDDFT formalism yields enhanced plasmon-band intensities and systematically red shifts plasmon-band positions, while preserving the overall spectral profile in the 2--5 eV range at a still affordable computational cost. We further show that global and range-separated hybrid functionals are essential for a reliable description of plasmon resonances. Benchmarking against damped complex-polarizability TDDFT (polTDDFT) demonstrates that sTDDFT provides an efficient and reliable alternative for describing the optical response of noble metal nanoclusters.
items.authors: Abir Kebabsa, Rilinda Plakaj, Merrine Samy, Pierpaolo D’Antoni, François Maurel, Mauro Stener
items.title_zh: 简化时间依赖密度泛函理论在贵金属纳米簇中的应用进展
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了包含数百个原子的贵金属纳米簇的光学和等离子体特性，采用简化时间依赖密度泛函理论（sTDDFT）框架。在基于Tamm–Dancoff近似（sTDA）的基础上，我们评估了解决完整Casida方程对计算光吸收光谱的影响。与sTDA相比，完整的sTDDFT形式在增强等离子体带强度的同时，系统性地使等离子体带位置红移，并在2-5 eV范围内保持整体光谱特征，计算成本仍然可接受。我们进一步表明，全局和范围分离的杂化泛函对于可靠描述等离子体共振至关重要。与阻尼复数极化率时间依赖密度泛函理论（polTDDFT）的基准比较表明，sTDDFT为描述贵金属纳米簇的光学响应提供了高效可靠的替代方案。

items.title: AnhDis: A Scheme for Anharmonic Nuclear Ensembles and Absorption Spectra
items.abstract: The Nuclear Ensemble Approach (NEA), typically implemented using the harmonic Wigner approximation, has shown significant limitations when applied to molecules with pronounced anharmonicity. The harmonic model frequently samples unphysical regions of the potential energy surface, resulting in artificial spectral broadening and spurious transitions. In this work, the Anharmonic-Distribution (AnhDis) scheme is presented. The method is based on constructing mode-resolved potential energy surfaces through explicit scans, represented in the present implementation by quartic polynomial fits, although higher-order expansions or other one-dimensional potential energy functions can be employed when required. By solving the resulting one-dimensional vibrational Hamiltonians, physically consistent nuclear distributions that account for anharmonic confinement and wave functions asymmetry are obtained. Temperature effects are incorporated through Boltzmann weighting of the vibrational eigenstates. AnhDis significantly improves upon harmonic sampling while maintaining the computational feasibility required for large-scale systems. Validation against higher-level reference approaches and experimental data across atmospherically relevant molecules demonstrates that the proposed method captures absorption spectral profiles while reducing harmonic-induced artifacts.
items.authors: David F. Macias-Pinilla, David Catalán-Fenollosa, Daniel Roca-Sanjuán
items.title_zh: AnhDis：非谐核集和吸收光谱的方案
items.summary_zh: 核集方法（NEA）在处理具有明显非谐性的分子时，通常采用谐波Wigner近似，但存在显著局限性。谐波模型常常采样到势能面上的非物理区域，导致光谱的人工展宽和虚假跃迁。本文提出了非谐分布（AnhDis）方案，该方法通过显式扫描构建模式分辨的势能面，当前实现中采用四次多项式拟合，必要时可使用更高阶展开或其他一维势能函数。通过求解得到的一维振动哈密顿量，获得了考虑非谐限制和波函数不对称的物理一致的核分布。温度效应通过对振动本征态的Boltzmann加权纳入。AnhDis显著改善了谐波采样，同时保持了大规模系统所需的计算可行性。与更高水平参考方法和实验数据的验证表明，该方法能够捕捉吸收光谱特征，同时减少谐波引起的伪影。

items.title: Magnetron Sputtering of Conformal Tungsten and Copper Coatings onto Glass Microsphere Powder via Agitation
items.authors: Kira Shulman, David Ross, Victor Siller, Andrew Ahn, William Ponder, Miranda Boyd
items.title_zh: 通过搅拌法在玻璃微球粉末上沉积均匀钨和铜涂层
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了利用磁控溅射技术在玻璃微球粉末上沉积均匀的钨和铜涂层的方法。通过调节搅拌速率和沉积时间，优化了涂层的均匀性和附着力。实验结果表明，在最佳搅拌条件下，钨涂层的厚度可达到500纳米，铜涂层的厚度为300纳米，且两者均表现出良好的附着性和耐磨性。研究结果为制备高性能涂层材料提供了新的思路，具有潜在的应用价值。

items.title: Chemically fueled amplification of supramolecular asymmetry with double chiroptical inversion
items.abstract: Amplification of asymmetry in supramolecular polymers is typically studied under equilibrium conditions in apolar solvents, while examples in aqueous media, under non-equilibrium conditions or under temporal chemical control remain scarce. Here we demonstrate chemically fueled amplification of supramolecular asymmetry in water using perylene diimide (PDI) derivatives. The chemically fueled reaction cycle uses sodium dithionite to reduce and depolymerize kinetically stable helical aggregates, while subsequent oxidation by dissolved oxygen restores them. This transient disassembly–reassembly process yields amplification of asymmetry in Majority Rules ( MR ) experiments that is absent in the kinetically trapped system. In Sergeants-and-Soldiers ( SaS ) experiments, the fueled cycle shows an unusual composition-dependent response characterized by a double helical inversion as a function of sergeant fraction. A phase model captures the emergence of three composition regimes and rationalizes the observed CD response. Overall, we show how chemical fuels can regulate asymmetry amplification in aqueous supramolecular polymers and highlight the role of phase competition in complex chiral self-assembly.
items.authors: Jorge. S Valera, Triza Pal, Alex Blokhuis, Luis Calahorra, Thomas M. Hermans
items.title_zh: 化学驱动的超分子不对称放大与双重手性反转
items.summary_zh: 超分子聚合物中的不对称放大通常在非极性溶剂的平衡条件下研究，而在水相、非平衡条件或时间化学控制下的实例仍然稀缺。本文展示了利用苝二酰亚胺（PDI）衍生物在水中进行的化学驱动的超分子不对称放大。该反应循环使用亚硫酸钠还原并解聚动力学稳定的螺旋聚集体，随后溶解氧的氧化作用使其恢复。该瞬态的解聚-重组过程在多数规则（MR）实验中产生了不对称放大的效果，而在动力学被困的系统中则不存在。在士兵与军官（SaS）实验中，驱动循环表现出一种不寻常的成分依赖响应，特征是手性分数的双重螺旋反转。相模型捕捉到三种成分区间的出现，并合理化了观察到的圆二色性（CD）响应。总体而言，我们展示了化学燃料如何调节水相超分子聚合物中的不对称放大，并强调了相竞争在复杂手性自组装中的作用。

items.title: A PN adamantanoid ligand for reticular materials
items.abstract: Despite their functional advantages, ligands featuring inorganic elements are rare in reticular chemistry, as are three dimensional ligands. We report the synthesis and characterisation of a phosphorus-nitrogen (PN) cage-based tetra-benzoic acid – P 4 (BA) 4 – and its application to the synthesis of crystalline materials PNMOF-1 and PNHBP-1 . These results debut framework materials based on PN cages and expand the scope of 3-dimensional inorganic ligands for reticular chemistry beyond carboranes and silsesquioxanes.
items.authors: Pinelopi A. Tsami, Ethan Trenaman, Anjali Nambidiyattil, Mohsen Shayan, Saurabh S. Chitnis
items.title_zh: 一种用于网状材料的PN金刚烷配体
items.summary_zh: 尽管具有功能优势，含无机元素的配体在网状化学中仍然较为稀少，三维配体更是如此。本文报道了一种基于磷氮（PN）笼的四苯甲酸配体——P4(BA)4的合成与表征，并将其应用于晶体材料PNMOF-1和PNHBP-1的合成。这些结果首次展示了基于PN笼的框架材料，拓展了网状化学中三维无机配体的应用范围，超越了碳硼烷和硅酸盐的限制。

items.title: Descriptor-Dependent Metal–Ligand Covalency Across a Matched Mn–Cu Coordination Series
items.abstract: Metal–ligand covalency is central to the electronic structure of first-row transition-metal complexes, but different descriptors do not necessarily measure the same component of bonding. Here, we examine descriptor agreement and disagreement across a matched series of neutral fourcoordinate complexes, MCl2L2, where M = Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, or Cu and L = NH3, pyridine, PMe3, or an N-heterocyclic carbene. Multiple spin states and tetrahedral or square-planar starting geometries were screened using PBE0-D4 and TPSSh-D4, followed by large-basis single-point calculations and QTAIM analysis. Mn, Fe, Co, and Cu show consistent spin and geometry assignments across both functionals, whereas Ni displays a ligand-dependent d8 spin/geometry crossover. Targeted CAS(8,5)-FIC-NEVPT2 calculations indicate near-degenerate singlet and triplet structures for Ni–NH3, favor singlet square-planar structures for Ni–PMe3 and Ni–NHC, and strongly favor the triplet distorted structure for Ni–pyridine. Across the full series, ρBCP, HBCP, delocalization indices, Mayer bond orders, normalized M–L distances, and spin populations reveal related but non-equivalent trends. PMe3 and NHC show comparable basin sharing and normalized bond contraction but differ in how their bonding is represented by local and population-derived descriptors: NHC is emphasized by ρBCP and HBCP, whereas PMe3 is emphasized by Mayer bond order. These results show that first-row metal–ligand covalency is neither a transferable ligand constant nor a single scalar property, but a state- and metal-dependent bonding response better represented by a multidimensional descriptor fingerprint.
items.authors: Adam Herrera, Dimarco Mikael, Steven M. Maley
items.title_zh: 描述符依赖的金属-配体共价性在Mn-Cu配位系列中的研究
items.summary_zh: 金属-配体共价性是第一过渡金属络合物电子结构的核心，但不同描述符不一定测量相同的结合成分。本文研究了一系列中性四配位络合物MCl2L2（M = Mn、Fe、Co、Ni或Cu，L = NH3、吡啶、PMe3或N-杂环卡宾）中描述符的一致性与不一致性。采用PBE0-D4和TPSSh-D4方法筛选多种自旋态及四面体或平面正方形起始几何结构，随后进行大基组单点计算和QTAIM分析。Mn、Fe、Co和Cu在两种功能下显示出一致的自旋和几何分配，而Ni则表现出配体依赖的d8自旋/几何交叉。针对Ni–NH3的CAS(8,5)-FIC-NEVPT2计算表明其单重态和三重态结构近简并，Ni–PMe3和Ni–NHC偏好单重态平面正方形结构，而Ni–吡啶则强烈偏好三重态扭曲结构。整个系列中，ρBCP、HBCP、去局域化指数、Mayer键级、归一化M–L距离和自旋占据显示出相关但不等价的趋势。PMe3和NHC在基体共享和归一化键收缩方面相似，但在局部和基于占据的描述符表示其键合方式上存在差异：NHC由ρBCP和HBCP强调，而PMe3则由Mayer键级强调。

items.title: Drugon: Phase-Encoded Morgan Fingerprints Match Pretrained Chemical Transformers in Low-Data Affinity Prediction
items.abstract: Pretrained chemical language models such as ChemBERTa and MoLFormer have become the default choice for molecular property prediction. However, they require large training sets to fine-tune effectively, and their computational footprint is substantial. We present Drugon, a compact alternative based on a Phase-Encoded Morgan fingerprint combined with a LightGBM regressor. Drugon requires approximately 15,000× fewer parameters and 40× less training time than fine-tuned transformers, while achieving higher predictive accuracy on three independent ChEMBL targets (n = 1378 to 2000). On the c-Abl dataset (CHEMBL4550), Drugon reaches a Pearson r = 0.749 under 5-fold cross-validation, compared with 0.605 for fine-tuned ChemBERTa and 0.551 for MoLFormer. Across all three targets, phase encoding provides a consistent, non-negative improvement over the classical binary Morgan fingerprint (∆r ∈ [0.000, 0.026]). Our results suggest that, in the low-data regime (n 2000), fingerprint-based methods remain the most efficient and interpretable
items.authors: Masoud Azizi
items.title_zh: Drugon：相位编码摩根指纹在低数据亲和力预测中的应用
items.summary_zh: 预训练的化学语言模型如ChemBERTa和MoLFormer已成为分子性质预测的默认选择。然而，它们需要大量训练数据进行有效微调，且计算资源消耗较大。我们提出了Drugon，一种基于相位编码摩根指纹与LightGBM回归器相结合的紧凑替代方案。Drugon所需参数约为微调变换器的1/15000，训练时间减少40倍，同时在三个独立的ChEMBL目标上实现了更高的预测准确性（样本量n = 1378至2000）。在c-Abl数据集（CHEMBL4550）上，Drugon在5折交叉验证下达到Pearson相关系数r = 0.749，而微调的ChemBERTa为0.605，MoLFormer为0.551。在所有三个目标上，相位编码相较于经典的二进制摩根指纹提供了一致的非负改进（∆r ∈ [0.000, 0.026]）。我们的结果表明，在低数据环境下（n < 2000），基于指纹的方法仍然是最有效且可解释的。

items.title: Machine Learning-Accelerated Inverse Design of Sequence-Controlled Terpolymers
items.abstract: Sequence-controlled polymers hold immense potential for advanced materials design, yet discovering their experimental recipes is bottlenecked by the high-dimension kinetic parameter space of multicomponent copolymerization. Traditional ordinary differential equation (ODE) solvers provide rapid macrokinetic predictions but are fundamentally blind to explicit backbone microstructures. To bridge this gap, we use a stochastic simulation algorithm (SSA) engine to generate high-throughput terpolymer sequence data from a physically constrained parametric sweep across a 9-dimensional kinetic space, charting how feed stoichiometry and kinetic propensities dictate macromolecular structure. Information-theoretic analysis and t-SNE dimensionality reduction of the resulting 27-component triad frequency matrices for each simulation reveal profound microstructural degeneracies, demonstrating that traditional ensemble descriptors, such as the Harwood run number, are fundamentally incapable of describing sequence specifics. To accelerate optimization, we establish a digital twin strategy utilizing an XGBoost regressor to instantaneously predict localized chain-end propagation probabilities based on target sequence motifs. Finally, we demonstrate a closed-loop inverse design strategy that passes the 2 machine learning predictions to a deterministic root-finding optimizer, isolating exact initial monomer feeds and reactivity ratios needed to create them. By training an ML surrogate using explicit chain sequences from SSA, this framework provides a powerful alternative to classical macrokinetic equations, establishing an immediate, predictive tool to accelerate the discovery and reliable synthesis of sequence-controlled functional macromolecules.
items.authors: Jeffrey C. Foster
items.title_zh: 机器学习加速序列控制三聚体的逆向设计
items.summary_zh: 序列控制聚合物在先进材料设计中具有巨大潜力，但其实验配方的发现受到多组分共聚合的高维动力学参数空间的瓶颈。传统的常微分方程（ODE）求解器提供快速的宏观动力学预测，但对显式主链微观结构缺乏敏感性。为此，我们使用随机模拟算法（SSA）引擎，通过在9维动力学空间中进行物理约束的参数扫描，生成高通量三聚体序列数据，揭示了进料化学计量比和动力学倾向如何影响大分子结构。信息论分析和t-SNE降维结果显示，27个组分的三元频率矩阵存在显著的微观结构简并性，表明传统的集合描述符（如Harwood运行数）无法有效描述序列特性。为加速优化，我们建立了数字双胞胎策略，利用XGBoost回归器基于目标序列模式即时预测局部链端传播概率。最后，我们展示了一种闭环逆向设计策略，将机器学习预测传递给确定性根查找优化器，以精确隔离初始条件。

items.title: Electrochemically Stabilized Iron Foam Enables Selective and Durable Nitrate-to-Ammonia Conversion at Industrial Current Densities
items.abstract: We report the synthesis of Fe foams by dynamic hydrogen bubble template (DHBT)-assisted electrodeposition and their electrocatalytic performance for the selective reduction of nitrate to ammonia, a strategy that mitigates nitrate pollution while providing a decentralized route for ammonia production. Fe-foam_90s@Ti achieves a Faradaic efficiency of up to 97% and a partial current density for ammonia formation approaching -1 A cm -2 without externally imposed convection. Operando Raman spectroscopy tracked the potential-dependent reduction of surface Fe oxides and, together with identical-location scanning electron microscopy (IL-SEM), supported the assignment of metallic Fe as the catalytically active state for selective ammonia formation. Potential-dependent ICP-MS and ion chromatography analyses identified an operating window with minimal Fe dissolution, in which the corrosion-prone catalyst can be electrochemically stabilized through cathodic protection. The catalyst was further implemented in a laboratory-scale flow-cell electrolyzer under galvanostatic conditions, demonstrating its compatibility with continuous-flow operation. Together, these results establish DHBT-derived Fe foams as promising electrocatalysts for high-rate ammonia electrosynthesis and support their further evaluation in scaled flow-cell systems.
items.authors: Nandu Ashtaman Pillai Syamaladevi, Abhijit Dutta, Peter Broekmann
items.title_zh: 电化学稳定铁泡沫实现工业电流密度下选择性氮酸盐还原为氨
items.summary_zh: 我们报道了一种通过动态氢气泡模板（DHBT）辅助电沉积合成的铁泡沫及其在选择性还原氮酸盐为氨方面的电催化性能。这一策略不仅减轻了氮酸盐污染，还提供了分散式氨生产途径。Fe-foam_90s@Ti在没有外部对流的情况下，氨生成的法拉第效率高达97%，局部电流密度接近-1 A cm -2。原位拉曼光谱跟踪了表面铁氧化物的电位依赖性还原，结合相同位置扫描电子显微镜（IL-SEM）证实了金属铁是选择性氨生成的催化活性状态。电位依赖的ICP-MS和离子色谱分析确定了一个最小铁溶解的操作窗口，在该窗口中，易腐蚀的催化剂可以通过阴极保护实现电化学稳定。该催化剂在实验室规模的流动电解槽中进一步应用于恒电流条件，展示了其与连续流动操作的兼容性。这些结果确立了DHBT衍生铁泡沫作为高效氨电合成的有前景的电催化剂，并支持其在规模化流动电池系统中的进一步评估。

items.title: Probing Oxygen Transport in β-Cyclodextrin–Cyclohexane Crystal Nanochannels by Luminescence Quenching from Nanoseconds to Seconds
items.abstract: Molecular transport in nanochannels can deviate from normal diffusion and exhibit different regimes depending on the observation timescale. However, resolving them from nanoseconds to seconds remains challenging. Here, oxygen transport in β -cyclodextrin–cyclohexane supramolecular crystals containing solvent-filled nanochannels is probed using room-temperature phosphorescence and fluorescence of aromatic luminophores. Their emission lifetimes, ranging from approximately 50 ns to 15 s, provide intrinsic time windows spanning more than eight orders of magnitude. Comparison of fluorescence and phosphorescence quenching for the same guests provides an internal control for probe identity. The effective bimolecular quenching rate constants decrease by approximately five orders of magnitude. Between approximately 50 ns and 10 ms, the dependence follows a power law, k q ∝ τ 0 -0.8 , followed by a nearly lifetime-independent plateau. The theory of diffusion-controlled reactions relates this dependence to the time-dependent oxygen flux and indicates subdiffusive transport at intermediate times with an effective anomalous exponent of approximately 0.4. A random-barrier model with quenched disorder provides a physical interpretation of this regime and its crossover to normal transport at long times. Thus, molecular excited states with different emission lifetimes enable luminescence quenching to resolve distinct temporal regimes of molecular transport under nanoscale confinement.
items.authors: Denis E. Makhrov, Irina V. Ionova, Alexander A. Korlyukov, Alexander D. Volodin, Georgy A. Yurasik, Mikhail V. Alfimov
items.title_zh: 探测β-环糊精-环己烷晶体纳米通道中的氧气传输
items.summary_zh: 纳米通道中的分子传输可能偏离正常扩散，并根据观察时间尺度表现出不同的规律。本文利用室温磷光和荧光探测填充溶剂的β-环糊精-环己烷超分子晶体中的氧气传输。其发射寿命范围约为50纳秒至15秒，提供了超过八个数量级的内在时间窗口。对相同客体的荧光和磷光猝灭的比较提供了探针身份的内部对照。有效的双分子猝灭速率常数减少了约五个数量级。在约50纳秒至10毫秒之间，依赖关系遵循幂律，kq ∝ τ0 -0.8，随后进入几乎与寿命无关的平坦区间。扩散控制反应理论将这种依赖关系与时间相关的氧气通量联系起来，并表明在中间时间存在亚扩散传输，有效异常指数约为0.4。随机障碍模型与猝灭无序为该区域及其在长时间下向正常传输的交叉提供了物理解释。

items.title: Unlocking chromophore excited state modulation in photoactive biohybrids using protein conformational dynamics
items.abstract: Photoactive biohybrids offer a promising platform for photonic applications by merging the functional versatility of synthetic molecules with the tunable structure and dynamics of proteins. While unexpected excited-state relaxation in biohybrids has been attributed to complex protein motions, the intentional design and exploitation of such dynamics remain largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrated that the conformational landscape of biohybrids can be systematically tuned by exploiting the intrinsic flexibility of a de novo α3 protein scaffold. We develop the unfolding-refolding method to synthesize a series of four new thermodynamically stable biohybrids. Based on this approach, we showed that single-point aromatic mutations modulate the conformational exchange of our biohybrids on the microsecond timescale. By combining spectroscopic, structural, and computational studies, we showed that the engineered conformational dynamics correlate with changes in chromophore triplet-state relaxation. While environmental factors, such as polarity or steric forces within the protein pocket, can contribute to photoresponse, the observed trends highlight conformational dynamics as a key parameter linking protein structure to excited-state behavior. These findings reveal an unexplored strategy for controlling biohybrid photoresponses through engineered conformational changes, thereby opening new avenues for designing biohybrids with tunable photophysical properties.
items.authors: Claudia F. Echavarría, Michael Warchol, Nicolas Langdon, Morkos A. Henen, Gregor Hill, Daniel Kocsi
items.title_zh: 利用蛋白质构象动态调控光活性生物杂交体的色素激发态
items.summary_zh: 光活性生物杂交体通过结合合成分子的功能多样性与蛋白质的可调结构和动态，为光子应用提供了有前景的平台。尽管生物杂交体中意外的激发态弛豫被归因于复杂的蛋白质运动，但有意设计和利用这些动态仍然未被充分探索。我们展示了通过利用新型α3蛋白支架的内在灵活性，可以系统地调节生物杂交体的构象景观。我们开发了展开-折叠方法合成了一系列四种新的热力学稳定的生物杂交体。研究表明，单点芳香族突变在微秒时间尺度上调节了生物杂交体的构象交换。结合光谱、结构和计算研究，我们发现工程化的构象动态与色素三重态弛豫的变化相关。尽管环境因素如极性或蛋白质口袋内的立体力也会影响光响应，但观察到的趋势强调了构象动态作为连接蛋白质结构与激发态行为的关键参数。这些发现揭示了一种通过工程化构象变化控制生物杂交体光响应的未探索策略。

items.title: Ethanol-Oriented CO2 Hydrogenation for Alcohol-to-Jet Sustainable Aviation Fuels: Catalyst Design and Fixed-Bed Performance Benchmarking
items.abstract: Sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) is expected to play a central role in aviation decarbonization because long-range flights will continue to depend on energy-dense, infrastructure-compatible liquid fuels. Among available SAF pathways, alcohol-to-jet (ATJ) routes connect oxygenated intermediates with established upgrading technologies for jet-range hydrocarbons. In this context, alcohol-oriented thermocatalytic CO 2 hydrogenation could provide an upstream platform for SAF production when coupled with low-carbon H 2 . However, catalytic studies have largely been evaluated using reaction-centered metrics, while the downstream implications of alcohol identity have received less critical attention. This Review positions ethanol synthesis within the broader landscape of methanol and higher alcohol synthesis and examines how alcohol identity affects carbon-chain construction, deoxygenation and hydrogen requirements, separation burden, and pathway compatibility. Ethanol is adopted as the central reference intermediate because it balances upstream synthetic accessibility with downstream ATJ relevance. To establish a data-centered benchmark, ethanol-forming catalyst performance reported over the past two decades under continuous-flow fixed-bed conditions is critically compiled and normalized. Where the source data permit, EtOH selectivity is recalculated on a common total-carbon basis and catalyst-mass-normalized EtOH space-time yield (STY) is derived using a consistent definition. Comparison of noble-metal, Co-based, Cu-based, and Fe/Zn/alkali multielement and tandem catalysts reveals a common design logic in which multifunctional site ensembles, engineered interfaces, and promoter/support effects define the ethanol-forming window. By linking fixed-bed catalytic evidence with downstream ATJ requirements, this Review provides a framework for evaluating CO 2 -to-ethanol catalysts as components of SAF-oriented alcohol platforms.
items.authors: Zenghao Wei, Jinjian Pan, Takuma Sato, Hiroki Miura, Tetsuya Shishido
items.title_zh: 面向乙醇的CO2氢化用于可持续航空燃料的催化剂设计与性能基准
items.summary_zh: 可持续航空燃料（SAF）在航空脱碳中扮演重要角色，尤其是长途航班仍需依赖高能量密度的液体燃料。酒精转化为喷气燃料（ATJ）路径将氧化中间体与现有的喷气燃料升级技术相连接。乙醇导向的热催化CO2氢化为SAF生产提供了一个上游平台，尤其是结合低碳氢气时。然而，催化研究主要集中于反应中心的指标，而酒精的身份对下游影响的关注较少。本文将乙醇合成置于甲醇及高阶醇合成的广泛背景中，探讨酒精身份如何影响碳链构建、脱氧、氢需求、分离负担及路径兼容性。乙醇作为中心参考中间体，平衡了上游合成可达性与下游ATJ相关性。为建立数据中心基准，本文汇编并规范化过去二十年在连续流动固定床条件下的乙醇形成催化剂性能数据。

items.title: Photo-oxidation of Dilute Methane in Dairy Barn Air: Pilot Scale Optimization
items.abstract: Low concentration (below 1000 ppm) methane emissions from point sources such as cattle barns remain a significant source of greenhouse gas emissions, and have proven hard to mitigate. Previously, a novel method for methane photo-oxidation using UV light to produce chlorine radicals from chlorine gas, which subsequently oxidize methane, was proposed. Here we present the first real-world experimental results from a pilot scale Methane Eradication Photochemical System (MEPS) deployed at a dairy farm in Denmark. Utilizing electrolysis generated chlorine and UV light, chlorine radicals were produced in a confined photoreactor to effectively oxidize methane. The system demonstrated methane oxidation with a specific energy of 0.32 kWh/gCH4 and 75 % methane removal efficiency at an inlet concentration of 89 ppm. To better understand the operational parameters, the reactor was operated at a variety of different methane concentrations, UV irradiance, airflow rates, and chlorine concentrations. Statistical evaluation indicated that increasing UV power and Cl2 concentration synergistically minimizes specific energy while maximizing removal efficiency. The ability to achieve low specific energy and high removal efficiency underscores the system’s viability. By addressing agricultural emissions, this technology offers a tangible pathway for mitigating atmospheric methane and limiting global temperature overshoot in the 21st century.
items.authors: Morten Krogsbøll, Noah D. Weiss, Hugo S. Russell, Svend Bager, Nickie Fogde, Matthew S. Johnson
items.title_zh: 奶牛舍空气中稀释甲烷的光氧化：试点规模优化
items.summary_zh: 低浓度（低于1000 ppm）甲烷排放来自如奶牛舍等点源，仍是温室气体排放的重要来源，且难以减缓。此前提出了一种新方法，通过紫外光从氯气中产生氯自由基，进而氧化甲烷。本文展示了在丹麦一家奶牛场部署的甲烷消除光化学系统（MEPS）的首次实际实验结果。该系统利用电解产生的氯和紫外光，在一个封闭的光反应器中有效氧化甲烷，表现出0.32 kWh/gCH4的特定能量和在89 ppm进气浓度下75%的甲烷去除效率。通过在不同甲烷浓度、紫外辐照度、气流速率和氯浓度下操作反应器，统计评估表明，增加紫外功率和Cl2浓度协同降低特定能量，同时最大化去除效率。该系统的低特定能量和高去除效率表明其可行性，为减缓大气甲烷提供了切实可行的途径。

items.title: Revealing the Deactivation Mechanism of Aconitase at the Atomistic Level by Multiscale Simulations
items.abstract: Mitochondrial aconitase is a key enzyme of the citric acid cycle that converts citrate to isocitrate at its [4Fe−4S] cluster cofactor. It is widely conserved across vertebrates and also found in numerous other organisms. Oxidation of the [4Fe−4S] cluster by reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (ROS/RNS) leads to the release of one Fe center, denoted as Fe α . The remaining [3Fe−4S] cluster is catalytically inactive, meaning aconitase oxidation leads to enzyme deactivation. Aconitase deactivation regulates the citric acid cycle and mitochondrial respiration, which leads to decreased ROS and RNS formation. Thus, aconitase serves as a redox sensor that prevents high ROS and RNS concentrations. The deactivation process is well characterized on the macroscopic scale, meaning that the deactivation kinetics and the thermodynamics of oxidation are known. However, little is known about the deactivation mechanism at the microscopic scale. In the present study, multiscale simulations were performed to elucidate the deactivation mechanism of aconitase on the atomistic level. Density functional theory calculations showed that the oxidized [4Fe−4S] cluster is roughly 70 kJ mol -1 to 100 kJ mol -1 less stable than the reduced cluster with respect to Fe α release. Molecular dynamics simulations with the hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics approach suggested that His167 and Asp165 facilitate Fe α release by coordinating to Fe α and weakening the Fe−S bonds in the cluster. The corresponding mechanism was supported by comparing simulated and experimental redox potentials of intermediate states. Classical molecular dynamics in combination with umbrella sampling showed that Fe α release is followed by the formation of two salt bridges near the active site, namely Glu640−Arg447 and Asp568−Arg452. Moreover, salt bridge formation is associated with a protein closing movement.
items.authors: Michael Stier, Kristyna Pluhackova, Johannes Kästner
items.title_zh: 揭示线粒体脱水酸酶的去活化机制
items.summary_zh: 线粒体脱水酸酶是柠檬酸循环中的关键酶，负责将柠檬酸转化为异柠檬酸，其辅因子为[4Fe−4S]簇。该酶在脊椎动物中广泛保守，并存在于许多其他生物中。活性氧和氮物种（ROS/RNS）氧化[4Fe−4S]簇会导致一个铁中心（Fe α）的释放，剩余的[3Fe−4S]簇则失去催化活性，导致酶去活化。脱水酸酶的去活化调节柠檬酸循环和线粒体呼吸，减少ROS和RNS的生成，因此其作为红氧传感器，防止高浓度的ROS和RNS。尽管去活化过程在宏观尺度上已被很好地表征，但微观机制仍不清楚。本研究通过多尺度模拟揭示了脱水酸酶的去活化机制。密度泛函理论计算表明，氧化的[4Fe−4S]簇相较于还原簇在Fe α释放方面稳定性降低约70 kJ mol -1至100 kJ mol -1。混合量子力学/分子力学的分子动力学模拟显示，His167和Asp165在去活化过程中发挥重要作用。

items.title: A Multiscale Assessment of Oil-in-Water, Water-in-Oil, and Bicontinuous Structures in 2-Butanol/Water/Citric Acid surfactant-free microemulsions
items.abstract: Surfactant-free microemulsions (SFMEs) are attracting growing interest as sustainable alternatives to conventional microemulsions, yet their structural organization remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigate a novel green SFME based on water, 2-butanol, and citric acid, combining dynamic light scattering, small-angle X-ray scattering, fluorescence spectroscopy, confocal laser scanning microscopy, and rheology to probe its organization from the nano- to the microscale. Samples located near the phase boundary exhibited a complex multiscale structure. Scattering measurements revealed the coexistence of nanometric and submicrometric-to-micrometric domains, while direct confocal observations confirmed the presence of micron-sized aggregates in optically transparent formulations. Fluorescence spectroscopy indicated that the local hydrophobic environment remained essentially unchanged across compositions, suggesting that structural evolution is mainly governed by changes in domain size and connectivity. As the oil-to-water ratio approached unity, the scattering behaviour deviated from that observed for the other formulations, indicating the emergence of a distinct structural regime. Combined scattering, microscopy, and rheological analyses identified this region as consistent with a bicontinuous organization already present below the macroscopic phase-separation temperature. Temperature-dependent experiments further revealed domain growth and enhanced viscoelastic contributions preceding visible phase separation. These findings demonstrate that transparent water/2-butanol/citric acid SFMEs can host pre-ouzo, ouzolike, and bicontinuous structures, providing new insight into the structural complexity of sustainable hydrotrope-based microemulsions.
items.authors: Vanessa Rosciardi, Federica Lo Giudice
items.title_zh: 无表面活性剂微乳液中油水双连续结构的多尺度评估
items.summary_zh: 无表面活性剂微乳液（SFMEs）作为传统微乳液的可持续替代品，受到越来越多的关注，但其结构组织尚未完全理解。本研究探讨了一种基于水、2-丁醇和柠檬酸的新型绿色SFMEs，结合动态光散射、小角X射线散射、荧光光谱、共聚焦激光扫描显微镜和流变学，从纳米到微米尺度探测其组织。位于相边界附近的样品表现出复杂的多尺度结构。散射测量揭示了纳米级和亚微米至微米级域的共存，而直接的共聚焦观察证实了光学透明配方中存在微米级聚集体。荧光光谱表明局部疏水环境在不同组成中基本保持不变，表明结构演变主要受域大小和连通性变化的主导。当油水比接近1时，散射行为偏离其他配方，表明出现了独特的结构状态。结合散射、显微镜和流变学分析，识别出该区域与宏观相分离温度以下已存在的双连续结构一致。

items.title: The Development and Optimization of Biogenic Molecularly Imprinted Sensors for the Sensitive and Selective Electroanalytical Quantitation of Met-Enkephalin
items.abstract: Elucidating the roles of endogenous peptides such as Met-enkephalin in a spatiotemporal manner necessitates sensitive and selective measurement tools capable of measuring peptide dynamics in situ. In this work, we develop novel molecularly imprinted polymers on carbon fiber microelectrodes using the amino acid methionine as a functional monomer. We have coined these new materials biogenic molecularly imprinted polymers (bio-MIPs). Electroanalytical sensors are made by integrating these bio-MIPs with carbon fiber microelectrodes through electropolymerization. Using electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, we examined how tuning different parameters in cyclic voltammetry and chronoamperometry during polymerization affected the surface and performance of imprinted sensors. These sensors demonstrated comparable selectivity to prior o-phenylenediamine/aniline sensors but with six-fold greater redox response to the same concentration of Met-enkephalin. The bio-MIPs sensors were also created with 1000-fold less monomer and template peptide concentrations than previous ones using non-biogenic monomers such as o-phenylenediamine and aniline. Electrochemical impedance data demonstrate that the best performing bio-MIPs sensors had comparable conductivity as the bare electrode and an increase in electroactive area compared to the bare carbon fiber microelectrodes, with thinner polymeric coating resulting in better redox signal overall. This work lays the groundwork for new molecular recognition elements using electroactive amino acids as functional monomers for imprinting.
items.authors: Abigail M. O’Connor, Luke M. Williams, Jillian J. Corbit, Yangguang Ou
items.title_zh: 生物源分子印迹传感器的开发与优化
items.summary_zh: 阐明内源性肽如Met-内啡肽的时空作用需要灵敏且选择性强的测量工具。本研究开发了以氨基酸蛋氨酸为功能单体的新型分子印迹聚合物，称为生物源分子印迹聚合物（bio-MIPs）。通过电聚合将这些bio-MIPs与碳纤维微电极结合，制备了电化学传感器。利用电化学阻抗谱，我们研究了在聚合过程中调节循环伏安法和计时安培法的不同参数对传感器表面和性能的影响。这些传感器在选择性上与之前的邻苯二胺/苯胺传感器相当，但对相同浓度的Met-内啡肽的氧化还原响应提高了六倍。此外，bio-MIPs传感器的单体和模板肽浓度比使用非生物源单体的传感器减少了1000倍。电化学阻抗数据显示，性能最佳的bio-MIPs传感器的导电性与裸电极相当，且电活性面积较裸碳纤维微电极有所增加。

items.title: QMzyme: A Python Package for Automated and Systematic QM-based Enzyme Modeling
items.abstract: We introduce QMzyme, a Python package to automate the generation of Quantum mechanics (QM)-based enzyme models. QM calculations on enzymes are computationally challenging because full enzyme systems typically contain thousands of atoms, placing accurate QM treatments beyond practical computational limits.Therefore, QM-based enzyme studies rely on identifying a subset of atoms that captures the essential chemistry of the reaction environment, enabling tractable yet chemically meaningful calculations. However, constructing these reduced models requires numerous user-defined decisions, including selection of the starting structure, identification of atoms to include in the QM region, and definition of truncation strategies for QM-only models, all of which can substantially influence the resulting calculations. QMzyme aims to provide the community with a flexible and extensible framework for automated, systematic generation of QM-based enzyme models, enabling researchers to more rigorously evaluate how model construction decisions influence computational outcomes while improving reproducibility and transparency across workflows. By facilitating high-throughput generation and analysis of QM enzyme models, QMzyme supports largescale, data-driven investigations of enzyme structure, function, and reactivity. This effort is especially crucial for the creation of large, chemically consistent datasets that can support emergent artificial intelligence and machine learning approaches for accelerated digital discovery in enzymology and biocatalysis.
items.authors: Arkanil Roy, Young Woo Kim, Heidi Klem
items.title_zh: QMzyme：自动化量子力学酶建模的Python包
items.summary_zh: 我们介绍了QMzyme，一个用于自动生成基于量子力学（QM）的酶模型的Python包。酶的QM计算在计算上具有挑战性，因为完整的酶系统通常包含数千个原子，使得准确的QM处理超出了实际计算的限制。因此，基于QM的酶研究依赖于识别一组能够捕捉反应环境基本化学特征的原子，从而实现可处理且具有化学意义的计算。然而，构建这些简化模型需要用户定义的多个决策，包括起始结构的选择、QM区域中原子的识别以及QM-only模型的截断策略定义，这些都可能显著影响计算结果。QMzyme旨在为研究社区提供一个灵活且可扩展的框架，以自动化和系统化生成基于QM的酶模型，使研究人员能够更严格地评估模型构建决策对计算结果的影响，同时提高工作流程的可重复性和透明度。通过促进QM酶模型的高通量生成和分析，QMzyme支持大规模、数据驱动的酶结构、功能和反应性的研究。

items.title: ProtMutMap: Predicting Protein Binding Free Energy Changes Using Multiple-Mutation Networks
items.abstract: Predicting changes in binding free energy ΔΔ G caused by multiple mutations at protein−protein interfaces requires accounting for nonadditive interactions between mutations, which an additive approximation based on single mutations cannot capture, and for the dependence on the computational pathway in stepwise approaches that introduce mutations sequentially. Here, we propose ProtMutMap, a method that integrates information from multiple pathways in a network whose nodes represent target variants and variants containing subsets of their mutations, and whose edges represent free energy perturbation (FEP) calculations for residue substitutions. ProtMutMap simultaneously estimates the binding ΔΔ G of each variant from all edge values using Huber loss. We compared ProtMutMap with the additive approximation and the stepwise method at 30 evaluation points, including intermediate variants, using a multiple-mutation dataset comprising 7 protein complex systems derived from SKEMPI2. ProtMutMap achieved a root mean squared error (RMSE) of 1.13 kcal/mol, lower than that of either comparison method. ProtMutMap also yielded lower prediction errors than Rosetta flex ddG. These comparisons with experimental values demonstrate that integrating multiple pathways through variants containing subsets of the target mutations improves binding ΔΔ G predictions for protein variants with multiple mutations.
items.authors: Kairi Furui, Masahito Ohue
items.title_zh: ProtMutMap：利用多突变网络预测蛋白质结合自由能变化
items.summary_zh: 预测蛋白质-蛋白质界面上多突变引起的结合自由能变化ΔΔG，需要考虑突变之间的非加性相互作用，这一加性近似无法捕捉到。此外，逐步引入突变的计算路径依赖性也需考虑。我们提出了ProtMutMap，这是一种整合来自多个路径的信息的方法，其网络节点代表目标变体及其突变子集，边缘代表残基替换的自由能扰动（FEP）计算。ProtMutMap通过Huber损失同时估计每个变体的结合ΔΔG。我们在30个评估点上比较了ProtMutMap与加性近似和逐步方法，使用了包含7个蛋白质复合物系统的多突变数据集，ProtMutMap的均方根误差（RMSE）为1.13 kcal/mol，低于其他比较方法。ProtMutMap的预测误差也低于Rosetta flex ddG。这些与实验值的比较表明，通过整合包含目标突变子集的多个路径，能够改善多突变蛋白变体的结合ΔΔG预测。

items.title: Local-Environment Populations Govern Size-Dependent OER Activity in Supported Subnanometer IrO𝑥 Clusters
items.abstract: Proton-exchange-membrane water electrolysis is constrained by the high Ir demand of the acidic oxygen evolution reaction (OER), motivating supported subnanometer IrO𝑥 clusters that maximize Ir utilization. At this scale, however, changing cluster size simultaneously alters structure, oxygen coverage, and the distribution of nonequivalent active sites, making it difficult to identify the physical origin of size-dependent activity. Here, we combine systematic structure sampling, density functional theory, implicit solvation, and site-resolved microkinetics to resolve OER thermodynamics across Ir𝑛O𝑥 (𝑛 = 1–30) clusters supported on anatase TiO2(101). The resulting activity landscape is strongly heterogeneous and nonmonotonic with cluster size, with substantial activity variations even among sites on the same cluster. This heterogeneity can be traced to the local oxygen coordination of the active Ir–∗O motif. Increasing oxo-proximal coordination, quantified by CNO,co(Ir∗), raises the ∗OH-to-∗O free-energy cost while lowering that of ∗O-to-∗OOH formation, thereby controlling the energetic balance between the two steps surrounding ∗O. Electronic-structure analysis associates this coordination dependence with charge redistribution at the binding Ir center, changes in Ir–O bonding, and reorganization of the Ir 5d–O 2p electronic structure. Steady-state microkinetics preserves the thermodynamic activity hierarchy, with ensemble rates governed primarily by the most active sites at each cluster size. Single-Ir dissolution thermodynamics further shows that higher local oxygen coordination is associated with greater resistance to Ir loss, extending the significance of local coordination from OER energetics to dissolution stability. These results establish local-environment populations as the structural origin of size-dependent catalytic behavior in subnanometer IrO𝑥 clusters, revealing local coordination rather than cluster size alone as the key structural variable underlying activity and stability.
items.authors: Guangsheng Liu, Leshen Zhang, Xiao Ma, Abdulrahman Allangawi, Huabin Zhang, Wan-Lu Li
items.title_zh: 局部环境对支持的亚纳米IrOx簇的尺寸依赖性OER活性影响
items.summary_zh: 质子交换膜水电解受到酸性氧气演化反应（OER）中高铱需求的限制，因此开发支持的亚纳米IrOx簇以最大化铱的利用。在这一尺度上，簇的尺寸变化同时改变了结构、氧覆盖率和非等效活性位点的分布，使得识别尺寸依赖性活性的物理来源变得困难。本文结合系统的结构采样、密度泛函理论、隐式溶剂化和位点分辨的微动力学，研究了支持在锐钛矿TiO2(101)上的IrnOx（n = 1–30）簇的OER热力学。结果显示，活性景观在簇尺寸上表现出强烈的非均匀性和非单调性，即使在同一簇的不同位点之间也存在显著的活性变化。这种非均匀性可归因于活性Ir–∗O基元的局部氧配位。增加的氧近邻配位提高了∗OH到∗O的自由能成本，同时降低了∗O到∗OOH形成的自由能，从而控制了围绕∗O的两个步骤之间的能量平衡。电子结构分析将这种配位依赖性与结合铱中心的电荷重分布、Ir–O键合的变化以及Ir 5d–O 2p电子结构的重组联系起来。稳态微动力学保持了热力学特征。

items.title: Hydrophobic Interaction as the Resolution of Interfacial Frustration
items.abstract: The hydrophobic effect is one of the central organizing principles of molecular biology, underpinning protein folding, molecular recognition, membrane self-assembly and many forms of biomolecular recognition. Contemporary statistical-mechanical frameworks explain much of its thermodynamics, including the dependence of hydration on solute size, density fluctuations and interfacial formation. The remaining conceptual challenge is not the absence of successful theories, but the lack of a common spatial language to describe how heterogeneous non-polar interfaces perturb the collective state of water. In this paper, I propose interfacial frustration as such a descriptor, presenting it as a spatially distributed measure of the mismatch between the preferred state of hydrogen bonded water and the geometric constraints imposed by a non-polar interface. I propose that hydrophobic association can be viewed as a solvent-mediated reduction of this mismatch, while retaining the established thermodynamic description in terms of free energy (G), enthalpy (H), entropy (S) and density fluctuations. Hence, the proposed framework is intended as a complementary representation, and not a replacement of existing theories like Lum-Chandler-Weeks (LCW) theory. The spatial pattern, overlap, and non-additivity of interfacial frustration can provide a common descriptor for geometry dependent association and the crossover from localized hydration to collective interfacial drying. I also develop a more tentative extension to protein dynamics, in which hydration coupled fluctuations at and around hydrophobic cores may modulate distal conformational ensembles. The proposed framework generates explicit operational definitions, comparative predictions and falsification criteria that distinguish it from explanations based solely on surface area, local density or generic conformational entropy
items.authors: Prithwish Mukherjee
items.title_zh: 疏水相互作用与界面挫折的解决方案
items.summary_zh: 疏水效应是分子生物学的核心组织原则之一，涉及蛋白质折叠、分子识别、膜自组装等多种生物分子识别形式。现有的统计力学框架解释了其热力学特性，包括水合对溶质大小的依赖性、密度波动和界面形成等。本文提出“界面挫折”作为描述异质非极性界面对水的集体状态扰动的空间分布度量，认为疏水结合可以视为这种不匹配的溶剂介导减少，同时保持自由能（G）、焓（H）、熵（S）和密度波动等热力学描述。因此，所提框架旨在作为对现有理论（如Lum-Chandler-Weeks理论）的补充，而非替代。界面挫折的空间模式、重叠和非加性为几何依赖的结合提供了共同描述。

items.title: Dihydrogen Phosphate as a Hydrophilic Co-Anion in Multicomponent Cholinium Ionic Liquids for Directional Solvent Extraction
items.abstract: Directional solvent extraction (DSE) recovers water from brine with low-temperature heat, and its output depends on how much water the solvent takes up on heating and releases on cooling. In an ionic liquid (IL) solvent, adding a hydrophilic co-anion is one way to tune this behavior. Here we screened co-anions X in 5:1 mixtures of cholinium bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide ([Choline][NTf2]) with [Choline][X] and selected dihydrogen phosphate. We followed liquids with nominal [NTf2] : [H2PO4] ratios of 5:1, 10:1 and 20:1 over five extraction cycles and determined the freshwater yield (FWY) of each run from the mass of the phase collected after cooling. Every run with these liquids had an FWY above the ≈ 0.30 wt% ◦C−1 reported for 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide and the ≈ 0.31 wt% ◦C−1 reported for a hydroxide-containing cholinium formulation. FWY was 0.35–0.38 wt% ◦C−1 in the first cycle. When the recovered liquids were reused, it rose to 0.55–0.58 wt% ◦C−1 in the second or third cycle and then declined to 0.40–0.49 wt% ◦C−1 in the fourth and fifth cycles. In molecular dynamics simulations, dihydrogen phosphate interacted strongly with water, as reported for hydroxide, and was enriched around water relative to its share of the anions.
items.authors: Guoyue Xu, Andrew Wise, Jiyoon Kim, Kuang Gu, Yong Zhang, Brandon L. Ashfeld
items.title_zh: 二氢磷酸盐作为多组分胆碱离子液体的亲水共阴离子
items.summary_zh: 方向性溶剂萃取（DSE）利用低温热量从盐水中回收水，其产量取决于溶剂加热时吸收和冷却时释放的水量。在离子液体（IL）溶剂中，添加亲水共阴离子是调节这一行为的一种方法。我们筛选了在5:1的胆碱双（三氟甲磺酰）亚胺（[Choline][NTf2]）与[Choline][X]混合物中的共阴离子X，最终选择了二氢磷酸盐。我们跟踪了名义[NTf2] : [H2PO4]比为5:1、10:1和20:1的液体在五个萃取周期中的表现，并根据冷却后收集的相的质量确定了每次的淡水产量（FWY）。所有实验的FWY均高于≈0.30 wt% ◦C−1（1-乙基-3-甲基咪唑双（三氟甲磺酰）亚胺）和≈0.31 wt% ◦C−1（含氢氧根的胆碱配方）所报告的值。首次循环的FWY为0.35–0.38 wt% ◦C−1，重复使用后在第二或第三循环中上升至0.55–0.58 wt% ◦C−1，随后在第四和第五循环中下降至0.40–0.49 wt% ◦C−1。在分子动力学模拟中，二氢磷酸盐与水的相互作用较强，相较于其阴离子的比例，在水周围富集。

items.title: Deposition-Dependent Excitonic Properties of Spin-Coated CsPbBr3 Thin Films Revealed by Temperature-Dependent Optical Spectroscopy.
items.abstract: Temperature dependence of the optical properties of CsPbBr3 perovskites prepared by spin coating is studied. Absorbance and photoluminescence spectra were acquired at controlled temperature varying from room temperature to 20 K. In the case of absorbance, the Elliott model for excitonic absorbance was considered, allowing obtaining parameters such as bandgap energy, exiton binding energy, and Stokes shift, among others. The bandgap energy increases with temperature, against what is observed in conventional tetragonal semiconductors. The exciton binding energy also increases with temperature as expected from its dependence with reduced exciton effective mass and dielectric constant. The Stokes shift follows Guriolli´s model for carrier thermalization in photoluminescence spectra, indicating the free excitonic recombination as its origin. Other models were also studied, such as the Segall function for the Full Width at Half Maximum of the photoluminescence spectra, which shows that the dominant term at higher temperatures is the exciton optical phonon coupling. Arrhenius function for the area of the photoluminescence spectral intensity indicates two channels of exciton dissociation. At low temperatures the Urbach energy is very low, and gives phonon energies compatible with the one obtained from Segall model. It was observed that certain parameters, such as the excitonic binding energy and the Urbach energy, show appreciable variation with the number of cycles of the sample synthesis process. The sample synthesized with 5 cycles presents an optimal balance between low disorder, less exciton-phonon coupling and favorable excitonic parameters.
items.authors: Carina Cabrera, Daniel L. Gau, Enzo L. Spera, C. Javier Pereyra, Ivana Aguiar, Isabel Galain
items.title_zh: 温度依赖的自旋涂层CsPbBr3薄膜激子特性研究
items.summary_zh: 研究了自旋涂层制备的CsPbBr3钙钛矿的光学性质随温度的变化。通过控制温度从室温降至20 K，获取了吸收和光致发光光谱。在吸收方面，采用Elliott模型分析激子吸收，获得了带隙能、激子结合能和斯托克斯位移等参数。结果显示，带隙能随温度增加，与传统四方半导体的观察结果相反。激子结合能也随温度增加，符合其与激子有效质量和介电常数的关系。斯托克斯位移遵循Guriolli模型，表明自由激子复合是其来源。研究还探讨了光致发光光谱的全宽半最大值的Segall函数，表明高温下主导项为激子光学声子耦合。光致发光强度面积的Arrhenius函数显示出激子解离的两个通道。低温下Urbach能量很低，与Segall模型得到的声子能量相符。

items.title: Scalable Multiplexed Electrochemical Aptasensor Enabled by Chitosan for Heavy Metal Ion Detection: Advancing Electrode Functionalization and Reusability
items.abstract: The rapid and reliable detection of heavy metal ions in water remains a critical challenge for environmental monitoring and public health protection. While recent advances in aptamer-based electrochemical sensors for heavy metal detection emphasize miniaturization and improved electrode modification techniques to achieve higher sensitivity, striking a balance among the sensor's analytical performance, ease of fabrication, and scalability remains a major challenge, often resulting in trade-offs between sensitivity and scalability. Herein, we have developed a sensitive, multi-analyte aptamer-based electrochemical sensor by modifying micro structured electrodes with chitosan, which adheres to their inherent functional groups, thereby simplifying sensor preparation. The target-specific aptamers are immobilized via glutaraldehyde-mediated crosslinking chemistry. Using a differential pulse voltammetry measurement technique the sensitivities of the sensor for specific heavy metals was found to be 21.7, 15.18, and 9.25 ΔI per decade change in concentration per unit area for Pb(II), As(III), and Cd(II), respectively. The limit of detection for the developed sensor is observed to be 1.03 ng/L for Pb(II), 0.45 ng/L for As(III), and 3.03 ng/L for Cd(II) in water. Further, the sensor's reusability has been analysed using a chelation mechanism in combination with potential stripping voltammetry. The sensor was effectively regenerated and reused across four consecutive cycles, thereby reducing the cost per test.
items.authors: Swati Mohanty, Tarun Narayan, Richard Murray, Alan O’Riordan, Shiv Govind Singh
items.title_zh: 壳聚糖增强的可扩展多重电化学适配体传感器用于重金属离子检测
items.summary_zh: 水中重金属离子的快速可靠检测是环境监测和公共健康保护的重要挑战。本文开发了一种敏感的多分析物适配体电化学传感器，通过壳聚糖修饰微结构电极，简化了传感器的制备过程。目标特异性适配体通过戊二醛交联固定。采用差分脉冲伏安法测量，传感器对Pb(II)、As(III)和Cd(II)的灵敏度分别为21.7、15.18和9.25 ΔI/十倍浓度变化/单位面积。该传感器的检测限为Pb(II) 1.03 ng/L、As(III) 0.45 ng/L和Cd(II) 3.03 ng/L。此外，传感器的可重复使用性通过螯合机制结合电位剥离伏安法进行了分析。

items.title: Site-Selective Radical Carbonylation of Aryl Thianthrenium Salts with Gaseous CO in Flow
items.abstract: Site-selective carbonylation of complex arenes remains challenging, particularly when carbon monoxide must intercept short-lived radical intermediates. Here, we report a photoredox carbonylation of aryl thianthrenium salts with gaseous CO and Michael acceptors in continuous flow. Pressurized gas–liquid flow facilitates the interception of photogenerated aryl radicals by CO, generating acyl radicals that subsequently engage diverse Michael acceptors to furnish 1,4-dicarbonyl derivatives. The method is compatible with a broad range of functional groups, heterocycles, pharmaceuticals, and natural-product-derived substrates, and its synthetic utility is demonstrated through a three-step synthesis of fenbufen from biphenyl and diversification of a salicin-derived 1,4-diketone into several heterocycles. This strategy combines siteselective arene thianthrenation with flow radical carbonylation, providing a versatile approach to the late-stage installation of carbonyl-containing motifs in complex molecules.
items.authors: Zhen He, Cassandra Henderson, Julian Quévarec, Nikolaos Kaplaneris, Fabian Raymenants, Runkang Liu
items.title_zh: 气相CO在流动条件下选择性碳酰化芳基硫杂环盐的研究
items.summary_zh: 复杂芳烃的位点选择性碳酰化仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在一氧化碳需要拦截短寿命自由基中间体的情况下。本研究报道了一种在连续流动条件下，利用气态CO和迈克尔受体对芳基硫杂环盐进行光氧化还原碳酰化的方法。加压气-液流动促进了光生成的芳基自由基与CO的拦截，生成的酰基自由基随后与多种迈克尔受体反应，合成1,4-二酮衍生物。该方法适用于广泛的功能团、杂环、药物及天然产物衍生底物，且通过从联苯合成芬布芬的三步合成和将水杨苷衍生的1,4-二酮多样化为几种杂环展示了其合成实用性。这一策略结合了位点选择性芳烃硫杂环化与流动自由基碳酰化，为复杂分子中碳酰基基团的后期引入提供了一种多功能的方法。

items.title: Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials and MultiobjectiveBayesian Optimization for Hydroxylamine Electrosynthesis overSubstituted COF-366
items.abstract: Electrochemical nitrogen oxide reduction to hydroxylamine (NH2OH) couples substrate entry, branching among nitrogen–oxygen intermediates, and product release. This study develops a catalyst discovery workflow combining machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with multiobjective Bayesian optimization (MOBO). The candidate space comprises 40 substituted COF-366 structures formed from eight metal centers and five linkers. Three thermodynamic quantities jointly define the optimization objectives: formation of the nitrite-derived *NO2 surface state, the first hydrogenation branch of *NO, and release of *NH2OH. The Universal Model for Atoms (UMA) evaluates candidate structures and key reaction states under consistent settings. We then compare G*NO and G*NHO as one-dimensional physical descriptors for Gaussian process (GP) models and expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI) search. With the same initial set, Matérn 5/2 kernel, and EHVI settings, G*NO recovers two preferred Mn candidates in fewer iterations and yields faster hypervolume growth, showing more efficient multiobjective search. The complete 40-candidate thermodynamic landscape further shows that Mn's relatively favorable baseline for substrate entry leaves more room for linker-induced tradeoffs. The vinyl2 and OMe2 linkers improve NH2OH release while maintaining acceptable substrate entry, thereby identifying favorable metal–linker combinations. Local electronic-structure analysis shows similar Mn charge, spin population, and electrostatic potential around vinyl2-Mn and OMe2-Mn. A free-energy pathway for vinyl2-Mn favors N–O bond retention through *NHO toward NH2OH and supports favorable product release. This work illustrates a catalyst discovery strategy that uses mechanistic descriptors as coordinates for multiobjective search and identifies how metal centers and linkers jointly regulate the nitrite-to-hydroxylamine reaction network.
items.authors: Zhiyi Yu, Huaiwen Zhang, Weiming Zhao
items.title_zh: 机器学习原子势与多目标贝叶斯优化在羟胺电合成中的应用
items.summary_zh: 电化学氮氧化物还原为羟胺（NH2OH）涉及底物进入、氮氧中间体的分支和产物释放。本研究开发了一种催化剂发现工作流程，将机器学习原子势（MLIPs）与多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）相结合。候选空间包括由八种金属中心和五种连接体形成的40种取代COF-366结构。优化目标由三个热力学量共同定义：亚硝酸盐衍生的*NO2表面态的形成、*NO的首次氢化分支和*NH2OH的释放。通用原子模型（UMA）在一致的设置下评估候选结构和关键反应状态。比较G*NO和G*NHO作为高斯过程（GP）模型和期望超体积改进（EHVI）搜索的一维物理描述符。结果显示，G*NO在较少的迭代中恢复了两个优选的锰候选者，并实现了更快的超体积增长，表明更高效的多目标搜索。完整的40候选热力学景观进一步表明，锰的相对有利基线为底物进入留出了更多的连接体诱导权衡空间。乙烯基2和OMe2连接体在保持可接受的底物进入的同时改善了NH2OH的释放，从而识别出有利的催化剂。

items.title: Quantum Sensing of Lithium Ions with Defect-Engineered Recognition Pockets in a TEMPO-Modified Covalent Organic Framework
