The two required precursors, sodium carbonate (from baking soda) and calcium acetate (from eggshells and vinegar), were prepared in house. A 16-factor design then tested how calcium source, solution temperature, citric acid addition, and mixing intensity affect morphology. Optical microscopy (400×) of the first successfully produced sample (condition 3-D: cooled calcium chloride, citric acid added, strongly mixed) showed small, circular clusters with a flour-like texture consistent with vaterite morphology. Qualitative comparison of the remaining conditions suggests that citric acid addition is associated with finer textures more than mixing intensity, though this remains unconfirmed under magnification for most samples. This is presented as an interim record of an ongoing study. Crystallographic confirmation (XRD/FTIR) and microscopy of the remaining samples are planned as direct follow-up work. The primary contribution at this stage is a documented, reproducible, low-cost synthesis protocol together with one positive proof-of-concept result.
items.authors: Omar Alaa El-Din El-Jeheny

items.title: Structure-Based Prioritization and Electronic Tuning of Cinnamate-Bearing Natural Products at Falcipain-2 and Falcipain-3
items.abstract: Electronic descriptors can prioritize substituents on model electrophiles, but whether those choices persist in intact natural products across receptor states remains uncertain. We tested cinnamate-bearing natural products at falcipain-2 (FP-2) and falcipain-3 (FP-3). Screening 1,012 South African Natural Compounds Database records yielded 185 motif-bearing parents, 174 with paired profiles. Receptor-normalized Glide XP ranking placed acteoside and aloeresin C alone on the dual-target Pareto front; six composites agreed at Spearman ρ ≥ 0.93. A protocol-matched FP-2 benchmark showed limited but statistically resolvable enrichment (ROC-AUC 0.548, 95% CI 0.505–0.590; 0.641, 0.586–0.698 for covalent actives). In a para-substituted methyl-cinnamate series, OH→NO₂ increased global electrophilicity from 2.22 to 3.69 eV while decreasing the β-carbon Fukui response from 0.166 to 0.026 as 61% of the added-electron response shifted to the nitro fragment; fragment-level trends persisted across ESP and Mulliken partitions, whereas atom-condensed indices did not. In the intact glycoside, para-chlorination improved the FP-3 Docking Score by 0.77 units (more negative) at pH 7.0 but redistributed the cinnamoyl core across the pose ensemble (median displacement, 8.7 Å) without conventional halogen-bond geometry, so the score gain did not reflect simple pose conservation. Moving one proton within the FP-2 catalytic dyad shifted the matched-pair contrast by 3.89 units and altered one-third of the library by more than the substituent effect; at pH 5.5, the FP-3 contrast reversed to +0.62. Thus, substituent effects that survive score-selection and sampling checks can remain conditional on protonation-state treatment, placing ligand tuning and receptor-state uncertainty on the same quantitative scale.
items.authors: Olaniyi Victor Olaniru, Clement Odunayo Ajiboye

items.title: Surface functionalization of soft photocathodes with an azido-phosphonic acid monolayer for robust and efficient solar-to-H2 conversion
items.abstract: Organic semiconductors are promising candidates for light-assisted electrocatalysis but interfacial design remains a key challenge for improving performance and durability. Design guidelines include: i) appropriate matching of the catalyst Fermi level to the transport level of charges in the organic semiconductor under operando; ii) controlling surface hydrophilicity for rapid bubble-release in the hydrogen evolution reaction; and iii) retained operation in acidic and alkaline media. Herein we demonstrate a surface-modification approach on five different soft photocathodes to create terminating phosphonic acid surfaces, yielding high-surface energy interfaces across pH ranges from 1 to 13. In acidic conditions, using Pt nanoparticle catalysts, photoelectrochemical devices exhibit photocurrent densities of ~9 mA cm−2 and onset potential of ~0.82 V, surpassing non-surface modified controls by approximately 35–95% and 10–30%, respectively. Improvements are attributed to efficient gas bubble desorption kinetics and increased photovoltages. Surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy is then used to monitor the Stark shift of a vibrational probe molecule on a metal nanoparticle, enabling the quantification of the quasi-Fermi level of the catalytic site and photovoltage on the unmodified and modified polymer surfaces under operation (i.e., applied bias). The phosphonic acidterminated surfaces yield dramatically increased photovoltages relative to unmodified surfaces. Finally, to demonstrate the broader application of the modifier, we show the approach is readily amenable to increasing the pH~6 for Pt and the binding stability RuOx catalysts. Collectively, our observations suggest a scalable, robust, and efficient route to organic photoelectrochemical devices as well as energy conversion and storage and sensing platforms.
items.authors: Eui Hyun Suh, Bo Dong, Yadong Zhang, Zhiting Chen, Giorgi Petriashvili, Stephen Barlow

items.title: Optimal sparging and mixing for enhanced mass transfer in U-loop bioreactors across scales
items.abstract: Scaling up the utilization of CO 2 for fuel and protein production requires designing large-scale reactors that can enhance gas-liquid mass transfer rates. Here, the gas sparging and phase mixing strategies are optimized in the case of a 608 m 3 U-loop reactor using computational fluid dynamics (CFD). The optimization is made possible by constructing a surrogate model that maps the design variables to the quantity of interest that captures the mass transferred per unit of energy expended. It is found that the optimal design consists of distributing as many spargers as possible. A separate analysis investigates how optimization can be conducted across scales, operating conditions and model assumptions. It is shown that optimal designs are primarily affected by the reactor scale if the reactor volume ratio between the industrial scale and the lab-scale is greater than 100.
items.authors: Malik Hassanaly, Pranav Jain, Mohammad J Rahimi, Federico Municchi, Devon Sigler, Hariswaran Sitaraman

items.title: All-Optical Spin Coherence in a Photosynthetic Electron-Transfer Metalloprotein
items.abstract: Optically addressable, biocompatible spin qubits represent promising platforms for quantum sensing. However, current efforts have focused on genetic encodability and microwave-based approaches thus far limited to organic radicals. Utilizing time-resolved Faraday rotation, we measured electron spin coherence in plastocyanin, a protein in the photosynthetic electron transport chain. Persisting hundreds of picoseconds, this is the first measurement of spin coherence in a metalloprotein under ambient conditions. We show how the protein’s active-site geometric and electronic structure responsible for biological function also enabled a spin–photon interface. A related blue copper protein—azurin—also demonstrated all-optical spin coherence. The ability to measure bioinorganic spin coherence under functional conditions foreshadows metalloproteins as native quantum sensors and opens questions about the potential role of spin coherences in electron transfer.
items.authors: Christian A. Totoiu, Erica Sutcliffe, Demetrios A. Dresios, Ryan G. Hadt

items.title: Scoring close linker analogues in PROTAC ternary complexes: A matched-pose study of VHL-recruiting SHP2 degraders
items.abstract: Linker optimisation in targeted protein degradation remains largely empirical, and a computational method able to rank close analogues before synthesis would be valuable. Whether current methods can do so has not been tested against the smallest chemical difference that changes potency. Here two VHL-recruiting SHP2 degraders that differ by exactly one methylene, P9 and P10, were compared across 27 ternary complex arrangements generated for both compounds, so that in every comparison the protein–protein geometry was held fixed and only the degrader varied. RxDock interaction scores did not distinguish them (p = 0.66). Prime MM-GBSA favored P9 by 8.1 kcal mol−1, agreeing in direction with the reported potency order (p = 0.040), but the preference was overturned by removing any of twelve individual poses and arose entirely from the generalized-Born solvation term; the nonpolar contribution was zero (−0.01 kcal mol−1, p = 0.97). Interface geometry computed from coordinates alone was indistinguishable between the two ensembles, with buried surface areas differing by 0.23%, and the computed energies were uncorrelated with interface size across a 2.9-fold range (r2 ≤ 0.10). Two further observations emerged: rigid-body docking score did not predict ternary competence, since none of the highest-scoring 1% of arrangements accommodated either degrader, and the longer linker reached ten more arrangements while closing no better within those both could bridge. End-point scoring of single minimized ternary complexes therefore does not resolve a one-methylene linker difference, even when it recovers the correct direction, and conformational averaging rather than a different energy function is the most likely route to improvement. The ternary complex models reported here are the first for this series.
items.authors: Tasniqul Islam

items.title: DrugForge-ADMET v0.3.0: An auditable BRICS-based workflow
items.abstract: Early hit discovery normally begins with a physical or virtual collection of small molecules. Public resources such as PubChem, ChEMBL and ZINC have broadened access to chemical space, but using them effectively still requires retrieval, standardization, filtering, deduplication, three-dimensional preparation and provenance management; many laboratories also lack an in-house screening collection. We present DrugForge-ADMET v0.3.0, an open-source RDKit workflow intended to provide a compact, auditable starting set when a prepared library is unavailable. The software decomposes 30 inspectable, sp3-enriched seed templates into BRICS fragments, recombines them, sanitizes the products, and applies deterministic physicochemical rules, structural-alert catalogues and explicitly labelled descriptor-based risk proxies. Seed/reference similarity is assessed with radius-2, 2048-bit Morgan fingerprints and Tanimoto similarity; score-first diversity selection limits redundancy. Selected structures are exported as CSV and as SDF records with ETKDGv3 conformers followed, where parameterized, by MMFF or UFF optimization. In three fixed-seed technical validation runs, each capped at 10,000 enumerated products, 61, 157 and 194 candidates were selected. Across 412 outputs, 411 canonical SMILES were unique, all 412 SDF records were readable and all contained three-dimensional conformers. The pooled median values were molecular weight 355.50, cLogP 1.55, TPSA 79.25 Å2, fraction sp3 0.706, three rotatable bonds, one aromatic ring and QED 0.845. These results establish software execution and property-window compliance, not bioactivity, synthesizability, patent novelty or experimentally validated ADMET performance. DrugForge-ADMET is therefore positioned as a transparent candidate-generation and triage layer before target-specific modelling, retrosynthesis and experimental testing.
items.authors: Erman Salih İSTİFLİ

items.title: Twenty Years of COF-1: The Spark That Launched a Field and Its Mysteries That Remain
items.abstract: COF-1, reported in 2005, was the first covalent organic framework (COF) and marked the birth of the field. Since then, COFs have quickly attracted attention by demonstrating how supramolecular chemistry and reticular design can be used to construct crystalline and porous organic frameworks with predictable molecularly defined pore sizes. More than two decades after its discovery, COF-1 remains one of the most studied COFs and has served as the gold standard for developing new methodologies and advances in COF crystallization. Yet, despite this extensive work, its precise crystal structure and the relationship between synthetic conditions and framework crystallinity remain debated and elusive. In this minireview, we revisit the story of COF-1, its evolution, and the open questions surrounding its structure, synthesis, stability and function.
items.authors: Riddhi Bansal, Samuel A. Levesque, Md. Zuwel Rana, Ehsan Hamzehpoor

items.title: Mechanochemical conglomerate formation by ball milling - or not?
items.abstract: Inspired by a study reporting on the zinc oxide-induced mechanochemical conglomerate formation of racemic amino acids, we investigated the reaction behavior of the analogous 19F-labeled DL-valine. Solid-state NMR spectroscopy under magic-angle spinning (MAS) conditions was employed as the central analytical technique to analyze the reaction products. In contrast to our expectation, no conglomerate formation occurred, and in the presence of ZnO and methanol a polymeric complex with one zinc and two fluorinated valine molecules was formed in a vibrational ball mill. Repeating these experiments with non-fluorinated valine led to a rather unusual and unique tetranuclear species with an overall composition of Zn4(D-Val)4(L-Val)4 as determined by single-crystal analysis and solid-state NMR. The latter complex was also formed when an equimolar ratio of the two enantiopure valine phases was combined in the ball mill with ZnO and methanol. The use of Resonant Acoustic Mixing (RAM) led to the same complex, but the efficiency of its formation varied significantly depending on the reaction conditions.
items.authors: Sven Moos, Pascal Trommelschläger, Tobias Krückel, Calogero Quaranta, Niklas Aengenvoort, Fabio Manzoni

items.title: Out-of-equilibrium Pd(II)-based cage populations with chiral memory
items.abstract: Metallosupramolecular assembly has considerably progressed the rational creation of complex nano structures. Yet, their use has remained largely constrained to operating under thermodynamic control, far from reaching the functional sophistication seen in out-of-equilibrium biological systems. Here, we show that populations of heteroleptic Pd2L4-type coordination cages can be transiently and repeatedly driven out of equilibrium using a chiral cage-based chemical fuel and C 60 fullerene as an anti-fuel. This fueling cycle allows a temporary assembly to be formed through competition between ligand exchange and guest encapsulation reactions, operating at different timescales. The system behaves as an energy ratchet and can be refueled. At the center of the assembly, a chiral figure-of-eight motif formed by red diketopyrrolopyrrole ligands partially retains its handedness during ligand exchange, leading to a chiral memory effect. This work establishes chemically fueled coordination cage populations as a versatile basis for encoding transient structural and stereochemical information within complex dynamic systems.
items.authors: Elie Benchimol, Björn Schmidt, Irene Regeni, Thorfinnur Gunnlaugsson, Guido H. Clever
items.title_zh: 具有手性记忆的非平衡Pd(II)基笼体群体
items.summary_zh: 金属超分子组装在复杂纳米结构的理性创造上取得了显著进展，但其应用仍主要受限于热力学控制，远未达到非平衡生物系统的功能复杂性。本文展示了异配位Pd2L4型配位笼体群体可以通过手性笼基化学燃料和C60富勒烯作为反燃料，暂时且反复地驱动出平衡。该燃料循环通过配体交换和客体封装反应之间的竞争形成暂时组装，操作于不同时间尺度。该系统表现为能量棘轮，并可重新加油。在组装中心，由红色二噁烯配体形成的手性8字图案在配体交换过程中部分保留其手性，导致手性记忆效应。此研究确立了化学燃料驱动的配位笼体群体作为在复杂动态系统中编码瞬态结构和立体化学信息的多功能基础。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，异配位Pd2L4型配位笼体群体能够通过手性燃料驱动形成具有手性记忆效应的动态结构，展现出在复杂系统中编码信息的潜力。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了异配位Pd2L4型配位笼体群体在非平衡状态下的手性记忆效应及其应用潜力。尽管金属超分子组装在复杂纳米结构的创造上取得了显著进展，但其应用仍主要受到热力学控制的限制，未能达到非平衡生物系统所具备的功能复杂性。研究表明，通过使用手性笼基化学燃料和C60富勒烯作为反燃料，异配位Pd2L4型配位笼体群体能够暂时且反复地驱动出平衡，形成一种能量棘轮的机制。

该燃料循环的实现依赖于配体交换和客体封装反应之间的竞争，能够在不同时间尺度上形成暂时的组装状态。在这一过程中，由红色二噁烯配体形成的手性8字图案在配体交换过程中部分保留其手性，进而导致了手性记忆效应的出现。这一现象不仅展示了化学燃料驱动的配位笼体群体在动态系统中的潜力，还为编码瞬态结构和立体化学信息提供了多功能的基础。

通过这一研究，作者强调了在复杂动态系统中，利用化学燃料驱动的配位笼体群体能够实现对结构和手性信息的有效编码，展现出其在未来纳米技术和材料科学中的广泛应用前景。这一发现为理解和设计具有复杂功能的非平衡系统提供了新的视角，推动了金属超分子化学领域的发展。

items.title: Nanodiamond as highly reductive catalyst: photohydrodeoxygenation of aryl ketones under mild conditions
items.abstract: Recent developments in diamond materials have focused on their potential for photocatalytic applications. This is mainly driven by diamond’s unique band structure, which distinguishes it from typically used semiconductors and allows access to potentials as reductive as -3.6 V (vs NHE). Additionally, diamond presents itself as a sustainable alternative, being carbon-based, nontoxic and reusable. However, its use in applied organic chemistry remains scarcely reported. Here, we present for the first time the use of hydrogen-terminated detonation nanodiamond (H-DND) for the deoxygenation of aryl ketones. The deoxygenation of organic compounds is key to produce fine and commodity chemicals e.g. from biomass. Traditional deoxygenation methods involve harsh conditions and the use of toxic reagents due to the high dissociation energy of the C-O bond. We demonstrate the deoxygenation of aryl ketones using H-DND under 395 nm LEDs irradiation and mild conditions. The applicability relevance of the method is also supported by scalability and recyclability studies, highlighting the application of H-DND as efficient highly reductive photocatalysts.
items.authors: Rocio Belen Rodriguez, Vanessa Raisch, Anke Krueger

items.title: When Do Quantum-Chemical Descriptors Improve Aqueous Solubility Prediction? A Residual-Rescue Benchmark under Chemical Distribution Shift
items.abstract: Quantum-chemical descriptors are increasingly appended to molecular machine-learning representations, yet their computational cost is difficult to justify when the average accuracy gain is small. We asked a stricter question for aqueous solubility: do low-cost quantum descriptors contain information that is genuinely nonredundant with conventional two-dimensional chemistry, and under which chemical regimes is that information useful? A frozen 2,996-molecule internal cohort derived from AqSolDB was evaluated with random, Bemis-Murcko scaffold-disjoint, and Butina-cluster-disjoint splits, and an independent 820-molecule OChemUnseen cohort was reserved for external validation. GFN2-xTB/ALPB-water descriptors produced small but reproducible direct improvements when added to RDKit descriptors (mean internal RMSE reductions 0.009-0.018 logS across model/split combinations; all 10 seeds improved). More importantly, a strict out-of-fold residual-rescue architecture, in which a quantum-only model learned errors left by the 2D model, improved RMSE by 0.028, 0.047, and 0.028 logS under random, scaffold, and cluster splits, respectively (10/10 seeds; paired Wilcoxon p = 0.001953 for each). On the external set, quantum augmentation reduced the 95th-percentile absolute error by 0.055 logS. Frontier-orbital descriptors accounted for most of the external gain, and significant benefits after false-discovery-rate correction were concentrated in nitro, amine, amide, and alcohol/phenol subsets. A learned low-cost gate did not reliably predict which molecules would benefit, providing a useful negative result. These results show that inexpensive quantum descriptors add modest average accuracy but measurable orthogonal information, with the clearest value under chemical distribution shift and in difficult or electronically distinctive cases.
items.authors: Aris Tsai

items.title: Empirical Evidence that Dirac–Fock Relativistic and Quantum Corrections are Z-indexing Artifacts
items.abstract: Note: This work is self-contained and independently testable, but forms part of a broader empirical research program, the Spectral Framework, investigating the empirical spectral structure underlying atomic and physical systems.For the present study, readers may find it useful to first read reference (7).The results of this study, together with the full dataset, can also be visualized interactively in the Spectral Framework Predictive Engine of atomic properties (https://www.spectralframework.org/predictive-engine).
items.authors: Abdennour Abbas

items.title: Computational Analysis of Competing Reduction Pathways in the Asymmetric Transfer Hydrogenation of 2-Alkenylquinolines
items.abstract: Two competing reduction pathways can deliver a single stereochemical outcome. This computational study reveals that asymmetric transfer hydrogenation of 2-alkenylquinolines can begin through nearly isoenergetic 1,4-hydride transfer to either the quinoline ring or the alkenyl side chain. The resulting sequences converge on a common prochiral iminium intermediate, after which a final chiral phosphoric acid-controlled 1,2-hydride transfer establishes the experimentally observed enantioselectivity, providing a rational explanation of how competing reduction sequences ultimately afford the same product and stereochemical outcome.
items.authors: Adrián López-Francés, Aitor Maestro

items.title: Effect of the Hydrostatic High Pressures (HHP) on the Microbiological and Physicochemical Properties of ‘Picual’ cv. and ‘Morisca’ cv. Olive Pomaces
items.abstract: Olive pomace (alperujo) is a major by-product of the virgin olive oil industry with a substantial environmental impact but remarkable potential as a health-promoting functional food ingredient. However, its high moisture and organic load necessitate immediate stabilization to prevent degradation. This study evaluated the efficacy of High Hydrostatic Pressure (HHP) processing (400 and 600 MPa for 5 min) as a non-thermal technology to stabilize ‘Picual’ and ‘Morisca’ olive pomaces harvested at two distinct ripening stages (green and ripe). HHP treatments achieved complete microbial inactivation, reducing aerobic mesophiles, molds, and yeasts below detection limits ( 1.0 log CFU g−1) regardless of cultivar or ripeness, while exceptionally preserving the macroscopic color profile with total color differences (ΔEHHP) remaining at about or below the human visual perception threshold ( 3.0). Conversely, endogenous polyphenol oxidase (PPO) exhibited significant baroresistance, remaining statistically unaltered and active after processing. The pressure-induced cellular disruption, combined with this residual PPO activity, triggered a selective oxidative cascade: ortho-diphenols (hydroxytyrosol, oleuropein, and the verbascoside+rutin fraction) significantly decreased, whereas monophenols (tyrosol and p-coumaric acid) and flavonoid glycosides remained highly stable throughout processing for ‘Morisca’ but exhibited reductions in ‘Picual’, due to their lack of a reactive catechol moiety. Despite these slight oxidative changes, a strong linear correlation (p 0.001) between total phenolic content and antioxidant activity was maintained. Furthermore, HHP preserved individual profiles of unsaturated fatty acids, such as oleic and linoleic acids. Multivariate Principal Component Analysis (PCA) confirmed that HHP effectively safeguards the macro-physicochemical and nutritional identity of the matrix while ensuring microbiological safety. These findings demonstrate that HHP is a robust bio-stabilization tool, particularly when applied to early-harvested (green) matrices, enabling the sustainable upcycling of olive pomace into safe, lipid-stable, and antioxidant-rich functional food ingredients.
items.authors: Jesús J. García-Parra, María Cabeza de Vaca, Manuel A. Martínez-Cañas, Antonia M. Trejo

items.title: Microclimate Reconstruction in Fixed Agrivoltaic Systems and Effects of Planting Density on the Physiology and Yield of Summer-Sown Peanut: A Two-Year Field Experiment
items.abstract: This two-year field study quantified microclimate modification using a fixed agrivoltaic (APV) array and evaluated planting-density effects on peanut physiology and yield specifically in the cultivable inter-panel strip, using an adjacent open field as the crop control. Trials were conducted in Nanjing, China, in 2023 and 2025 with ‘Sunonghua No. 1’ at hill spacings of 32, 36, and 40 cm. Solar radiation and air and soil temperature were monitored under the panels, between the panels, and in the open field, whereas plant measurements were restricted to inter-panel and open-field plots. The array produced a stable radiation gradient: mean relative solar radiation was 58.21% and 63.13% between panels in 2023 and 2025, respectively, but only 16.43% and 17.14% under the panels. Near-surface air-temperature variation among positions was small (daily means differed by no more than 0.24 °C on representative days), while inter-panel soil maxima were 0.60–2.21 °C lower and diurnal ranges 0.80–2.40 °C narrower than in the open field. Inter-panel SPAD and stomatal conductance decreased by 19.5–36.0% and 57.0–91.2%, respectively. Net photosynthesis generally declined; an anomalous 2023 contrast for the medium-density pair is reported but is not used as a mechanistic explanation of yield. Pod yield decreased by 51.2–55.0% in 2023 and 16.2–22.7% in 2025, mainly through lower pod and kernel mass. The 36 cm spacing produced the highest inter-panel yield in both years and the smallest relative loss. Under this site, cultivar, and array configuration, medium density was the most consistent option, although confirmation across additional seasons is required.
items.authors: Yanfei You, Xiayun Geng, Kaikai Shao, Jiaxun Teng, Yunyun Huang, Minli Yu

items.title: Spatiotemporal Variations and Environmental Correlates of Evapotranspiration Across Land-Use Types in the Longchuan River Basin
items.abstract: Long-term evapotranspiration (ET) information is important for water-resource assessment in basins associated with large-scale water-transfer projects. This study characterized ET variability and ET–environment associations across grassland, cropland, and forestland in the Longchuan River Basin using multisource remote-sensing data from May to September during 2001–2020. Temporal ET variability was assessed using all MOD16 8-day composites overlapping this period, while 13 environmental variables were evaluated using pixel-wise Pearson correlations and land-use-specific ET estimation models were developed using selected predictors. Mean daily ET generally increased from May to August and declined in September. The long-term May–September mean daily ET was highest in forestland (3.12 mm d−1), followed by the basin average (2.24 mm d−1), cropland (1.87 mm d−1), and grassland (1.33 mm d−1). Gross primary productivity (GPP) was the predominant correlate across all three land-use types and remained predominant after removal of the monthly climatological cycle and further detrending. Validation R2, RMSE, and NRMSE were 0.84, 0.23 mm d−1, and 17.49% for grassland; 0.84, 0.32 mm d−1, and 16.94% for cropland; and 0.78, 0.41 mm d−1 and 13.22% for forestland, respectively. These findings provide a long-term baseline for land-use-specific ET assessment and water-resource management.
items.authors: Liudong Zhang, Hairui Li, Bojia Li, Fei Huang, Xi Huang

items.title: Area Measures for Differential Item and Test Functioning on the Logit Scale: Relationships to Linking Errors in the 2PL Model
items.abstract: Area measures for differential item functioning and differential test functioning are conventionally defined as functions of the difference in item response functions. This probability scale may be less convenient for interpretation than an assessment carried out on the logit scale of the latent variable θ. This article proposes modified area measures on the logit scale and derives approximate closed-form expressions for the two-parameter logistic model. The noncompensatory measures are decomposed into uniform and nonuniform components, yielding interpretable summaries of differential functioning in item difficulties and item discriminations, respectively. A central finding approximately links the expected values of the proposed test-level measures to the linking errors of mean-geometric mean linking: the uniform component bounds the linking error for the group mean—with equality in the absence of differential functioning in item discriminations—while the nonuniform component equals the linking error for the group standard deviation. Analogous approximate relationships hold at the item level through newly introduced item-specific linking errors. The proposed measures thus offer intuitive summaries that directly quantify the impact of differential item functioning on group comparisons in the logit scale of θ.
items.authors: Alexander Robitzsch

items.title: Complement in HER2-Positive Breast Cancer: A Conditionally Protective Mechanism Under Attack
items.abstract: The therapeutic efficacy of anti-HER2 monoclonal antibodies in breast cancer has traditionally been attributed to direct inhibition of signaling and antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC). Recent evidence, however, has established complement activation through the classical pathway as a possible adjunct mechanism underlying the synergistic activity of the trastuzumab and pertuzumab combination. This synergy is mediated by complement-dependent cytotoxicity (CDC) and complement-dependent cellular phagocytosis (CDCP), and is lost upon C1q deletion in preclinical models. Tumor cells evade complement-mediated killing through overexpression of membrane-bound complement regulatory proteins (mCRPs), particularly CD55 and CD59, which correlate with shorter disease-free survival in patients treated with trastuzumab. C1q itself plays a dual, context-dependent role: it acts as a complement-independent tumor suppressor in HER2-positive breast cancer while promoting tumor progression in most other malignancies. Emerging therapeutic strategies, including biparatopic antibodies such as zanidatamab, complement-redirecting immunoconjugates, and mCRP-targeting approaches, aim to overcome complement resistance and enhance antitumor immunity. On this basis, we propose that HER2-positive breast cancer represents a conditionally complement-protective tumor, in which the balance between antibody-directed complement activation and mCRP-mediated evasion determines treatment outcome. This review evaluates the current evidence linking complement to anti-HER2 therapy and highlights future directions for successful treatment.
items.authors: Dobromira Petkova, Ivaila Kuleva, Zhasmin Stoyanova, Boryana Ilcheva, Albena Fakirova, Zhasmina Mihaylova
items.title_zh: HER2阳性乳腺癌中的补体：受攻击的条件保护机制
items.summary_zh: 抗HER2单克隆抗体在乳腺癌中的治疗效果传统上归因于直接抑制信号传导和抗体依赖性细胞毒性（ADCC）。然而，近期证据表明，通过经典途径激活补体可能是曲妥珠单抗与帕妥珠单抗组合协同作用的辅助机制。这种协同作用通过补体依赖性细胞毒性（CDC）和补体依赖性细胞吞噬（CDCP）介导，并在前临床模型中因C1q缺失而丧失。肿瘤细胞通过过表达膜结合补体调节蛋白（mCRPs），尤其是CD55和CD59，逃避补体介导的杀伤，这与接受曲妥珠单抗治疗的患者较短的无病生存期相关。C1q在HER2阳性乳腺癌中扮演双重角色：作为补体独立的肿瘤抑制因子，同时在大多数其他恶性肿瘤中促进肿瘤进展。新兴的治疗策略包括双特异性抗体如赞尼达单抗、补体重定向免疫偶联物和针对mCRP的策略，旨在克服补体抗性并增强抗肿瘤免疫。因此，我们提出HER2阳性乳腺癌代表一种条件性补体保护肿瘤。

items.title: Differential Analysis of the Application of Evolutionary Strategies in Reservoir Operating Recurrent Neural Networks
items.abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are widely used in reservoir operation because they can represent temporal dependencies, but their performance depends strongly on hyperparameter selection. This study compares eight evolutionary strategies—genetic algorithm (GA), particle swarm optimization (PSO), simulated annealing (SA), differential evolution (DE), ant colony optimization (ACO), artificial electric field algorithm (AEFA), slime mould algorithm (SMA), and white shark optimization (WSO)—for optimizing the hidden-node number and initial learning rate of long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU) models. Under common experimental settings, ACO required the shortest computation time in all reported dataset–architecture blocks, whereas the most accurate strategy depended on the dataset, architecture, and metric. For the total dataset, ACO–LSTM and AEFA–GRU produced the lowest reported MAEs (609.876 and 582.942 m3/s, respectively); WSO–LSTM was best for flood-season MAE (948.326 m3/s), and GA–GRU was best for non-flood-season MAE (516.088 m3/s). An independent chronological holdout experiment further verifies the search boundaries and validation-fitness procedure and shows that the fitness response also varies with hydrological period and RNN architecture. The results support objective- and dataset-specific optimizer selection, subject to the limitations of a single-reservoir case study and a restricted two-variable search.
items.authors: Boran Zhu, Di Zhang, Junqiang Lin, Yufeng Ren, Youkun Li, Pengchao Zhang

items.title: Three-Dimensional Concrete Printing in the Built Environment: Mechanistic Underpinnings, Rheological Constraints, and Prospective Integration Pathways
items.abstract: Over the past decade, three-dimensional concrete printing (3DCP) has moved from a laboratory curiosity to a technology that has produced hundreds of built structures worldwide. Despite this momentum, the engineering conditions under which printing genuinely delivers over conventional construction are not yet well-defined, and important technical barriers persist. This paper takes stock of where the field stands. It examines the rheological foundations that determine whether a mix can be pumped, extruded, and stacked without collapse; the kinematic and dispensing systems that translate digital geometry into physical form; and the open-time dynamics that govern interlayer bond quality, arguably the most consequential and least standardised aspect of current practice. Buildability is formalised through a combined rheological-structural criterion linking structuration kinetics to layer-buckling and plastic collapse limits, and the resulting interlayer weak plane is shown to make printed elements inherently orthotropic, a property increasingly captured in homogenised finite-element models and addressed operationally through impedance-, profilometry-, and vision-based closed-loop process control. Against this mechanistic background, the paper maps seven application domains according to their current technology readiness, with market trajectory data contextualising the pace of commercial uptake. A comparative assessment of the three principal printing process, families extrusion-based, powder binder jetting, and shotcrete-based, identifies where each is genuinely competitive and where it falls short. The sustainability case for 3DCP is examined quantitatively, demonstrating that alkali-activated binder systems combined with recycled aggregate can reduce embodied carbon by up to 66% relative to conventional reinforced concrete. The paper closes by identifying the six technical and institutional priorities that must be resolved before 3DCP can compete across a broad range of structural applications: reinforcement integration, normative frameworks, bond quality control, production economics, surface durability, and deployment reliability. Together, these findings offer a consolidated reference point for researchers, practitioners, and code developers working at the frontier of digital construction.
items.authors: Fahad Saud Allahaim, Mohammed Aljammaz

items.title: Low Salinity Elevated Ecological Risks for Shrimp Rearing by Promoting Stochastic Processes and Dispersion of Vibrionaceae Taxa
items.abstract: Inland shrimp rearing at low salinity has become widespread in recent years, yet how severe low salinity affects the microbial community and ultimately drives shrimp culture performance remains unclear. Here, we assessed the impact of salinity decline on the microbial community by diversity, community structure, assembly processes, and interspecies interactions. Water quality, enzyme activities, and shrimp culture performance were also assessed, and the complex relationship between the microbial community and environmental parameters was systematically evaluated. Our study revealed that low salinity significantly impacted community diversity. A decline in both community Richness and Evenness was observed compared to normal-salinity groups (p 0.01). It caused drastic demographic changes in community structure, surpassing the initial difference between water and gut, and created further dissimilarity between them (p 0.05). A drastic shift in microbial community assembly process was also observed, where large proportions of deterministic processes were replaced by stochastic processes (70.88% and 80.49% for rearing waters and shrimp gut, respectively). The number of shared microbial community members between rearing waters and shrimp gut showed an over 60-fold reduction, reflecting the reduced migration of microbes from rearing waters to shrimp gut. A drastic reduction in the number of nodes and edges in co-occurrence networks was also observed, indicating weakened interspecies interactions between microbes. Lastly, severe low salinity correlated with the dominance of Vibrionaceae, which rapidly accumulated in group S3G and may have contributed to lowered shrimp survival rate. Overall, our work systematically evaluated the responses of microbial communities in both shrimp gut and rearing waters to salinity decline, which sheds light on the importance of complex host–microbiome interactions and provides a new perspective on how salinity drives shrimp culture performance.
items.authors: Yubin Chen, Pengsheng Dong, Zhipeng Pan, Bo Yan, Yuhang Ma, Wenwen Zhang

items.title: Concurrent Associations of Gaming Time and Problematic Gaming with Depressive Symptoms in Children and Adolescents: A Three-Wave Cohort Study with Complementary Machine Learning Classification
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Digital media use is integral to the daily lives of children and adolescents, intensifying concerns regarding potential associations with mental health. However, much of the literature linking gaming and depression is based on cross-sectional designs and does not adequately distinguish within-person change from between-person differences. This study examined concurrent associations between gaming use patterns, problematic gaming behavior, and depressive symptoms across three repeated assessment waves and, as a complementary analysis, evaluated the concurrent classification performance of gaming-related indicators for elevated depressive symptoms. Methods: Three-wave data collected at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months were obtained from the Internet, Game, and Smartphone User Cohort established by the National Center for Mental Health. Depressive symptoms were assessed using the Children’s Depression Inventory (CDI), and problematic gaming behavior was assessed using the Internet Game Use-Elicited Symptom Screen (IGUESS). Linear mixed-effects models, including within–between decomposition and change-score models, were applied. Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost were used to classify concurrent elevated depressive symptoms (CDI ≥ 22). Results: The primary mixed-effects analyses included 2194 of 2294 enrolled participants. Across models, higher IGUESS scores were consistently associated with greater concurrent depressive symptoms, whereas gaming time showed weak or inconsistent associations. Machine learning models yielded ROC-AUC values of 0.85–0.88; however, precision and F1-scores were modest, indicating a substantial false-positive burden in this low-prevalence setting. Conclusions: Overall, problematic gaming behavior, rather than gaming time alone, may be more closely associated with depressive symptoms in children and adolescents.
items.authors: Yeseo Lee, Jun Seok Her, Hyo Jung Kim

items.title: Optimized Organic–Inorganic Nitrogen Balance Improves Asymbiotic In Vitro Seed Germination and Early Seedling Development of the Endangered Terrestrial Orchid Anacamptis coriophora
items.abstract: Anacamptis coriophora is a threatened tuberous orchid of the Irano-Turanian calcareous grasslands, subject to unsustainable harvesting for salep, increasing pressure from habitat loss and climate change. Asymbiotic in vitro culture is the principal method for its ex situ propagation; however, nitrogen nutrition, which is a decisive determinant of early morphogenesis, remains poorly optimized for Iranian terrestrial orchids, whose dust-like, endosperm-free seeds require external nutritional support for germination. Using a modified Malmgren basal medium, we investigated how nitrogen form and concentration affected asymbiotic seed germination and early seedling development in A. coriophora. Organic nitrogen (Aminoven at 25%, 50%, and 75% of full strength) was supplied in combination with inorganic nitrogen (KNO3 and (NH4)2SO4 in four combinations (balanced-low, nitrate-dominant, ammonium-dominant and high-inorganic). Germination declined markedly from 66% under balanced-low treatment to 13% under high inorganic nitrogen treatment, whereas organic nitrogen consistently enhanced germination across all inorganic backgrounds. Increasing Aminoven significantly promoted shoot elongation and biomass accumulation under low and moderate inorganic nitrogen levels but had little effect under high inorganic nitrogen concentrations. Root growth was enhanced by organic nitrogen across all inorganic treatments, whereas plantlet diameter increased under ammonium-dominant conditions, a signature of stress-induced radial swelling rather than enhanced vigor. Under the optimal medium (75% organic nitrogen, with low inorganic nitrogen), germination rate, shoot length, root length and fresh biomass reached 72%, 12.2 mm, 6.4 mm, and 44 mg plantlet−1, respectively. These findings provide a practical and scalable propagation protocol for this pharmaceutically and ecologically valuable Iranian orchid, thereby supporting conservation strategies aimed at mitigating salep overharvesting and environmental degradation.
items.authors: Fereshte Hoseini, Yavar Vafaee, Farzad Nazari, Rafail Shlemon Toma

items.title: Multiparametric ECIS Profiling Complements Metabolic Endpoint Screening of Complex Plant Extracts in HNSCC Models
items.abstract: Metabolic endpoint assays enable rapid screening but provide limited information on treatment kinetics, heterogeneity, and recovery. Here, we established a multistep workflow combining MTS-based metabolic screening with electric cell–substrate impedance sensing (ECIS), a label-free cell-based biosensor, to functionally prioritize complex plant extracts in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) models. Seventeen soluble extracts were screened at 50 µg/mL for 24 h in four HNSCC cell lines and human adipose-derived stem cells. Selected candidates were characterized by real-time impedance monitoring, multifrequency analysis, and model-derived barrier resistance. Extract 16 showed the most favorable metabolic selectivity profile. ECIS resolved no growth-inhibitory effects, sustained impedance suppression, heterogeneous responses, and transient suppression followed by partial recovery. Recovery was incomplete (CAL-33) or absent (Detroit 562); modeled barrier resistance became resolvable late (FaDu, PE/CA-PJ15) or not at all (CAL-33). Comparison with the PI3Kα inhibitor Inavolisib revealed partially overlapping but non-identical metabolic response profiles and no consistent enhancement by combination treatment. Extract 16 was associated with junctional redistribution, F-actin remodeling, and cell line-dependent PARP cleavage, whereas caspase 3/7 activation could not be detected. Integrating metabolic endpoint screening with multiparametric ECIS monitoring provides greater functional resolution and supports prioritizing complex bioactive samples for chemical and mechanistic investigation.
items.authors: Fine Handrick, Vincent O. Imieje, Vivien Engel, Esther Abiodun Odigie, Ewelukwa Ebube Chukwueloka, Lilian Nneoma Amafili
items.title_zh: 多参数ECIS分析补充复杂植物提取物在HNSCC模型中的代谢终点筛选
items.summary_zh: 代谢终点检测能够快速筛选，但对治疗动力学、异质性和恢复提供的信息有限。本研究建立了一种多步骤工作流程，将基于MTS的代谢筛选与电细胞-基底阻抗传感（ECIS）相结合，以在头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）模型中功能性优先筛选复杂植物提取物。对17种可溶性提取物在四种HNSCC细胞系和人脂肪来源干细胞中以50 µg/mL浓度进行24小时筛选。通过实时阻抗监测、多频分析和模型导出的屏障阻力对选定候选物进行表征。提取物16显示出最有利的代谢选择性特征。ECIS未观察到生长抑制效应，持续的阻抗抑制、异质反应和短暂抑制后部分恢复。恢复在CAL-33中不完全，在Detroit 562中缺失；模型化的屏障阻力在FaDu和PE/CA-PJ15中晚期可解析，而在CAL-33中则完全不可解析。与PI3Kα抑制剂Inavolisib的比较显示代谢反应谱部分重叠但不完全相同，且组合治疗未表现出一致的增强效果。提取物16与连接蛋白重分布、F-actin重塑及细胞系依赖的PARP裂解相关，而未能检测到caspase 3/7的激活。

items.title: When the AI Self Becomes the Ideal Self: A Systematic Review of AI-Enhanced Self-Discrepancy, Appearance Anxiety, and Protective Psychological Factors
items.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) appearance technologies, including beauty filters, augmented reality (AR) modification and generative avatars, have individualized digital self-presentation. Unlike traditional media, these technologies create self-referential appearance ideals that create novel forms of self-discrepancy and appearance anxiety. A systematic review was conducted in peer-reviewed databases for empirical studies published from 2021 to 2026 that studied self-representation, self-discrepancy, appearance distress, and protective psychological constructs within this context of AI, following PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Emergent patterns were identified by using the narrative thematic synthesis method across eligible studies. A total of eight empirical studies were found that fulfilled the inclusion criteria. The themes that emerged were as follows: (1) AI-enhanced self as a novel appearance ideal of the self; (2) self-discrepancy as an operative mechanism between the appearance of idealized and non-idealized selves and psychological distress; (3) contextually related and protective moderators; and (4) representation modality—between aestheticizing versus non-aestheticizing appearance modalities and psychological distress. The findings from the synthesis showed that self-discrepancy, social self-comparison, and self-objectification are the three main routes for appearance anxiety. Theoretically, these non-idealizing avatars, high self-similarity, and goal-oriented use contexts were considered as protective buffers but were not consistently quantified. Most importantly, there was no empirical study that directly assessed positive body image constructs or body appreciation. The current research mainly focuses on the pathology aspect of AI appearance technology, and positive body image is not investigated. Empirical studies should be conducted in the future with the clear aim of examining if constructive, nonidealized relationships with the technologically enhanced body can foster psychological resilience, and if so, how.
items.authors: Anju Soman, Navneet Mishra, Sumona Chakladar

items.title: Leading AI-Driven Digital Transformation: A Review of Leadership Attributes and Practices, with Implications for Singapore
items.abstract: The rapid evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping how enterprises are led, organised, and governed, raising critical questions about which leadership attributes and practices best enable AI-driven digital transformation (AIDT). Enterprises face growing pressure to accelerate AIDT in Asian countries such as Singapore, with stakeholders demanding tangible returns from AI investments, though there is limited clarity on the leadership attributes and practices that enable such success. Drawing on an integrated theoretical lens that synthesises theories of transformational leadership, ambidextrous leadership, and dynamic capabilities, this paper systematically reviews 73 peer-reviewed studies published between 2015 and 2025 following the PRISMA 2020 guidelines and thematically synthesises the evidence into an integrated leadership framework for AIDT. The synthesis identifies seven leadership attributes, four strategic priorities, six organisational focus areas for AI exploration, and six integrated AI governance practices. This review reports valuable findings on navigating AIDT with key leadership attributes and practices that balance innovation, accountability, and sustainability. The study contributes to the leadership and digital transformation literature by clarifying how leadership orchestrates the interplay between technology, practices, and governance in AIDT, and by proposing a research agenda for empirically validating the framework derived across various industry contexts.
items.authors: Nanda Kumar Karippur

items.title: Thermodynamic and Annual Performance Assessment of a Cascaded Air-Source Heat Pump for Industrial Steam Generation: a Mediterranean Case Study
items.abstract: Industrial heat decarbonization is a key challenge for the energy transition, particularly in applications requiring high-temperature steam when industrial waste heat is unavailable. This study presents a thermodynamic and annual performance assessment of a steam-generating heat pump system using ambient air as the external low-temperature heat source. The system combines cascaded low- and medium-temperature heat pumps with a mechanical vapor recompression unit. Steady-state thermodynamic models, parameterized using assumptions consistent with representative commercial components, are used to evaluate the system under nominal and annual operating conditions. The annual assessment is applied to the continuous steam demand of a real paper-production facility under Mediterranean climatic conditions. A grid-supported photovoltaic and battery energy storage system is included as the electricity supply framework for characterizing the operation of the steam-generating heat pump under time-varying ambient and renewable-generation conditions. Under the adopted modeling assumptions, the system produces saturated steam at 5–25 bar with design COP values of 1.35–1.49. As steam pressure increases, mechanical vapor recompression becomes the dominant electricity-consuming stage, resulting in a moderate reduction in COP while decreasing the sensitivity of overall system performance to ambient temperature variations. Full-year simulations show that the operating COP exceeds the design-point value for the investigated location because ambient temperatures are generally more favorable than the nominal design condition. The results of the preliminary economic analysis performed for three PV-BESS configurations show that the economic feasibility strongly depends on the electricity purchase price. None of the studied configurations recovers its additional investment at 50 €/MWh, whereas discounted payback periods range from 6.9 to 16.5 years at 100 €/MWh and from 4.2 to 7.3 years at 150 €/MWh. As the integrated system has not been experimentally validated, the results should be interpreted as model-based estimates.
items.authors: Luca Migliari, Daniele Cocco

items.title: Informal Volunteering, Relational Practice and the Challenge of Measurement
items.abstract: Informal volunteering is widely recognised as an important form of civic participation and community support, yet it remains one of the most difficult dimensions of volunteering to define and measure. Existing frameworks typically describe informal volunteering as unpaid help provided directly to individuals outside formal organisational structures. However, growing evidence suggests that many activities classified by researchers as volunteering are not understood by participants in those terms. Drawing on relational sociology, this paper examines how informal volunteering is understood, classified, and measured through a multimethod study comprising a Delphi panel of volunteering experts (n = 7), a survey (n = 94), and cognitive interviews (n = 8). Originally undertaken to inform the development of volunteering questions for the Irish Census, the study generated broader insights into the conceptual boundaries of informal volunteering. Findings reveal a consistent pattern across all three stages of the research. Experts anticipated difficulties in defining and measuring informal volunteering, survey respondents demonstrated substantial uncertainty when classifying informal volunteering activities, and interview participants frequently distinguished volunteering from helping neighbours, friends, and community members. While activities undertaken through organisations were widely recognised as volunteering, activities embedded within everyday social relationships were more often understood through the languages of care, reciprocity, neighbourliness, friendship, and community support. The paper argues that informal volunteering functions as a relational social practice rather than as a clearly bounded category of volunteer work. Difficulties in measuring informal volunteering therefore reflect not only methodological limitations but also a mismatch between institutional definitions and everyday understandings of participation and support. The study contributes to debates on the conceptualisation of informal volunteering, advances relational approaches to civic participation, and suggests that challenges in measurement are conceptual before they are methodological.
items.authors: Shirley Martin, Margaret Scanlon, Elaine Desmond

items.title: Epidemiology and Predictors of 90-Day Mortality in Patients with Clostridioides difficile Infection: A Retrospective Single-Center Study from Galati, Romania
items.abstract: Background: Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, but data on 90-day mortality after hospitalization from Romania remain limited. This study characterized hospitalized patients with CDI at a regional infectious diseases hospital in south-eastern Romania and evaluated factors associated with 90-day all-cause mortality. Methods: We conducted a retrospective observational study of adults with laboratory-confirmed CDI admitted to Infectious Diseases Clinical Department I between 1 January and 31 December 2024. The date of hospital admission for the index CDI episode was defined as time zero for the 90-day follow-up. Clinical, epidemiological, laboratory, and treatment variables were analyzed; ATLAS components were assessed at CDI diagnosis, while urinary-catheter (UC) exposure was analyzed separately because the source records did not reliably establish whether catheter placement preceded or followed CDI diagnosis in every patient. Associations with 90-day all-cause mortality were assessed using multivariable logistic regression. Results: Among 170 patients (median age, 70 years), 55 died within 90 days (32.4%; 95% CI, 25.4–39.9%). Overall, 99/170 patients (58.2%; 95% CI, 50.4–65.7%) had an age-adjusted Charlson Comorbidity Index 5. In the final multivariable model, ATLAS score 4 (adjusted OR [aOR], 3.52; 95% CI, 1.56–7.95; p = 0.002) and indwelling UC exposure (aOR, 2.88; 95% CI, 1.12–7.37; p = 0.028) were associated with 90-day all-cause mortality. The model showed good discrimination (AUC, 0.746; 95% CI, 0.664–0.828). Conclusions: Ninety-day all-cause mortality was substantial in this single-center Romanian cohort. Higher ATLAS score and UC exposure were associated with mortality, but the UC association is exploratory because catheter timing relative to CDI diagnosis was not reliably available. Prospective multicenter external validation is required before these findings are used for clinical risk stratification.
items.authors: Pantelie Nicolcescu, Gabriel-Valeriu Popa, Mădălina-Nicoleta Matei, Alina Plesea-Condratovici, Alina-Viorica Iancu, Manuela Arbune
items.title_zh: 罗马尼亚Galati地区艰难梭状芽胞杆菌感染患者90天死亡率的流行病学及预测因素研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：艰难梭状芽胞杆菌感染（CDI）与显著的发病率和死亡率相关，但罗马尼亚住院患者90天死亡率的数据有限。本研究对东南罗马尼亚一所地区传染病医院的住院CDI患者进行了特征描述，并评估了与90天全因死亡率相关的因素。方法：我们对2024年1月1日至12月31日期间入院的实验室确诊CDI成年患者进行了回顾性观察研究。以CDI首次住院日期为90天随访的时间零点。分析了临床、流行病学、实验室和治疗变量；ATLAS评分在CDI诊断时评估，而尿管暴露单独分析。使用多变量逻辑回归评估与90天全因死亡率的关联。结果：在170名患者中（中位年龄70岁），55名患者在90天内死亡（32.4%；95% CI，25.4–39.9%）。总体上，99/170名患者（58.2%；95% CI，50.4–65.7%）的年龄调整Charlson合并症指数为5。在最终的多变量模型中，ATLAS评分为4（调整后OR [aOR]，3.52；95% CI，1.56–7.95）。

items.title: Hexokinase II as a Potential Target of Apigenin Through the Induction of Apoptosis and Necroptosis in Malignant Mesothelioma
items.abstract: Background: Lactate-acclimated MSTO-211HAcT and H2452AcT malignant mesothelioma (MM) cells were previously found to tolerate gemcitabine more readily than their parental cells while remaining sensitive to apigenin. We examined whether changes in glucose metabolism and HKII contribute to the apigenin response. Methods: Apigenin was evaluated in monolayer and spheroid cultures and in a xenograft model; HKII was also silenced in the acclimated cells. Results: Apigenin reduced cell viability, p-AKT (Ser473), glycolysis-associated proteins including HKII, and mitochondrial electron transport chain proteins, while increasing p53 and markers of cell death. Tumor growth and selected metabolic proteins were reduced in the xenograft model. HKII silencing reduced cell viability and glucose utilization, lowered cellular ATP, altered mitochondrial membrane potential, and increased markers of apoptosis and necroptosis. Conclusions: HKII-associated metabolism contributes to survival of lactate-acclimated MM cells, and apigenin affects this metabolic phenotype. Direct targeting of HKII by apigenin and the complete mitochondrial apoptotic pathway require further study.
items.authors: Moon-Kyun Cho, Sang-Han Lee, Hae-Seon Nam, Yoon-Jin Lee
items.title_zh: 芹菜素通过诱导凋亡和坏死性凋亡靶向己糖激酶II于恶性间皮瘤
items.summary_zh: 背景：乳酸适应的MSTO-211HAcT和H2452AcT恶性间皮瘤细胞对吉西他滨的耐受性较强，但对芹菜素仍敏感。我们研究了葡萄糖代谢和HKII是否影响芹菜素的反应。方法：在单层和球体培养以及异种移植模型中评估芹菜素；同时在适应细胞中沉默HKII。结果：芹菜素降低了细胞活力、p-AKT（Ser473）、与糖酵解相关的蛋白质（包括HKII）和线粒体电子传递链蛋白，同时增加了p53和细胞死亡标志物。在异种移植模型中，肿瘤生长和选定的代谢蛋白减少。HKII沉默降低了细胞活力和葡萄糖利用，降低了细胞ATP，改变了线粒体膜电位，并增加了凋亡和坏死性凋亡的标志物。结论：HKII相关的代谢促进了乳酸适应的恶性间皮瘤细胞的存活，芹菜素影响了这一代谢表型。芹菜素直接靶向HKII及完整的线粒体凋亡途径需进一步研究。

items.title: Rewriting Phosphorylation Codes: Toward Signal-State Editing with PhosTACs
items.abstract: Protein phosphorylation is a dynamic post-translational modification (PTM) that regulates protein function, signaling, and cellular behavior. Accumulating evidence indicates that combinations of phosphosites function as “phosphorylation codes,” encoding distinct conformational and signaling states rather than acting independently. Dysregulation of these phosphorylation codes contributes to numerous diseases. Although therapies targeting protein kinases and phosphatases have achieved substantial clinical success, their indirect modulation of substrate phosphorylation leaves room for improved selectivity, reduced off-target effects, and greater resilience to therapeutic resistance. Here, we integrate current concepts of phosphorylation codes as a unifying framework for understanding phosphorylation-dependent regulation. Using tau and EGFR as representative models of pathological and signaling-state encoding, we further compare conventional kinase and phosphatase inhibitors with emerging induced-proximity technologies, including targeted protein degradation (TPD) of phosphorylation regulators and phosphorylation-targeting chimeras (PhosTACs), which recruit engineered or endogenous phosphatases to achieve targeted protein dephosphorylation (TPDephos). Together, these molecular strategies represent a conceptual progression from enzyme-centered intervention to event-driven editing of substrate phosphorylation states.
items.authors: Dong-Ting Ke, Wei-Chen Chang, Yu-Yu Chen, Po-Han Chen

items.title: Beyond Individual Resilience: Organizational Support, Psychosocial Vulnerabilities, and Mental Health Outcomes Among Correctional Officers—A Scoping Review
items.abstract: Correctional officers report high rates of mental disorders, and building individual resilience is increasingly proposed as the remedy. This scoping review examined how resilience and organizational support are conceptualized, measured, and related to correctional officers’ mental health across the continuum from distress to well-being. Following the PRISMA-ScR guidelines, we searched APA PsycInfo, Web of Science, and PubMed for peer-reviewed studies in English, Italian, and Spanish; 21 primary studies from seven countries were included. Resilience was directly examined in six studies, measured with validated instruments in only four, and conceptualized inconsistently across them. Organizational factors were charted in every study: understaffing, work–family conflict, and stigmatizing workplace cultures emerged as consistent risks, while organizational and peer support were the most consistent protective factors; in national surveys, organizational stressors outweighed operational trauma exposure. Positive outcomes were measured in only two studies. Findings support shifting the focus from individual resilience training toward modifiable organizational conditions—staffing, leadership, culture, and accessible correctional-specific support.
items.authors: Francesca Giordano, Nicole Pojani, Giada Pugliese

items.title: The Use of the Drospirenone 4 mg-Only Pill in Overweight and Obese Women with Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.abstract: Objective: Polycystic ovary syndrome is frequently associated with hyperandrogenemia-related hirsutism, which creates notable cosmetic concerns for many affected women. Although multiple antiandrogenic treatments exist, many patients remain dissatisfied, and combined oral contraceptives are often contraindicated due to metabolic and cardiovascular risk factors. This study evaluates whether a drospirenone-only pill improves hormonal profiles and hirsutism in PMOS compared to cyclic dydrogesterone. Methods: This retrospective cohort study assessed hyperandrogenemia and hirsutism using the modified Ferriman–Gallwey score in 60 overweight or obese women with PMOS who were treated at the Clinical Division of Gynecologic Endocrinology and Reproductive Medicine of the Medical University of Vienna, Austria. Patients underwent follow-up examinations after three and six months of treatment. Thirty women chose treatment with drospirenone-only and were age-matched with 30 women receiving cyclic dydrogesterone. Results: After 3 months, women in the drospirenone group showed significant improvements, including reductions in LH (p 0.001), FSH (p 0.001), testosterone (p = 0.001), FAI (p 0.001) and AMH (p = 0.005). Ferriman–Gallwey scores were significantly lower after 3 months (p 0.001) and 6 months (p = 0.001). At follow-up, the drospirenone group exhibited lower LH (5.4 vs. 8.8 mIU/mL; p = 0.004) and lower FAI (2.9 vs. 4.0; p = 0.045) compared with controls. Among women with baseline hirsutism (FGS ≥ 8), scores decreased from 14 to 12 (p 0.001) after 3 months and to 10 (p = 0.002) after 6 months in the drospirenone group. Conclusions: Drospirenone-only treatment resulted in a modest reduction in Ferriman–Gallwey score, with more pronounced improvements observed in women with baseline hirsutism. This was accompanied by hormonal changes, suggesting a potentially beneficial option for women with hyperandrogenic PMOS for whom combined oral contraceptives are not suitable.
items.authors: Klara Hofer, Selina Ebner, Rodrig Marculescu, Magdalena Boegl, Peter Frigo, Robert Krysiak
items.title_zh: 仅用4毫克地屈孕酮治疗多内分泌代谢卵巢综合症女性的研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：多囊卵巢综合症常伴有与高雄激素血症相关的多毛症，给许多女性带来显著的美容困扰。本研究评估仅用地屈孕酮的药物是否能改善多囊卵巢综合症女性的激素水平和多毛症。方法：本回顾性队列研究评估了60名超重或肥胖的多囊卵巢综合症女性的高雄激素血症和多毛症，使用修正的Ferriman–Gallwey评分，患者在维也纳医科大学妇科内分泌与生殖医学临床部门接受治疗。结果：经过3个月治疗，地屈孕酮组的LH、FSH、睾酮、FAI和AMH均显著降低（p均<0.001），Ferriman–Gallwey评分在3个月（p<0.001）和6个月（p=0.001）后显著降低。随访时，地屈孕酮组的LH水平显著低于对照组（5.4 vs. 8.8 mIU/mL; p<0.001）。

items.title: Quantitative Spinal Cord Deformation Is Associated with Neurologic Status in High-Grade Thoracic Metastatic Epidural Spinal Cord Compression: A Retrospective Surgical Cohort
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Neurologic presentation varies among patients with high-grade metastatic epidural spinal cord compression (MESCC), even within Bilsky grades 2–3. We examined whether quantitative preservation of spinal cord caliber is associated with neurologic intactness at presentation. Methods: We retrospectively studied 73 adults who underwent surgery for thoracic Bilsky grade 2–3 MESCC between June 2020 and December 2025. Preoperative neurologic status was classified as Frankel E versus Frankel A-D. Blinded observers measured anteroposterior and transverse cord diameters at maximal compression and at the first tumor-free cranial and caudal pedicle levels. A normalized two-adjacent cord compression ratio (CCR) was available in 71 patients. Modified Poisson regression estimated prevalence ratios for Frankel-E status, adjusted for Bilsky grade; logistic, Firth, and cranial-reference analyses were used as sensitivity analyses. Results: Twenty-two patients (30.1%) were Frankel E. Two-adjacent CCR was higher in Frankel-E than Frankel A-D patients (median 0.521 vs. 0.439; p = 0.013). Each 0.10 increase in CCR was associated with greater prevalence of Frankel-E status after Bilsky adjustment (PR 1.23, 95% CI 1.04–1.47; p = 0.018). Logistic, Firth, and cranial-reference analyses were generally consistent in direction; the solid-tumor-only estimate also remained positive but was less precise and included the null. Interobserver agreement for CCR was acceptable but imprecise (ICC[A,1] = 0.758, 95% CI 0.433–0.911). Conclusions: In this surgically selected cohort, normalized cord-caliber preservation was associated with neurologic intactness after accounting for Bilsky grade. CCR should be regarded as a research phenotype rather than an individual-patient predictor or treatment threshold, pending prospective validation in broader surgical and nonsurgical populations.
items.authors: Ilhan Yilmaz, Baran Taskala, Muhammed Bayindir, Aydin Talat Baydar
items.title_zh: 定量脊髓变形与高等级胸椎转移性脊髓压迫神经状态相关性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：高等级转移性硬膜外脊髓压迫（MESCC）患者的神经表现存在差异，尤其在Bilsky 2-3级之间。本研究旨在探讨脊髓直径的定量保存是否与患者的神经完整性相关。方法：我们回顾性研究了2020年6月至2025年12月间接受手术的73名胸椎Bilsky 2-3级MESCC成人患者。术前神经状态分为Frankel E与Frankel A-D。盲法观察者测量最大压迫时的脊髓前后径和横径。71名患者获得了标准化的相邻脊髓压迫比（CCR）。采用修正的Poisson回归估计Frankel E状态的流行率比，并调整Bilsky等级；使用逻辑回归、Firth和颅参考分析作为敏感性分析。结果：22名患者（30.1%）为Frankel E。Frankel E患者的相邻CCR高于Frankel A-D患者（中位数0.521 vs. 0.439；p = 0.013）。CCR每增加0.10，Frankel E状态的流行率显著增加（PR 1.23，95% CI 1.04–1.47；p = 0.018）。逻辑回归、Firth和颅参考分析结果一致，固体肿瘤估计也保持正相关。

items.title: Effect of Chiral Arm Angle on the Stiffness, Auxeticity and Energy Absorption of Polyamide-12 Tetra-Chiral Lattices Under Quasi-Static Compression: A Numerical Baseline Study
items.abstract: Chiral auxetic lattices convert axial loading into node rotation, producing negative Poisson’s ratios and high energy absorption. This purely numerical study establishes a quasi-static baseline for additively manufacturable polyamide-12 (PA12) tetra-chiral lattices in which the chiral arm angle (0–90°) is treated as a design variable; no experiments were performed, and the model is verified rather than validated. Geometrically non-linear elastoplastic finite element analyses with a data-sheet-derived bilinear PA12 card and frictional self-contact were carried to 20% nominal strain and supported by mesh convergence, seeded-imperfection and friction sensitivity studies, a full-field lateral-strain measure and a refined sweep at 5° resolution. The arm angle switches the response between a stretch-dominated non-auxetic regime (0°, 50–90°) and a rotation-dominated auxetic regime (15–45°) whose lateral kinematics are not sensitive to mesh density, friction and seeded imperfections. The 15° lattice maximizes stiffness and peak force but is an isolated spike in the refined sweep, exhibits a collapse-mode bifurcation whose branch is selected by the discretization, and reaches the PA12 ductility limit after 3.5 mm of stroke. The 30° architecture sustains 9.4 mm before fracture onset and delivers the highest damage-bounded specific energy absorption of the auxetic window (820 J/kg on the baseline mesh), emerging as the design optimum.
items.authors: Volkan Arıkan, Cenk Yanen

items.title: Paired Transcriptomic Profiling Identifies Shared Liver Metastasis-Associated Molecular Features in Colorectal Cancer
items.abstract: Colorectal cancer liver metastasis (CCLM) is closely associated with poor patient prognosis, yet patient-specific molecular heterogeneity complicates the identification of recurrent molecular changes during metastasis. To address this, we performed RNA sequencing on paired primary tumors and liver metastases synchronously resected from six patients and analyzed gene expression changes using a paired design that accounted for interpatient variability. This analysis identified differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and metastasis-associated pathways through functional enrichment analysis and gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA). The reproducibility of these changes was further assessed across multiple independent publicly available transcriptomic datasets from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) and The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). Selected candidate genes were additionally evaluated in a metastasis-selected colorectal cancer cell model, in which several genes showed expression changes consistent with the transcriptomic findings. Together, these results indicate that recurrent molecular changes accompany CCLM despite substantial interpatient heterogeneity and provide a strategy for identifying metastasis-associated molecular features and potential therapeutic targets.
items.authors: Hye Won Lee, Seok Soon Park, Mi Ri Kwon, Eun Jin Ju, Seol Hwa Shin, Jin Park
items.title_zh: 配对转录组分析揭示结直肠癌肝转移相关分子特征
items.summary_zh: 结直肠癌肝转移（CCLM）与患者预后不良密切相关，但患者特异性的分子异质性使得识别转移过程中的重复分子变化变得复杂。为此，我们对六名患者同步切除的原发肿瘤和肝转移组织进行了RNA测序，并采用配对设计分析基因表达变化，以考虑患者间的变异性。该分析通过功能富集分析和基因集富集分析（GSEA）识别了差异表达基因（DEGs）和与转移相关的通路。这些变化的可重复性进一步通过多个独立的公共转录组数据集（来自基因表达综合数据库GEO和癌症基因组图谱TCGA）进行了评估。选定的候选基因在转移选择的结直肠癌细胞模型中也得到了验证，多个基因的表达变化与转录组发现一致。这些结果表明，尽管存在显著的患者间异质性，CCLM伴随的重复分子变化仍然存在，并为识别与转移相关的分子特征及潜在治疗靶点提供了策略。

items.title: Within-Person Longitudinal Associations Between Parental Depressive Symptoms and Children’s Emotional and Behavioral Functioning: Differences by Household Income
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Parental depressive symptoms are consistently associated with children’s emotional and behavioral functioning, yet research has predominantly emphasized parent-to-child associations. Less is known about child-to-parent pathways and reciprocal processes, particularly across socioeconomic contexts. This study examined within-person reciprocal associations between parental depressive symptoms and children’s emotional and behavioral functioning across Grades 3–5 and tested whether these associations differed by household income status. Methods: Data were drawn from 5320 children (Mage = 9.10 years at Grade 3) in the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study, Kindergarten Class of 2010–11 (ECLS-K:2011), a nationally representative U.S. longitudinal study. Parental depressive symptoms and teacher-rated internalizing and externalizing behaviors were assessed annually. Random-intercept cross-lagged panel models (RI-CLPMs) examined within-person reciprocal associations, and multigroup RI-CLPMs tested income-group differences. Results: In the overall sample, parental depressive symptoms did not significantly predict subsequent internalizing or externalizing behaviors, whereas both child behaviors predicted subsequent parental depressive symptoms. Both the parent-to-child and child-to-parent pathways for internalizing behaviors differed significantly by household income status. Among lower-income families, parental depressive symptoms and children’s internalizing behaviors were reciprocally associated, whereas neither direction was significant among relatively higher-income families. In contrast, the cross-lagged associations for externalizing behaviors did not differ by household income status. Conclusions: Within-person reciprocal associations between parental depressive symptoms and children’s internalizing behaviors emerged among lower-income families but not among relatively higher-income families, suggesting that parent–child mental health processes may be more interconnected under socioeconomic disadvantage.
items.authors: Jiho Park

items.title: Molecular Mechanism of AtCAX3-Induced BPA Tolerance in Plants
items.abstract: Cation/H+ Exchangers (CAXs) are involved in the sequestration of cations such as Ca2+, Mn2+, Li+, Zn2+, and Cd2+ from the cytosol into the vacuole using proton gradients. Our previous studies demonstrated the involvement of AtCAX3 in Cd2+ tolerance. In this study, we investigated whether AtCAX3 is also involved in tolerance to the endocrine disruptor Bisphenol A (BPA). Furthermore, to examine the role of the autoinhibitory domain of AtCAX3 in BPA tolerance, the empty vector (pYES5), AtCAX3, Δ36-AtCAX3 (deletion of the N-terminal regulatory region; NRR), and Δ90-AtCAX3 (deletion of both the NRR and regulatory-dependent region; RDR) were overexpressed in Saccharomyces cerevisiae and the atcax3 knockout mutant of Arabidopsis thaliana. In Arabidopsis, BPA tolerance, Ca2+ levels, and antioxidant enzyme activities were highest in Δ90-AtCAX3-overexpressing plants, followed by Δ36-AtCAX3, AtCAX3, Col-0, and atcax3. Conversely, ROS levels followed the opposite pattern. Interestingly, the expression levels of Ca2+ importer genes (AtCNGC10 and AtMCA1) were increased, whereas those of Ca2+ exporter genes (AtACA10) were decreased in the order of Δ90-AtCAX3 Δ36-AtCAX3 AtCAX3 Col-0 atcax3. These results suggest that elevated Ca2+ levels may contribute to ROS reduction. Taken together, deletion of the autoinhibitory domain of AtCAX3 enhances BPA tolerance by reducing BPA-induced ROS accumulation through increased Ca2+ accumulation and activation of antioxidant defense systems. Furthermore, enhanced Ca2+ homeostasis may interfere with the positive feedback loop between BPA-induced ROS generation and Ca2+ spikes. These findings can be applied to develop BPA phytoremediators and BPA-resilient crops.
items.authors: HyoCheol Shin, DongGwan Kim, JunHyun Lee, Kyung Hwa Kee, Hye Hyun Yoo, SeongBin Hwang

items.title: Focused Ultrasound-Mediated Blood–Brain Barrier Opening for Enhanced Drug Delivery in Diffuse Gliomas: A Systematic Review
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: The blood–brain barrier (BBB) severely limits the intratumoral delivery of systemically administered therapeutics in diffuse gliomas, including glioblastoma (GBM), contributing to the persistently poor prognosis of these tumors. Focused ultrasound (FUS) combined with microbubble agents enables transient, spatially targeted, and reversible BBB opening (BBBO), offering a non-invasive strategy to enhance drug delivery in this setting. Despite a rapidly growing body of clinical evidence, a systematic synthesis of outcomes across FUS platforms, drug regimens, and study designs is currently lacking. This systematic review aims to critically appraise the available clinical evidence on FUS-mediated BBBO for enhanced drug delivery in adult patients with diffuse gliomas. Methods: A systematic search of PubMed/MEDLINE and Scopus was performed using pre-specified search terms (last search: June 2026). Eligible studies included clinical trials and cohort studies enrolling adult patients (≥18 years) with histologically confirmed diffuse glioma (WHO grades II–IV) who underwent FUS-BBBO for therapeutic drug delivery enhancement. Two reviewers independently screened records and extracted data using a standardized form. Study quality was assessed using the NIH Quality Assessment Tool for Before-After Studies (single-arm studies) and the ROBINS-I tool (comparative studies). The review was retrospectively registered on OSF. Results were synthesized narratively due to study heterogeneity. Results: Eight publications from seven independent clinical studies were included. Across these publications, 68 patient entries were reported; however, because of overlapping populations across publications, the number of unique patients could not be precisely determined. Two FUS platforms were employed, with the ExAblate Neuro system (220–230 kHz) used in six out of seven cohorts. BBB opening was confirmed in all studies, with target sonication success rates of 92.4–100%. No procedure-related serious adverse events attributable to FUS-BBBO were reported across any study. Transient T2/SWAN hypointense foci were observed in a subset of patients, consistently asymptomatic and histologically benign. Direct intratumoral drug quantification was feasible in two pre-surgical studies, demonstrating a 2.2-fold increase in drug accumulation in FUS-treated versus untreated tissue (p 0.01). The only comparative study reported a statistically significant improvement in overall survival (median 31.3 vs. 19.3 months; HR 0.50, p = 0.009) and progression-free survival (median 13.5 vs. 8.1 months; HR 0.55, p = 0.020) versus the controls. Conclusions: FUS-mediated BBBO is a safe and feasible approach for enhancing drug delivery in adult diffuse glioma patients across multiple platforms and drug combinations. Preliminary comparative data suggest a potential survival benefit in newly diagnosed GBM; however, these findings are based on a single non-randomized study and require confirmation in prospective randomized controlled trials.
items.authors: Gabriele Ciaffi, Renata Martinelli, Andrea Traverso, Benedetta Burattini, Placido Bruzzaniti, Fabio Papacci
items.title_zh: 聚焦超声介导的血脑屏障开放以增强弥漫性胶质瘤药物递送
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：血脑屏障（BBB）严重限制了系统性给药在弥漫性胶质瘤（包括胶质母细胞瘤GBM）中的肿瘤内递送，导致这些肿瘤预后持续不良。聚焦超声（FUS）结合微泡剂能够实现暂时、空间靶向和可逆的BBB开放（BBBO），为增强药物递送提供了一种非侵入性策略。尽管临床证据迅速增长，但目前缺乏对不同FUS平台、药物方案和研究设计的系统性综合。本系统评价旨在批判性评估FUS介导的BBBO在成人弥漫性胶质瘤患者中增强药物递送的临床证据。方法：通过预先设定的搜索词对PubMed/MEDLINE和Scopus进行了系统搜索（最后搜索：2026年6月）。符合条件的研究包括招募成年患者（≥18岁）且组织学确认的弥漫性胶质瘤（WHO II-IV级）进行FUS-BBBO以增强药物递送的临床试验和队列研究。两位评审员独立筛选记录并使用标准化表格提取数据。研究质量使用NIH前后研究质量评估工具（单臂研究）和ROBINS-I工具（比较研究）进行评估。

items.title: Water-Quality-Integrated Optimal Allocation of Agricultural Water Resources in Arid Irrigation Districts: A Case Study of Yingjisha County, Xinjiang
items.abstract: We developed a comprehensive water-quality-integrated model for allocating agricultural water resources in Yingjisha County, a hyper-arid county in Xinjiang, China. Groundwater was classified into four salinity levels, and brackish water was incorporated into the irrigation water supply system according to crop salt tolerance. The objective was to maximize agricultural net profit, while accounting for the Maas–Hoffman yield reduction coefficient, a graded salt damage penalty, and soft-constraint penalties, subject to constraints on water quantity, water quality, land area, food security, and freshwater conservation. Under the graded penalty framework, low-salinity brackish water remained economically viable for irrigation: freshwater dependency was governed by the freshwater-conservation ratio, gross agricultural profit increased by 13.6–17.0%, and the time to onset of mild soil salinization reached 5.7–6.0 years under the corrected per-class constraints. These results demonstrate the feasibility of classified regulation for brackish water irrigation in arid irrigation districts.
items.authors: Zhichao Li, Mian Fan, Sheng Li, Dilinaer Waheti, Yanyan Ge, Junfeng Meng

items.title: Cultural Adaptation in Physical Therapy: A Scoping Review of Empirical Evidence and Practices
items.abstract: Background and Purpose: The cultural adaptation of physical therapy interventions has been widely recommended, yet the literature remains limited, heterogeneous, and unevenly reported. This scoping review maps the literature on culturally adapted physical therapy and identifies adaptation strategies, key characteristics of the evidence base, and gaps relevant to education and practice. Methods: A scoping review of PubMed, Google Scholar, and Elicit (2000–2026) identified 37 peer-reviewed articles on the cultural adaptation of physical therapy. Searches were supplemented by backward and forward citation tracking.
